paper.title: The Plan, Not the Decoder: Diagnosing and Repairing Compositional Failure in Reasoning-Augmented Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Reasoning-augmented text-to-image models such as GoT-R1 emit an explicit textual plan - object names, attributes, and bounding boxes - before generating image tokens. When such a model fails a compositional prompt, is the plan wrong, or is the plan right and the decoder unfaithful? Because the plan is machine-readable it can be edited before decoding, which makes the two separable. We first validate the ruler. Swapping the two bounding boxes inside the model's own chain demonstrably flips the ge

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“推理增强 T2I 为什么会组合失败”这个泛问题，而是更具体的一层：失败究竟出在 planner 写错了中间计划，还是 decoder 没有忠实执行计划。作者围绕 GoT-R1-1B 做了可控干预，把 prompt、plan、decoder 三者拆开，逐项验证。全文的关键结论很明确：在可测的对象属性与空间关系任务上，decoder 大体是忠实执行者，主要瓶颈在 planner 的计划质量，尤其是关系写错、框重叠严重、对提示措辞敏感。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接启发不在图像生成效果本身，而在“显式中间表示是否真的有用、失败该归因到哪里、评测该怎么做”这三个问题。很多 reasoning-augmented 生成模型都引入了可读中间链条，但常见 benchmark 分数把 planning error 和 execution error 混在一起。这篇文章用干预实验把两者分开，说明显式 plan 不是摆设，decoder 也不是主要短板。更重要的是，它指出评测器本身会误导结论：VQA 式空间评测对布局变化不敏感，甚至会把明显错误打高分。对做统一多模态预训练、latent plan、AR+planner 联合训练的人，这个结论很实用：如果中间表示可验证，就应该优先做因果式诊断，而不是只看端到端分数。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者没有提出新的生成架构，而是设计了一套很干净的 intervention protocol。对象是 GoT-R1-1B：先从 prompt 生成文本 plan，plan 中包含对象片段、属性和 bounding box，再条件生成 576 个图像 token。核心做法有四类。第一类是验证评测器：作者直接在模型自己的 chain 里交换两个 box，制造一个已知会翻转布局的干预，再比较 VQA 式空间评分和 detector-based 几何评分是否能感知这个变化。第二类是 plan faithful execution 检验：比较“计划中的关系”与“检测出的图像布局”是否一致，并通过打乱 object segment 顺序、去掉 chain 等方式看 decoder 到底依赖什么信号。第三类是 external plan injection：把外部构造的 oracle plan 注入 decoder，系统考察三种文本风格和两种 box 分布，区分 decoder 是否依赖 planner 的写作风格、token 似然，还是只关心几何可执行性。第四类是 inference-time patch：对 planner 输出做符号验证、重采样和最小修补，测试不改模型参数能否提升组合正确率。这里有一个很重要的机制判断：decoder 对 plan 的语义绑定是按对象内容而不是按位置槽位进行的，所以简单交换对象段顺序不会让它机械地跟着位置走；但如果 plan 内部文本和 box 自相矛盾，就会诱发重复和 identity fusion。这说明 decoder 学到的是“语义对象—几何约束”的条件映射，而不是脆弱的模板对齐。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在 T2I-CompBench++ 的 color 和 spatial 两个验证子集，各 300 条 prompt。模型是 GoT-R1-1B，384px 输出，576 image tokens，默认 CFG 5.0、temperature 1.0、单 seed，并且所有条件共享同一硬件软件环境和解码设置，headline 结果都做了 paired permutation test。最关键的结果有几组。1）评测器诊断：把 chain 中两个 box 对调后，生成布局确实翻转，detector accuracy 从 0.75 降到 0.48，p<1e-3；但 VQA 空间分数反而上升，说明这类 judge 对布局盲。2）decoder 忠实性：在未扰动 chain 上，94% 的生成布局实现了计划中的关系，planned-vs-detected box IoU 为 0.75。3）planner 是瓶颈：大约五分之一 prompt 会写出无效关系，而且对语句表述极敏感；语义等价的布局描述，planning accuracy 可以从 98% 掉到 54%，作者把它归因为 mention-order / raster-order bias。4）外部计划注入：正确的外部 plan 若使用干净、分离良好的 box，可比模型自写 plan 提升 13.3 分，p=1e-4；而若沿用 planner 那种重叠 box 统计，则几乎没有收益。verbose 和 terse 文本风格差别不大，planner-likeness 也不重要，即使 NLL 差 5 倍也没有明显执行代价。5）训练外修补：符号验证加重采样可提升 5.0 分，最小原位修补可提升 6.0 分，说明问题主要在 plan 质量而不是 decoder capacity。全文还有一个负结果也值得记：去掉 chain 后 object presence 明显崩塌，说明 plan 不是可有可无的解释层，而是主要条件通道。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先抓三处。第一看引言和 4.1，理解作者为什么先打评测器，再谈模型归因；如果这一点没接受，后面的结论会显得不稳。第二看第 5 节的 oracle dial 实验，这是全文最有信息量的部分，它把“decoder 是否和 planner 共适配”这个常见猜想拆开验证了。重点看三种文本风格 × 两种 box 分布的设计，以及为什么 clean boxes 有效、planner-statistics boxes 无效。第三看第 6 节的 chain ablation 和顺序扰动实验，这部分最能说明 decoder 到底在读什么。预计 25 到 35 分钟能抓住主线。如果只想拿到对多模态预训练有用的结论，优先看图表里关于 box swap、plan-vs-image consistency、external plan injection、repair gains 的结果。作者没有做新的训练法，所以不必在实现细节上停留太久，重点是诊断框架和因果归因思路。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise causal question behind compositional failures in reasoning-augmented text-to-image models: when generation fails, is the planner wrong, or is the decoder failing to execute a correct plan? Using GoT-R1-1B as the testbed, the authors separate prompt, plan, and decoder through controlled interventions. The main answer is clear: on attribute binding and spatial composition, the decoder is largely a faithful executor, while the planner is the dominant source of error.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is less about image quality and more about diagnosis of explicit intermediate representations. Many multimodal systems now expose plans, chains, layouts, or latent reasoning traces, but end-to-end benchmark scores collapse planning and execution into one number. This work shows how to disentangle them with causal interventions. It also makes a strong evaluation point: VQA-style spatial judges can be blind to layout and may reward corrupted generations. For researchers working on explicit planning, multimodal pretraining, or AR models with intermediate symbolic structure, the paper is useful because it shows that interpretable plans are only helpful if they are also verifiable and separately evaluated.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is not a new generator but a careful intervention framework. GoT-R1-1B first emits a textual plan containing object spans, attributes, and bounding boxes, then generates 576 image tokens conditioned on both prompt and plan. The analysis has four parts. First, metric validation: the authors swap the two boxes inside the model's own chain, creating a known layout corruption, and test whether different evaluators detect it. Second, decoder-faithfulness tests: they compare planned relations against detected image layouts, and perturb object-segment order or remove the chain to identify what signal the decoder actually uses. Third, external-plan injection: they feed oracle plans into the decoder while varying text style and box statistics, to test whether execution depends on planner-specific phrasing, likelihood, or simply geometric quality. Fourth, inference-time repair: they apply symbolic verification, resampling, and minimal edits to planner outputs without retraining the model. A notable mechanistic finding is that the decoder binds boxes to object semantics rather than to positional slots in the serialized plan. Reordering object segments does not make it blindly follow token order, but internally inconsistent plans can trigger duplication and identity fusion. That points to a learned semantic-to-geometric conditioning map rather than brittle template matching.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use the color and spatial validation subsets of T2I-CompBench++, 300 prompts each. The model is GoT-R1-1B with 384px outputs, 576 image tokens, CFG 5.0, temperature 1.0, and matched decoding settings across all conditions. Headline results are tested with paired permutation tests. Key findings: 1) evaluator failure: swapping the two boxes flips the generated layout, and detector-based spatial accuracy drops from 0.75 to 0.48 (p<1e-3), while a VQA-style spatial score increases, showing that the judge is not layout-sensitive; 2) decoder faithfulness: on unperturbed chains, 94% of generated layouts realize the planned relation, with planned-vs-detected box IoU of 0.75; 3) planner bottleneck: roughly one in five prompts yields an invalid relation in the plan, and planning accuracy is highly phrasing-sensitive, ranging from 98% to 54% for semantically equivalent layouts, which the authors trace to mention-order or raster-order bias; 4) external plans: correct injected plans with clean, well-separated boxes outperform the model's own plans by +13.3 points (p=1e-4), while plans that preserve the planner's overlapping box statistics provide little benefit; text style, whether terse or verbose, matters little, and planner-likeness is irrelevant despite a 5x NLL gap; 5) training-free fixes: symbolic verification with resampling gives +5.0 points, and minimal in-place repair gives +6.0 points. Another important negative result is that removing the chain sharply hurts object presence, indicating that the plan is a primary conditioning channel rather than a decorative explanation layer.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and Section 4.1 to understand why the paper starts by validating the evaluator before making any model-level claim. Second, read Section 5 carefully, especially the oracle-dial experiment; this is where the paper most cleanly tests whether decoder performance depends on planner style or on geometric executability. Third, read Section 6 for chain ablations and order perturbations, which reveal what the decoder is actually conditioning on. In 25 to 35 minutes, you can extract the main lessons. If your interest is multimodal pretraining rather than T2I benchmarking, prioritize the figures and tables on box swapping, plan-image consistency, external plan injection, and repair gains. The training setup itself is not the point; the diagnosis protocol is.

recommendation.zh: 解耦了 T2I 模型中 reasoning plan 和 decoding 的错误归因，结论很 solid（decoder 是忠实的，瓶颈在 planner），对多模态生成和 reasoning 结合的研究很有启发。
recommendation.en: Decouples error attribution between reasoning plan and decoding in T2I models, with solid conclusions (decoder is faithful, bottleneck is planner), highly inspiring for research combining multimodal generation and reasoning.

paper.title: Calibrate What You SHIP: Post-Selection Risk Control for Verifier-Guided Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Verifier-guided text-to-image systems increasingly use test-time search to select, refine, or stop among multiple candidates, yet release thresholds are often calibrated on individual images. This creates a candidate-to-policy calibration mismatch: search changes both which prompts receive an output and which candidate is released, so candidate-level risk control need not imply control of released-output risk. We formalize this estimand shift through prompt reweighting and within-prompt selectio

summary.core_problem: 解决 verifier-guided 文生图系统中“按单张候选图校准”不能保证最终发布输出风险受控的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是生成系统的风险校准方法，重点指出 test-time search 会改变输出分布和覆盖的 prompt 分布；对做 verifier、best-of-N、拒答阈值和推理时搜索的研究有方法论参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SHIP，即 Selection-aware Held-out calibration of Inference Policies。方法在 held-out prompts 上运行或回放完整部署策略，用独立 target judge 评估实际被发布的图像，再选择满足风险上界预算的最宽松阈值。对可回放策略和预设阈值网格，使用 simultaneous confidence control 给出有限样本有效性。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 fixed、sequential 和 adaptive verifier-guided text-to-image inference policies；摘要未给出具体模型名称、样本量和数值提升，但强调 candidate-level calibration 与 released-output risk 之间存在系统性错配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between calibrating individual image candidates and controlling the risk of the image actually released by a verifier-guided text-to-image policy.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a risk calibration procedure for generation systems, showing that test-time search changes both prompt coverage and candidate selection. The setup is relevant to verifier use, best-of-N sampling, abstention thresholds, and inference-time search beyond image generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed SHIP procedure runs or replays the full deployed inference policy on held-out prompts, evaluates the actually released image with an independent target judge, and selects the most permissive threshold satisfying a risk upper bound. For replayable policies over a fixed threshold grid, simultaneous confidence control provides finite-sample validity.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover fixed, sequential, and adaptive verifier-guided text-to-image policies. The supplied abstract does not specify model names, sample counts, or exact gains, but it reports a systematic mismatch between candidate-level calibration and released-output risk.

recommendation.zh: 只看校准定义和有限样本部分；它提醒 best-of-N 阈值不能按候选样本独立校准。
recommendation.en: Read only the calibration setup and finite-sample section; it is a useful warning that best-of-N thresholds cannot be calibrated per candidate.

paper.title: GuardPaint:SpeculativeSafetyDecodingforText-to-ImageGeneration
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models offer powerful visual generation, but their controllability creates a critical safety challenge: adversarial prompts can steer the denoising trajectory toward policy-violating content such as explicit nudity or graphic violence. Existing safeguards mostly act before generation through prompt filtering or after generation through image classification, leaving the diffusion process itself unguarded and often yielding only refusal rather than safe visual repair.

summary.core_problem: 文本到图像扩散模型的安全防护通常只做生成前过滤或生成后分类，无法在扩散轨迹内部纠偏，容易导致拒答或生成违规内容。
summary.importance: 贡献是扩散生成安全的推理时控制方法。它不是预训练方法，但把“speculative decoding”式候选生成与审核机制迁移到扩散轨迹中，对思考生成过程内安全约束有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: GuardPaint 不修改基础 T2I 模型，而是在去噪过程中插入轻量 auditor。auditor 监控中间图像、定位不安全区域，只对违规区域触发 inpainting 修复；多个候选修复通过 guarded tournament 选择，只有同时提升合规性并保持 prompt fidelity 的编辑才被接受。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体使用的 T2I 模型、数据集、违规类别评测集或提升数字。实验重点应是安全合规率、提示保持度、局部修复质量和额外推理开销。

summary_en.core_problem: Safety controls for text-to-image diffusion mostly operate before generation or after generation, leaving the denoising trajectory itself unguarded and often producing either refusals or unsafe outputs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time safety control method for diffusion generation. It is not a pretraining paper, but the idea of guarded candidate generation inside the trajectory is relevant to broader generative-model control.
summary_en.technical_approach: GuardPaint keeps the base T2I model unchanged and inserts a lightweight auditor into the denoising process. The auditor monitors intermediate images, localizes unsafe regions, invokes a policy-aligned inpainter only where needed, and selects among repairs through a guarded tournament that requires improved compliance while preserving prompt fidelity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the base T2I model, evaluation datasets, unsafe-content taxonomy, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation axes are policy compliance, prompt fidelity, local repair quality, and inference overhead.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练问题；若关心生成时安全控制，只看轨迹内 auditor 与局部修复设计即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining problem; if you care about generation-time safety, only inspect the in-trajectory auditor and localized repair design.

paper.title: Abra: Scaling Diffusion Image Training
paper.abstract: Compute-optimal scaling laws guide the training of frontier language models yet remain largely unexplored for visual generation. We present a systematic scaling law study for text-to-image diffusion models using Abra, a controlled family of flow-matching transformers trained across three orders of magnitude worth of compute ($10^{19}$ to $10^{22}$ FLOPs), reaching significantly larger compute budgets than previous works. We demonstrate that diffusion models scale just as predictably as language

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型在视觉生成任务中缺乏系统性的 Scaling Law 研究，导致训练时计算资源的分配（模型大小与训练数据量的权衡）缺乏理论指导。
summary.importance: 首次为文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型建立了严谨的 Compute-Optimal Scaling Law，填补了视觉生成领域在预训练 Scaling 规律上的空白。其结论打破了 LLM 领域的 Chinchilla 定律在视觉任务中的适用性，对未来大规模视觉生成模型的训练资源分配具有直接指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出了 ABRA，一个基于 Flow-Matching Transformer 的受控模型家族。通过在跨越三个数量级（10^19 到 10^22 FLOPs）的计算预算下进行系统性训练，研究了模型参数量和训练数据量（图像 token 数）之间的最优分配。研究方法借鉴了 LLM 领域的 Scaling Law 研究范式，但针对扩散模型的特性（如 CFG、不同的评估指标）进行了适配。
summary.experiments: 实验表明，扩散模型的 Scaling 规律与语言模型一样可预测，但达到计算最优所需的数据量远大于 LLM。具体而言，计算最优发生在每个参数约 200 个图像 token 处，这是 LLM Chinchilla 定律（每个参数 20 个 token）的十倍。此外，与语言模型不同，扩散模型对过度训练（Overtraining）具有鲁棒性，这意味着在计算资源受限时，增加训练数据量（即使超过最优比例）通常是有益的。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Section 4.1 中关于 Iso-FLOP 分析的图表（如 Table 7 和 Table 8），理解不同评估指标（如 FID, CLIPScore）下的 Scaling 规律差异。深入阅读关于过度训练鲁棒性的讨论，这与 LLM 的训练动态有显著不同。

summary_en.core_problem: The lack of systematic Scaling Law studies for diffusion models in visual generation tasks leads to a lack of theoretical guidance for allocating computing resources (the trade-off between model size and training data volume) during training.
summary_en.importance: This work establishes rigorous Compute-Optimal Scaling Laws for text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models for the first time, filling a gap in pre-training scaling laws for visual generation. The findings challenge the applicability of the Chinchilla scaling laws from the LLM domain to visual tasks, providing direct guidance for resource allocation in training future large-scale visual generation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce ABRA, a controlled family of Flow-Matching Transformers. By systematically training across three orders of magnitude of compute budgets (10^19 to 10^22 FLOPs), they investigate the optimal allocation between model parameter count and training data volume (image tokens). The methodology adapts the Scaling Law research paradigm from the LLM domain to the specific characteristics of diffusion models (e.g., CFG, different evaluation metrics).
summary_en.experiments: Experiments demonstrate that diffusion models scale as predictably as language models but require significantly more data to reach compute optimality. Specifically, compute optimality occurs at approximately 200 image tokens per parameter, ten times the Chinchilla prescription for LLMs (20 tokens per parameter). Furthermore, unlike language models, diffusion models are robust to overtraining, implying that increasing training data (even beyond the optimal ratio) is generally beneficial when compute is constrained.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Iso-FLOP analysis charts in Section 4.1 (e.g., Table 7 and Table 8) to understand the differences in scaling laws across various evaluation metrics (e.g., FID, CLIPScore). Read the discussion on robustness to overtraining carefully, as it highlights a significant difference from LLM training dynamics.

recommendation.zh: 把视觉扩散的compute-optimal做到了足够大算力区间，200 tokens/param与“不过训更鲁棒”会直接影响多模态算力配比；先看最优比与过训分析。
recommendation.en: Large-range compute-optimal scaling for visual diffusion; the ~200 tokens/param optimum and overtraining robustness should change how you budget compute for multimodal diffusion—read the optimal-ratio and overtraining sections first.

paper.title: TEA: Text Encoder Alignment for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can be misused to generate harmful content through adversarial or paraphrased prompts that bypass built-in safety mechanisms. Existing concept erasure methods often suffer from limited robustness against adversarial prompts, degradation of benign generation quality, or reliance on inference-time interventions that introduce persistent computational overhead. To address these limitations, we formulate concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text represe

summary.core_problem: 如何提升文本到图像扩散模型中概念擦除（Concept Erasure）方法对抗性提示的鲁棒性，同时不影响正常生成质量且不增加推理开销？
summary.importance: 提出了一种轻量级的文本编码器对齐框架，将概念擦除转化为文本表示空间的域对齐问题，为多模态生成模型的安全性（Safety）提供了一种高效的后训练（Post-training）干预手段。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TEA（Text Encoder Alignment）框架，冻结生成主干网络，仅微调文本编码器。通过训练判别器区分包含概念的提示和安全锚点提示的 token 级表示，并更新文本编码器使这两种表示难以区分，从而实现概念擦除。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像扩散模型上进行了实验，证明了该方法在对抗性提示下的鲁棒性，且零推理开销，仅需少量训练数据。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve the robustness of concept erasure methods in text-to-image diffusion models against adversarial prompts without degrading benign generation quality or introducing inference overhead?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a lightweight text encoder alignment framework that formulates concept erasure as a domain alignment problem in the text representation space, providing an efficient post-training intervention for the safety of multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the TEA (Text Encoder Alignment) framework, freezing the generative backbone and only fine-tuning the text encoder. It trains a discriminator to distinguish token-level representations of concept-containing prompts from safe anchor prompts, and updates the text encoder to make them indistinguishable, achieving concept erasure.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on text-to-image diffusion models demonstrated robustness against adversarial prompts with zero inference overhead and minimal training data requirements.

recommendation.zh: 通过对齐文本编码器表示空间来实现概念擦除，思路干净，对多模态安全对齐（Safety Alignment）有启发，可关注其域对齐的 loss 设计。
recommendation.en: Achieves concept erasure by aligning the text encoder representation space; a clean approach inspiring for multimodal safety alignment, worth noting its domain alignment loss design.

paper.title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially m

summary.core_problem: 像素空间文本到图像扩散模型缺乏可与潜空间模型匹敌的大规模训练配方，且直接像素空间预训练收敛显著慢于潜空间。
summary.importance: 工程突破/经验研究：首次系统给出像素空间 T2I 扩散模型的大规模训练配方，核心发现是 latent-to-pixel 两阶段策略优于直接像素空间预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 latent-to-pixel 策略：先在潜空间高效获取生成先验，再在后训练阶段切换到像素空间；系统研究了权重初始化、数据组合、预测目标、解码器架构和噪声调度五个关键设计选择。
summary.experiments: 大规模文本到图像设置；对比潜空间基线，所得像素空间模型匹配或超过潜空间对应模型的质量。摘要未给出具体参数量和数值。

summary_en.core_problem: Pixel-space text-to-image diffusion models lack a large-scale training recipe that rivals latent-space counterparts, and direct pixel-space pretraining converges substantially slower.
summary_en.importance: Engineering/empirical contribution: systematically provides a large-scale training recipe for pixel-space T2I diffusion, with the key finding that a latent-to-pixel two-stage strategy outperforms direct pixel-space pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a latent-to-pixel strategy: acquire generative priors efficiently in latent space, then transition to pixel space during post-training. Systematically ablates weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule.
summary_en.experiments: Large-scale text-to-image setting; the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform latent-space counterparts. Specific parameter counts and numbers are not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 像素空间扩散训练的工程经验总结，latent-to-pixel 迁移思路对离散扩散 LM 中表示空间切换有类比价值；只看配方表即可。
recommendation.en: A solid empirical training recipe for pixel-space diffusion; the latent-to-pixel transition is a useful analogy for representation-space switches in discrete diffusion LMs. Just read the recipe table.

paper.title: Adversarial Learning of Classifier-Free Guidance Schedules
paper.abstract: Modern text-to-image diffusion models rely on classifier-free guidance (CFG) to achieve high image fidelity and text alignment. However, CFG typically applies a static, global scale across all timesteps, samples, and conditions -- a choice that is generally suboptimal and can introduce artifacts, as different states may benefit from different levels of guidance. While time-varying schedules are known to improve quality, designing them by hand is non-trivial and application-dependent. In this pap

summary.core_problem: 文本到图像扩散/流匹配模型中，classifier-free guidance（CFG）通常使用固定全局guidance weight，忽略不同时间步、条件和当前噪声样本对引导强度的不同需求；论文研究如何自动学习依赖时间、条件和样本状态的CFG调度，而不是手工设计常量或时变表。
summary.importance: 这是一篇生成模型采样方法论文，核心对象是图像diffusion/flow matching的CFG，不是LLM基座预训练本身。对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但有两点值得留意：其一，它把“训练时给出条件/无条件模型，采样时如何动态混合两个预测”转化为密度比估计和对抗训练问题，这一思路对离散扩散LM、masked LM或统一多模态模型中的guided decoding有概念参考价值；其二，它延续了最近把采样策略从静态超参数改为自适应、可学习策略的趋势，这和语言模型中自适应temperature、长度惩罚、verifier-guided decoding属于同一类问题。但总体上它更偏图像生成推理控制，不属于必须跟踪的预训练主线。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以flow matching为主要形式化对象，把guidance schedule建模为时间t、条件c和当前噪声样本x_t的函数，而不是全局常数。理论约束从之前工作中较强的self-consistency退回到较弱的marginal consistency：希望guided采样轨迹在每个时间步的边际分布尽量匹配真实数据加噪后的边际分布。实现上不用MMD或能量距离，而是采用对抗框架：训练一个判别器估计真实样本与CFG引导样本之间随时间变化的log-density ratio，再优化guidance调度器，使引导轨迹在各时间步的边际更接近真实边际。这样得到的guidance weight可以同时依赖时间、prompt和当前latent state，相比常数CFG和手工时变schedule更细粒度。
summary.experiments: 实验在标准T2I基准上对比常数CFG、手工时变CFG以及先前的learned guidance基线。论文报告在样本质量（FID）和文本对齐指标上同时优于这些基线，说明只要求marginal consistency的对抗式密度比学习，比之前追求self-consistency但对齐受限的方法更有效。论文没有把方法改成生成模型自身的训练目标，也没有讨论对大模型scaling的影响；主要收益集中在采样阶段的调度自适应。消融重点显示时间、条件和样本依赖三者都有贡献，常数或纯时间依赖的schedule不足以同时兼顾保真度和prompt adherence。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看引言和方法部分如何从marginal consistency推到density ratio/GAN形式，以及实验部分与静态CFG、手工schedule、Galashov等先前learned schedule的对比。若不做图像diffusion，不必细抠flow matching推导。预计阅读时间20–30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Classifier-free guidance in text-to-image diffusion and flow-matching models typically uses a fixed global guidance weight, even though different timesteps, prompts, and noisy states likely require different amounts of guidance. The paper studies how to learn a CFG schedule that depends on time, conditioning, and the current noisy sample rather than relying on hand-tuned constants or hand-designed time-varying schedules.
summary_en.importance: This is a sampling-methods paper for image diffusion/flow matching rather than a core LLM pretraining paper. Its direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited, but two ideas are worth noting. First, it reframes the sampling-time mixture of conditional and unconditional predictions as a density-ratio estimation and adversarial learning problem, which is conceptually relevant to guided decoding in discrete diffusion LMs, masked LMs, or unified multimodal models. Second, it continues the broader trend of turning static sampling hyperparameters into adaptive, learned policies, parallel to adaptive temperature, length penalties, or verifier-guided decoding in language models. Even so, the paper is primarily about image-generation inference control and is not central to the pretraining research stack.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper is formalized mainly in flow matching and models the guidance schedule as a function of timestep t, conditioning c, and current noisy state x_t, instead of a global scalar. It weakens the requirement from the stronger self-consistency objective used in prior learned-guidance work to a marginal-consistency condition: the guided sampling trajectory should match the true noised-data marginals at each timestep. Rather than using MMD or energy-distance kernels, the authors adopt an adversarial framework: a discriminator is trained to estimate the time-dependent log-density ratio between real samples and classifier-free guided samples, while the guidance scheduler is optimized to make guided marginals closer to the true marginals at all timesteps. The resulting guidance weight is therefore adaptive to time, prompt, and latent state, making it more expressive than constant CFG or manually designed schedules.
summary_en.experiments: On standard text-to-image benchmarks, the method is compared against constant CFG, hand-designed dynamic CFG schedules, and prior learned-guidance baselines. The paper reports improvements in both sample quality, measured by FID, and text-alignment metrics, indicating that adversarial density-ratio learning under the weaker marginal-consistency objective can outperform earlier self-consistency-based methods that improved distribution match but lagged in prompt adherence. The method is a sampling-time improvement rather than a change to generative-model training, and the paper does not study scaling effects on large models. Ablations suggest that time, conditioning, and sample dependence all contribute; constant or purely time-dependent schedules are insufficient to balance fidelity and prompt adherence.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the introduction and method sections for the move from marginal consistency to a density-ratio/GAN objective, and on the experimental comparison with static CFG, hand-tuned schedules, and prior learned schedules such as Galashov et al. Readers outside image diffusion can skip much of the flow-matching derivation. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散领域核心作者团队提出用对抗训练学习自适应CFG调度，方法可迁移至MDLM/LLaDA等文本扩散模型，重点看密度比估计建模
recommendation.en: Core diffusion researchers propose learning adaptive CFG schedules via adversarial training; method transfers to discrete diffusion LMs (MDLM/LLaDA) — focus on the density ratio estimation formulation.

paper.title: Concept Guidance: Precise, Training-Free Latent Control for Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models have two major drawbacks that severely limit their practical utility: (1) standard models lack an intrinsic mechanism for continuous, concept-specific guidance (e.g., for precisely controlling how aesthetically pleasing an image looks), and (2) they lack reliability for tasks requiring high local coherence (e.g., generating text or human hands). To tackle these issues, we introduce a novel notion of concept-wise mutual information and find large, concept-dependent

summary.core_problem: 解决文生图扩散模型缺乏连续概念级精准控制、局部一致性（如文字、人手生成）差的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新+机制发现，首次提出概念级互信息量化扩散模型层贡献，实现无需训练/外部模型的无训练引导，揭示扩散模型层级语义分工规律。
summary.technical_approach: 原创方法，先通过概念级互信息度量每层对特定目标概念的贡献度，再在去噪过程中增强概念相关层的输出权重，无需训练、梯度、外部模型或prompt工程即可实现精准控制。
summary.experiments: 在Stable Diffusion 1.5/2.1、SDXL等模型上验证，覆盖美学程度控制、文字生成、人手生成等任务，对比CFG、Prompt-to-Prompt等无训练基线，概念控制精度与局部一致性均有提升。
summary.authors_note: LMU Munich、Konrad Zuse卓越可靠AI学院（relAI）、慕尼黑机器学习中心（MCML），Björn Ommer团队（扩散模型领域知名研究团队，参与Stable Diffusion系列工作）

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two critical limitations of text-to-image diffusion models: lack of continuous, concept-specific precise control and poor local coherence (e.g., generated text, human hands).
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation + mechanistic insight; first proposes concept-wise mutual information to quantify layer-wise concept contribution, enables training-free guidance without external models, reveals layer-level semantic specialization in diffusion models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Original framework: first measures each layer's contribution to target concepts via concept-wise mutual information, then amplifies output weights of concept-relevant layers during denoising, requiring no training, gradients, external models, or prompt engineering.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Stable Diffusion 1.5/2.1, SDXL across aesthetic control, text generation, hand generation tasks; outperforms training-free baselines (CFG, Prompt-to-Prompt) in concept control precision and local coherence.
summary_en.authors_note: LMU Munich, Konrad Zuse School of Excellence in Reliable AI (relAI), Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML); Björn Ommer's group, a leading team in diffusion model research (contributed to Stable Diffusion series work).

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型层级语义分工的发现对跨模态统一建模范式有弱参考，仅看§3概念互信息定义与Fig4层贡献热图即可，对纯LLM预训练无直接价值。
recommendation.en: The layer-wise semantic specialization finding is a weak reference for unified multimodal paradigm research; only read §3 for mutual information definition and Fig 4 for layer heatmaps, no direct value for pure LLM pretraining.

institutions: Konrad Zuse School of Excellence in Reliable AI (relAI)
Affiliation:Konrad Zuse School of Excellence in Reliable AI (relAI)

paper.title: On the Limitations of Cross-Lingual Consistency in Multilingual Text-to-image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) generation has achieved remarkable progress in recent years. However, existing research has largely focused on English-only settings, leaving cross-lingual performance gaps and language-specific effects insufficiently explored. To fill this gap, we introduce LingT2I, a benchmark covering 10 widely used languages with 33K prompts, designed to evaluate cross-lingual effects in both content generation and text rendering. Building on this benchmark, we conduct a comprehensive cro

summary.core_problem: 评估多语言 prompt 下文本到图像模型的内容生成和文字渲染是否保持跨语言一致性。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成评测资产和行为分析。它不是 LLM 预训练核心论文，但对统一多模态模型的 multilingual alignment、视觉-语言 tokenizer 和跨语言数据配比有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 LingT2I benchmark，覆盖 10 种常用语言和 33K prompts，从内容生成和文本渲染两个方面评估跨语言效果，并分析语言因素和文化上下文对生成模式的系统性影响。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕现有 T2I 模型的跨语言评估展开，报告语言不平等、不同指标之间的语言依赖 trade-off，以及若干语言相关生成模式。摘要未列出具体模型名单、指标数值和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Khalifa University、Queen Mary University of London、The Chinese University of Hong Kong、The University of Melbourne 和 University of Central Florida。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether text-to-image systems behave consistently across multilingual prompts in both visual content generation and text rendering.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark and analysis for multilingual T2I behavior. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to multilingual alignment in unified multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce LingT2I, a benchmark with 33K prompts in 10 widely used languages. They evaluate cross-lingual effects on generated content and rendered text, then analyze language-dependent patterns tied to linguistic and cultural factors.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates existing T2I models and reports linguistic inequality, language-dependent trade-offs across metrics, and systematic generation patterns. The abstract does not provide the evaluated model list or quantitative margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include Khalifa University, Queen Mary University of London, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, The University of Melbourne, and University of Central Florida.

recommendation.zh: 看 benchmark 设计即可；它提醒多模态预训练别只用英文 prompt 评估 alignment，方法部分不用深读。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark setup, not the full method; it is a useful reminder that English-only prompts hide multimodal alignment failures.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Affiliation:The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: PEAK: Precise and Persistent Concept Erasure via k-Sparse Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Erasing concepts from large-scale text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has become increasingly crucial due to the growing concerns over copyright infringement, privacy violations, and offensive content. Existing approaches struggle to achieve both precise and persistent concept erasure: inaccurate localization of concept-related representations may cause unintended semantic interference, while incomplete removal of the underlying concept knowledge allows adversarial recovery. To address this dil

summary.core_problem: 文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除难以同时做到精确和持久：定位不准会伤及非目标语义，删除不彻底又会被对抗提示恢复。
summary.importance: 贡献是把 k-Sparse Autoencoder 用于扩散去噪网络内部表征分解，再基于稀疏特征做目标概念定位和擦除。它属于生成模型安全与可解释性结合的方法，对 LLM 的 SAE 机制研究有旁路参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: PEAK 先在 diffusion denoising network 的内部激活上训练 kSAE，将稠密表示分解为可解释稀疏特征；再对比目标 prompt 与非目标 prompt 诱发的稀疏激活，按激活强度和出现频率识别紧凑的目标特异特征集合，并围绕这些特征执行概念擦除。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出使用的 T2I 模型、kSAE 规模、训练数据、baseline 和具体数值。预期实验会覆盖目标概念移除率、非目标语义保持、对抗恢复难度和生成质量损失。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of making concept erasure in text-to-image diffusion models both precise and persistent.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is to apply k-Sparse Autoencoders to internal activations of diffusion denoising networks and use sparse features for concept localization and removal. It is mainly a generative-model safety paper, with some indirect relevance to SAE-based interpretability for LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEAK trains a kSAE on internal denoiser activations to decompose dense representations into sparse interpretable features. It then contrasts activations from target and non-target prompts, selects compact target-specific features by strength and frequency, and erases concepts through these localized features.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the T2I backbone, kSAE size, training data, baselines, or numerical gains. The expected evaluation covers target concept removal, preservation of unrelated semantics, resistance to adversarial recovery, and generation quality degradation.

recommendation.zh: SAE 用到 diffusion 内部表征的做法可扫一眼；对 LLM 预训练不是主线，关键看特征定位是否比 prompt 编辑更干净。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance for the SAE-on-diffusion representation angle; for LLM pretraining, the only real question is whether feature localization is cleaner than prompt-level editing.

paper.title: RL-Native Distillation: Exploiting Scored Trajectories for Few-Step Image Generation
paper.abstract: Efficient text-to-image generation requires both reinforcement-learning (RL)-based reward alignment and few-step distillation, yet these procedures are typically performed sequentially, increasing training cost and risking the loss of reward gains during compression. We instead take an RL-native perspective: diffusion RL already generates reward-scored finite-step trajectories, whose intermediate states provide a natural source of distillation supervision rather than a disposable byproduct of sa

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像模型中 RL 奖励对齐和少步蒸馏通常分阶段进行，导致训练成本高且压缩后奖励收益可能丢失的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是把扩散 RL 采样过程中已有的带分数轨迹直接用作蒸馏监督，属于图像生成训练流程改进。对 LLM 预训练不直接，但对“RL 信号如何和蒸馏/压缩共用轨迹”有可借鉴的训练接口思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 REST，即 Reward-Enhanced Scored-Trajectory Distillation，在不改变 RL teacher 优化的前提下挂接一个解耦 student，让 student 从 teacher 演化中的 rollout trajectory 做分段蒸馏；同时提出 Advantage-Modulated Distillation，用 advantage 调节模仿强度，避免平均模仿低奖励行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法可接入任意 RL teacher，并面向少步文本到图像生成；给出的片段未提供具体基础模型、训练数据、采样步数、奖励模型、基线或定量提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to merge reward alignment and few-step distillation for text-to-image diffusion models, avoiding the cost and reward loss of a sequential pipeline.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a training interface: reuse reward-scored RL trajectories as distillation supervision. This is not LLM pretraining, but the idea is relevant to how RL signals and compression can share rollouts.
summary_en.technical_approach: REST attaches a decoupled student to an RL teacher and trains it segment-wise from the teacher’s evolving scored trajectories, without changing the teacher optimization. Advantage-Modulated Distillation weights imitation by advantage so that low-reward behavior is not copied uniformly.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the method is designed for few-step text-to-image generation and can work with arbitrary RL teachers. The provided excerpt does not specify model scale, datasets, reward models, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LM 论文，但“带分数轨迹直接蒸馏”值得记；只看方法图和 AMD 公式。
recommendation.en: Not an LM paper, but scored-trajectory distillation is worth noting; read the method diagram and AMD equation only.

paper.title: Rectify Then Diffuse: Disentangling Concepts Before Denoising Trajectory Unfolds
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate individual concepts well, but they often omit or merge concepts incorrectly with multiple concepts. We trace these failures to an early coordination bottleneck: before denoising begins, prompt-conditioned attention may allocate different concepts to strongly overlapping spatial support, which can keep their attention coupled as denoising proceeds. This observation motivates treating compositional generation as a boundary-condition problem rather than r

summary.core_problem: 改善文本到图像扩散模型在多概念组合生成时漏掉、合并或空间纠缠概念的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练-free 图像生成控制方法。它把组合失败归因到去噪开始前的注意力空间分配，而不是只在去噪过程中反复施加控制；对理解扩散模型的早期条件注入有一定参考，但不直接服务 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Rectify-then-Diffuse。先用 pilot concept maps 估计不同概念的 normalized overlap，再用 Soft-Overlap Disentanglement 构造可微分的分离目标；随后用 Isotropic Gradient Rectification 对梯度归一化，并在初始 latent 上施加有界修正，之后按标准扩散去噪生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体基座模型、数据集、评测指标或提升幅度；方法定位为 training-free，主要应与现有 compositional generation 控制方法比较概念保真度、空间分离和图像质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses concept omission, merging, and spatial entanglement in multi-concept text-to-image diffusion generation.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free control method for image generation. It attributes compositional failures to the initial spatial allocation of prompt-conditioned attention rather than only to errors accumulated during denoising. It is useful for understanding early conditioning in diffusion models, but it is not directly about LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Rectify-then-Diffuse. The method estimates normalized overlap between pilot concept maps, defines a differentiable Soft-Overlap Disentanglement objective, applies Isotropic Gradient Rectification to normalize and bound the latent update, and then runs standard denoising.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the base model, datasets, metrics, or numerical gains. The intended comparisons are likely against existing compositional generation controls on concept fidelity, spatial separation, and image quality.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道但不必精读；看初始 attention overlap 的诊断即可，训练-free 控制对 pretrain 动作有限。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing, not worth a full read; inspect the initial-attention-overlap diagnosis, while the training-free control gives little pretraining action.

paper.title: Test-Time Scaling for Safe Text-Guided Image Generation via Intermediate Clean Estimates
paper.abstract: Ensuring safety and policy compliance in text-to-image diffusion models remains a critical challenge, as benign or adversarial prompts can often elicit prohibited content, e.g. nudity and protected intellectual property. While training-based unlearning methods are effective, they are computationally expensive and prone to catastrophic interference with general capabilities. Conversely, existing test-time defenses are primarily prompt-centric, relying on modifying textual descriptions only, and o

summary.core_problem: 解决文生图扩散模型在不改权重前提下，如何在推理时更可靠地拦截违规内容的问题。
summary.importance: 这是生成模型安全与 test-time intervention 工作，不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对“推理时利用中间表征做检测与干预”这一思路有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法利用扩散生成过程中的 intermediate clean estimate 作为视觉检测信号，用 sparse margin objective 判断是否出现违规概念；一旦触发，就在文本条件空间上优化结构化低秩残差，并通过 truncated backprop 在有限预算内进行干预，保持模型权重不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型与数据规模；实验应围绕安全文生图场景，对比训练式 unlearning 和仅基于 prompt 的 test-time defense，关注违规拦截率、正常提示下的能力保持和额外延迟。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to enforce safety in text-to-image diffusion models at inference time without modifying model weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a generation-safety and test-time intervention paper rather than a pretraining contribution, but the idea of using intermediate states for detection and control is still mildly relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses the intermediate clean estimate during diffusion as a visual signal for prohibited-concept detection via a sparse margin objective. When a violation is detected, it optimizes a structured low-rank residual in the text-conditioning space with truncated backpropagation, leaving model weights untouched.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model or dataset scale; experiments likely compare against training-based unlearning and prompt-only test-time defenses on safety blocking, benign-prompt utility retention, and latency overhead.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不大，但“用生成中间态做检测再局部干预”这个接口设计值得记一下；正文不必细读，抓住中间 clean estimate 的用法即可。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but the interface—detect from intermediate denoising states, then intervene locally—is worth noting; you do not need a full read beyond that mechanism.

paper.title: Mind the Gap: Zero-Query Jailbreaks via Filter-Generator Discrepancy in Text-to-Image Systems
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) systems typically have prompt-level safety filters before the generator to block unsafe requests, yet such systems remain vulnerable to malicious jailbreak prompts. Transfer-based attacks construct adversarial prompts offline without querying the target, but they tend to overfit to a single surrogate. Moreover, they explore a large search space in which semantic or perceptual similarity alone cannot guarantee both filter evasion and preservation of the unsafe generation inten

summary.core_problem: 研究文本到图像系统中，攻击者如何在不查询目标模型的情况下绕过 prompt-level 安全过滤器，同时保留生成危险视觉内容的意图。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成安全分析和攻击方法。它提出 Filter-Generator Discrepancy 作为攻击切入点，强调过滤器和生成器对同一 prompt 的表示目标不同，导致 prompt 风险判断和视觉概念保留之间存在可利用空隙。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出零查询 jailbreak 框架。方法先利用可观察信号筛选扰动，把搜索空间缩小到更可能同时满足 filter evasion 和 unsafe intent preservation 的候选集，再构造可迁移攻击 prompt。核心不是简单优化语义或感知相似度，而是针对 filter 与 generator 的目标差异进行筛选。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出完整数值结果。实验目标应是比较零查询转移攻击在不同 T2I 系统上的过滤绕过率、危险意图保留率和查询成本，并验证 FGD 筛选比仅依赖语义或感知相似度的候选搜索更有效。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how attackers can jailbreak prompt-level safety filters in text-to-image systems without querying the target model while preserving the unsafe visual intent.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation safety and attack-method contribution. It introduces Filter-Generator Discrepancy as the key lever: safety filters and generators process the same prompt with different objectives and representations, creating an exploitable gap.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a zero-query jailbreak framework that screens perturbations into a high-potential candidate set using observable signals. The method aims to find prompts that both evade the filter and preserve the unsafe concept for the generator, instead of relying only on semantic or perceptual similarity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report full numeric results. The intended evaluation appears to compare zero-query transfer attacks across T2I systems using filter-bypass rate, unsafe-intent preservation, and query cost, and to test whether FGD-based screening is better than similarity-only candidate search.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不是主线；做原生多模态安全的人可看 FGD 定义，重点是 filter/generator 分离带来的系统性漏洞。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; multimodal-safety readers should inspect the FGD definition, where filter-generator separation creates a systematic failure mode.

paper.title: PRISM: Prompt Refinement via Image-grounded Self-rewarding Mechanism for Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image generation models can synthesize high-quality images from natural language descriptions, but their performance remains highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Existing prompt optimization methods mainly rely on text-side rewriting, prompt expansion, or external reward signals, offering limited image-grounded diagnosis and weak support for learning reusable optimisation policies. In this paper, we propose PRISM, a Prompt Refinement framework via Image-grounded Self-rewarding Mechani

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图模型性能对prompt表述高度敏感，现有prompt优化方法仅依赖文本侧改写或外部奖励，缺乏图像层面的诊断且难以学习可复用的优化策略
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次构建prompt-图像-反馈的闭环自奖励框架，用于文生图的prompt自动优化
summary.technical_approach: 提出PRISM框架，先通过多任务SFT训练统一VLM作为诊断器，再结合理想点与切比雪夫混合奖励的自奖励优化机制改进prompt策略，从语义一致性、美学质量、人类偏好三个维度评估生成图像
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型参数量及训练数据规模，仅声明大量实验验证其可全面提升图像整体质量与细粒度语义对齐度

summary_en.core_problem: Text-to-image generation performance is highly sensitive to prompt formulation; existing prompt optimization methods rely solely on text-side rewriting or external rewards, lacking image-grounded diagnosis and reusable optimization policies
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; first closed-loop prompt-image-feedback self-rewarding framework for automatic text-to-image prompt optimization
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PRISM: first trains a unified VLM via multi-task SFT as a visual diagnoser, then optimizes prompt policies via self-rewarding with a hybrid ideal-point and Chebyshev reward, evaluating outputs on semantic consistency, aesthetic quality, and human preference alignment
summary_en.experiments: Abstract does not disclose specific model parameters or training data scale; only claims comprehensive improvements in overall image quality and fine-grained semantic alignment across extensive experiments

recommendation.zh: 自奖励+VLM的思路可迁移到LLM多模态后训练，但核心是文生图prompt优化，仅需了解核心机制即可
recommendation.en: The self-reward + VLM paradigm can be transferred to LLM multimodal post-training, but the core focus is text-to-image prompt optimization; only grasp the core mechanism

paper.title: Learning Sampling Parameters for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models expose many inference-time sampling parameters, including prompts, negative prompts, classifier-free guidance scales, and noise schedules. These parameters are typically manually chosen once and then held fixed across prompts and denoising timesteps, even though different prompts and stages of generation can benefit from different parameter values. We introduce LeSAMP, a framework for learning prompt-conditioned, timestep-varying sampling parameters. We formulate p

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像扩散模型采样参数长期依赖人工固定设置的问题，尤其是不同 prompt 和不同 denoising timestep 可能需要不同的 CFG、negative prompt 或 noise schedule。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成推理侧方法创新。它不改动底层扩散模型，而是把采样超参数变成可学习策略，说明生成质量的一部分瓶颈来自 inference-time control，而不只是模型权重或训练数据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LeSAMP，将采样参数选择建模为强化学习问题：给定用户 prompt，用一个大语言模型输出 prompt-conditioned、timestep-varying 的参数 schedule。训练信号来自 human preference model 和 VLM-as-a-judge，用偏好奖励优化该参数生成器。方法主要是把 LLM 作为采样控制器，而不是生成图像主体模型。
summary.experiments: 在 Flux.1 [dev] 和 Stable Diffusion 3.5 上评估。相对 baseline，LeSAMP 在 human preference score 下最高达到 68.12% win rate，在 VLM-as-a-judge 下最高达到 73.37% win rate。摘要还提到用户研究验证了收益，但未给出完整用户研究规模和统计细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fact that text-to-image diffusion samplers usually use manually fixed inference parameters, although different prompts and denoising stages may require different CFG scales, negative prompts, or noise schedules.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time method contribution for multimodal generation. It does not change the base diffusion model; instead, it treats sampler control as a learnable policy, suggesting that part of generation quality is gated by inference-time parameterization rather than model weights alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: LeSAMP formulates sampling-parameter selection as a reinforcement learning problem. Given a prompt, a large language model emits prompt-conditioned and timestep-varying schedules for selected sampler parameters. The controller is optimized with rewards from human preference models and VLM-as-a-judge signals.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on Flux.1 [dev] and Stable Diffusion 3.5. LeSAMP reaches up to 68.12% win rate under human preference scores and 73.37% under VLM-as-a-judge against baselines. The abstract also mentions validation through a user study, but does not provide full study details.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线；只看 learned sampler setup，作为“解码策略可学习化”的旁证即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the learned-sampler setup as weak evidence that decoding-time control can be learned.

paper.title: TILT: Improving Compositional Generation in Diffusion Models with a Model-Intrinsic Reward
paper.abstract: Recent advances in powerful text-to-image generation models have made it increasingly important to develop test-time methods that modify the sampling trajectory to produce images more faithful to complex compositional prompts. We present TILT, a training-free framework for compositional text-to-image generation via test-time reward alignment. We interpret compositional failures as overlap modes between joint and single-concept distributions, and define a reward that favors samples where all conc

summary.core_problem: 现有文本到图像扩散模型在复杂组合提示下的生成保真度差，现有测试时改进方法多依赖外部监督或独立奖励模型，部署成本高且泛化性有限。
summary.importance: 生成方法创新，提出训练无关的测试时组合生成优化框架，首次利用扩散模型自身的概念分布特性定义内在奖励，无需外部监督信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TILT框架，将组合生成失败解释为联合概念分布与单概念分布的重叠模式，定义倾向于所有概念同时存在的模型内在奖励，构建KL约束的优化目标，推导得到闭式倾斜目标分布与扩散采样引导步骤，并设计两种引导策略及混合平衡方案。
summary.experiments: 原摘要实验部分截断，仅提及混合引导策略在组合生成任务上取得更优性能，具体量化指标未披露。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-image diffusion models have poor generation fidelity under complex compositional prompts; existing test-time improvement methods mostly rely on external supervision or independent reward models, with high deployment cost and limited generalization.
summary_en.importance: Generation methodological innovation, proposes a training-free test-time compositional generation optimization framework, first defines intrinsic reward using the diffusion model's own concept distribution characteristics without external supervision signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents TILT framework, interprets compositional failures as overlap modes between joint concept distributions and single-concept distributions, defines a model-intrinsic reward favoring samples with all concepts jointly present, constructs a KL-constrained optimization objective to derive a closed-form tilted target distribution and guided diffusion sampling steps, and designs two guidance strategies plus a hybrid balancing scheme.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract is truncated; only confirms the hybrid guidance strategy achieves stronger performance on compositional generation tasks, specific quantitative metrics are not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 扩散图像生成的测试时内在奖励方法，对扩散LM的推理对齐设计有弱迁移启发，仅看核心方法逻辑即可。
recommendation.en: Test-time intrinsic reward method for diffusion image generation, has weak transfer inspiration for diffusion LM inference alignment design, only read core method logic section.

paper.title: Text Template Tokens Are Implicit Semantic Registers in Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion transformers (DiTs) jointly process text and image tokens, yet their internal computation during denoising remains poorly understood. We introduce a causal interpretability framework for modern large-scale DiTs that combines attention decomposition with targeted interventions across token spans, heads, and layers. Using it to separate prompt-content tokens from structural template tokens, we find that the structural tokens carry little prompt-specific information at the e

summary.core_problem: 揭示文生图扩散Transformer（DiT）中，文本模板token在去噪过程中的功能与语义传递机制
summary.importance: 跨模态Transformer可解释性研究，首次发现文本结构token作为隐式语义寄存器的非直观作用
summary.technical_approach: 构建因果可解释性框架，结合注意力分解与token/头/层定向干预，分离内容token与模板token的作用路径
summary.experiments: 在大规模DiT模型上验证，基于发现设计无训练剪枝规则，剪掉高注意力到模板token的头可保持生成质量

summary_en.core_problem: Reveals the function and semantic transfer mechanism of text template tokens during denoising in text-to-image Diffusion Transformers (DiTs).
summary_en.importance: A cross-modal Transformer interpretability study, first identifying the non-intuitive role of structural text tokens as implicit semantic registers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a causal interpretability framework combining attention decomposition and targeted interventions across tokens/heads/layers to disentangle the contribution of content vs template tokens.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on large-scale DiT models; the findings inspire a training-free pruning rule that removes heads heavily attending to template tokens while preserving generation quality.

recommendation.zh: DiT中寄存器token与语义流的发现可类比LLM的attention sink研究，只看§3机制分析即可，跳过剪枝部分
recommendation.en: The register token and semantic flow findings in DiT mirror LLM attention sink work; only read §3 mechanism analysis, skip the pruning part.

paper.title: Introspective Attention Modulation for Safe Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: State-of-the-art flow based text-to-image (T2I) models exhibit remarkable generative abilities but remain vulnerable to producing unsafe content. Prior safety efforts range from concept erasure and prompt filtering to classifier-based gating. However, simple techniques like parameter efficient adaptations of the models easily bypass such guardrails. We introduce a unique principled approach that achieves safety by regulating the model's attention dynamics through inference-time introspection, ex

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像生成模型在 unsafe content 上容易被 prompt 变体或参数高效适配绕过的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成安全方法。它关注部署阶段的安全控制，不是预训练方法，但 attention-space 干预对理解生成模型内部控制点有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Introspective Attention Modulation，在推理时分析并重平衡图像生成过程中的注意力激活，将生成轨迹从不安全概念上移开，同时尽量保持文本语义对齐和感知质量。方法不依赖外部 prompt filter 或单独 classifier gating。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和数值。作者声称在标准与对抗安全 benchmark 上获得较高安全分数，并保持或提升 alignment 与 perceptual quality。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles unsafe content generation in text-to-image models, especially cases where prompt filtering or adaptation-based guardrails can be bypassed.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation safety method. It is not a pretraining contribution, but attention-space intervention is a useful control point for understanding generative model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Introspective Attention Modulation analyzes and rebalances attention activations during inference, steering the synthesis trajectory away from unsafe concepts while preserving prompt alignment and perceptual quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific models, datasets, or numbers. It claims strong results on standard and adversarial safety benchmarks while maintaining or improving alignment and visual quality.

recommendation.zh: 扫一眼注意力干预机制即可；它对 T2I 安全有用，但对基座预训练只提供弱机制信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the attention-intervention mechanism only; it may matter for T2I safety, but it is a weak signal for foundation pretraining.

paper.title: Multi-Axis Max@K Reinforcement Learning for Representative Diversity in Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models can synthesize realistic, prompt-aligned images, yet samples generated for the same prompt often cover only a small subset of visually distinct modes. This limits the diversity of images, and for person-centric prompts, can reflect or amplify demographic skew. We formalize this problem as coverage of a predefined set of semantically specified modes, which we call target-mode coverage. We then propose multi-axis max@K, a group-based reinforcement learning objective for

summary.core_problem: 同一文本提示下，文生图扩散模型往往只覆盖少数视觉模式；论文要提高一组生成样本对预定义语义类别的覆盖度，尤其是人物提示中的人口属性多样性。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向生成多样性的强化学习目标，而不是新的基础模型架构。它把“多样性”从样本级平均得分改成组级模式覆盖，对理解生成模型后训练中的信用分配有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 multi-axis max@K。对同一 prompt 生成 K 个样本，并对每个目标类别计算分数；目标函数先在样本维度对每个类别取最大值，再对类别求和。这样只有当某个样本提高了某一类别的组内最大覆盖时，它才在该类别上获得正向权重，避免所有样本被推向同一个高分模式。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到先在合成任务上验证信用分配机制，再用于 diffusion-based T2I 模型的训练；核心对比应是常规奖励聚合或单样本奖励下的模式覆盖、多样性和 prompt alignment。摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Yutaka Matsuo 是东京大学松尾研究室负责人，团队长期做深度学习、LLM 应用和生成模型相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses mode under-coverage in text-to-image diffusion models, where multiple samples from the same prompt often represent only a narrow set of visually distinct semantic modes.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an RL objective for diversity-oriented generative model alignment. It is not a foundation-model pretraining result, but the group-level credit assignment idea is relevant to reward design for generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed multi-axis max@K objective generates a group of K samples per prompt, scores each sample against multiple target categories, takes the maximum score over samples for each category, and then sums those category-wise maxima. A sample receives positive credit only when it improves the group maximum for a category.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a synthetic validation of the credit-assignment mechanism and experiments on diffusion-based T2I models. It implies comparisons against standard reward aggregation or per-sample reward baselines, but does not provide model size, training scale, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Yutaka Matsuo leads the Matsuo Lab at the University of Tokyo, a group known for work on deep learning, LLM applications, and generative models.

recommendation.zh: 预训练侧不用细读；只看目标函数定义，作为“组级奖励避免模式坍缩”的一个小型可复用 trick。
recommendation.en: No need to read deeply for pretraining; inspect the objective as a compact example of group-level reward design against mode collapse.

paper.title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Boogu-Image-0.1, an open-source unified multimodal understanding and generation model family, comprising Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo variants. It delivers competitive performance in high-quality text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual (Chinese-English) text rendering. Closed-source multimodal systems like Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 achieve strong performance through system-level integration rather than a single model, yet their i

summary.core_problem: 在有限算力下，如何把开源统一多模态模型同时做成可理解、可生成、可编辑，并尽量逼近闭源图像生成系统的综合能力。
summary.importance: 这是一个统一多模态理解+生成系统工作，价值主要在工程 recipe 和系统整合，而不是新的基座预训练原理。对关注 AR+diffusion 联合建模、统一模态训练管线的人有边缘参考，但摘要里的“agentic inference-time scaling”更像系统技巧而非范式突破。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Boogu-Image-0.1 系列，包括 Base、Turbo、Edit、Edit-Turbo 变体，强调通过模型理解能力增强、数据质量改进、训练 pipeline 调整，以及推理时 agentic scaling 来提升文本生成图像、图像编辑和双语文字渲染表现。摘要没有给出清晰的统一建模细节，因此目前更像一个多组件系统集成，而不是可直接迁移到 LLM pretrain 的新目标函数或架构。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在标准 benchmark 上稳定匹配或超过其他开源模型，并接近领先闭源系统；覆盖高质量文生图、快速推理、指令编辑和中英双语文字渲染。摘要未提供模型规模、训练 token/image 数量、具体 baseline 和提升幅度，因此很难判断哪些收益来自数据、哪些来自 pipeline、哪些来自 inference tricks。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to build an open-source unified multimodal model that can understand, generate, and edit images under tight compute budgets while approaching closed-source systems.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a systems-and-recipe contribution for unified multimodal understanding and generation, not a new foundation-model pretraining principle. It has some peripheral relevance for people interested in unified AR+diffusion-style training pipelines, but the abstract reads more like integration work than a paradigm shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces the Boogu-Image-0.1 family—Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo—and attributes gains to better model understanding, improved data quality, training-pipeline refinements, and agentic inference-time scaling. The abstract does not reveal enough about the actual unified modeling mechanism, so at this stage it looks more like a multi-component system recipe than a transferable pretraining objective or architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The paper claims competitive or better performance than other open-source models across standard benchmarks, with results approaching strong closed-source systems, covering text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual text rendering. The abstract does not provide model size, training data scale, baselines, or exact deltas, making it hard to separate gains from data, training, and inference-time tricks.

recommendation.zh: 更像开源图像系统 recipe 汇总，不像会改变统一建模 prior 的论文；若你做 multimodal pretrain，只需看它如何拆分数据、训练和 inference trick 的贡献。
recommendation.en: This looks more like an open-source image-system recipe than a paper that changes priors on unified modeling; if you work on multimodal pretraining, only inspect how it attributes gains across data, training, and inference tricks.

paper.title: When T2I Synthetic Data Backfires: Amplified Privacy Risks in Real-Synthetic Mix Training
paper.abstract: To overcome data scarcity and privacy constraints in data collection, it has become standard practice across academia and industry to augment real training data with text-to-image (T2I)-generated synthetic data, a paradigm we term Real-Synthetic Mix-Training (RSMT). While substituting synthetic data for sensitive real samples is widely regarded as a means to mitigate privacy exposure of the substituted data, the risk to the remaining real samples that actively participate in training has remaine

summary.core_problem: T2I模型训练中普遍认为合成数据替代部分真实数据可降低隐私风险，但未被替换的剩余真实样本的隐私泄露风险未被系统研究。
summary.importance: 首次揭示真实-合成数据混合训练（RSMT）会放大剩余真实样本的隐私泄露，提出记忆放大理论框架和风险评估方法，挑战了“合成数据必然降低隐私风险”的直觉。
summary.technical_approach: 建立RSMT记忆放大理论框架，证明合成数据会将真实样本挤压到混合特征空间边缘，迫使模型更激进地记忆这些样本；基于该理论设计RSMixLeak成员推断攻击流程，量化隐私放大程度。
summary.experiments: 在T2I生成模型训练场景下验证了理论效应，显示混合合成数据后剩余真实样本的成员推断攻击成功率显著上升；摘要截断了具体模型、数据集和量化结果细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In text-to-image (T2I) model training, it is widely assumed that substituting part of real training data with synthetic samples reduces privacy risks, but privacy exposure of the remaining non-substituted real samples has not been systematically examined.
summary_en.importance: This work is the first to demonstrate that real-synthetic mix training (RSMT) amplifies privacy leakage of remaining real samples, proposes a theoretical memorization amplification framework to explain the effect, and introduces a corresponding risk assessment method, challenging the intuition that synthetic data universally reduces privacy risk.
summary_en.technical_approach: Develops the RSMT Memorization Amplification framework, proving synthetic data displaces real samples to peripheral regions of the mixed feature space, forcing models to memorize these outlying real samples more aggressively; designs RSMixLeak, a membership inference attack pipeline to systematically quantify amplified privacy risk.
summary_en.experiments: Validated in T2I generative model training setups, showing significantly higher membership inference success rates on remaining real samples after mixing in synthetic data; specific model, dataset, and quantitative details are truncated in the available abstract.

recommendation.zh: T2I场景下发现合成数据混合训练会放大真实样本记忆与隐私泄露，机制可能外溢到LM合成数据预训练，但无LM实验，知道结论即可，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Finds amplified real sample memorization when mixing T2I synthetic data, a mechanism potentially relevant to LLM synthetic data pretraining, but no LM experiments are included—just note the finding, no deep read needed.

paper.title: Improving Sample Diversity in Autoregressive Text-to-Image Generation via Cluster Truncation
paper.abstract: While diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art image quality for text-to-image (T2I) generation, recent work has demonstrated that they suffer from sample diversity collapse. In this work, we investigate whether autoregressive (AR) image generation models can push the Pareto frontier between image quality and sample diversity. With recent advances in quality and efficiency, AR models have emerged as a viable alternative to diffusion-based image generation. Beyond enabling new use cases such as

summary.core_problem: 自回归（AR）文生图模型的样本多样性缺乏系统研究，质量-多样性帕累托前沿仍有提升空间。
summary.importance: 首次系统研究AR文生图的样本多样性问题，提出簇截断解码方法改善质量-多样性权衡，属于多模态生成领域的增量方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 分析AR图像生成的两个核心特性（持续高token级熵、显著冗余），提出簇截断解码策略，在token嵌入空间聚类后截断低概率簇，在保持生成质量的同时提升样本多样性。
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，未给出完整模型参数量、训练数据和量化结果，仅提及基于现代AR图像生成模型开展实验，验证了方法在质量-多样性权衡上的提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Sample diversity in autoregressive text-to-image (T2I) models remains understudied, with room to improve the quality-diversity Pareto frontier.
summary_en.importance: First systematic study of sample diversity in AR image generation, with a cluster truncation decoding method to improve the quality-diversity tradeoff; incremental contribution in multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes two core properties of AR image generation (persistently high token-level entropy, significant redundancy) and proposes cluster truncation, a decoding strategy that truncates low-probability clusters in token embedding space to boost diversity while preserving quality.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; no full model size, training data, or quantitative results provided, only mentions experiments on modern AR T2I models validating improved quality-diversity tradeoff.

recommendation.zh: AR文生图的多样性解码改进，对理解AR范式的多样性问题有微弱参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Diversity decoding improvement for AR T2I with minor relevance to AR paradigm diversity understanding; abstract suffices.

paper.title: AutoAnchor: Stable Diffusion Unlearning Using Cross-Attention as a Manifold Surrogate
paper.abstract: Diffusion unlearning is essential for mitigating the generation of harmful or copyrighted content in text-to-image models. Current diffusion unlearning techniques determine the model update direction by either using alternatives of the target concept as an anchor or using empty prompts. The anchor-based method relies on manually and semantically-chosen anchors that risk biased unlearning, while the anchor-free method inherently suffers from unrobust unlearning due to unconstrained latent updates

summary.core_problem: 解决现有扩散模型遗忘方法中，手动语义anchor存在偏差、无anchor方法因潜空间更新无约束导致遗忘不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新+理论分析，首次在流形假设下形式化扩散遗忘的不稳定性成因，提出自动生成流形近邻anchor的两阶段框架，提升遗忘稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 先在流形假设下证明缺乏流形近邻anchor会导致显著法向空间漂移降低遗忘性能；再提出AutoAnchor：用交叉注意力图作为流形代理自动合成anchor，再基于anchor执行约束性遗忘更新。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像扩散模型上对比手动anchor与无anchor基线，验证AutoAnchor可在消除目标概念的同时减少对非目标内容的影响（具体指标摘要截断）。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses unstable unlearning in diffusion models: manual semantic anchor-based methods suffer from bias, while anchor-free methods cause unconstrained latent updates and degraded robustness.
summary_en.importance: Methodological and theoretical contribution; first formalizes diffusion unlearning instability under the manifold hypothesis, proposes a two-stage framework for automatic manifold-proximal anchor synthesis to improve unlearning stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: First proves under the manifold hypothesis that lack of manifold-proximal anchors induces significant normal-space drift harming unlearning; then proposes AutoAnchor: use cross-attention maps as manifold surrogate to synthesize anchors, then perform constrained unlearning updates.
summary_en.experiments: Compares with manual anchor and anchor-free baselines on text-to-image diffusion models, verifying AutoAnchor removes target concepts while minimizing impact on non-target content (full metrics truncated).

recommendation.zh: 做LLM对齐/模型遗忘的可参考其流形约束思路，但核心是图像扩散实验，仅看摘要和§2理论推导即可，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: For LLM alignment/unlearning researchers, the manifold constraint idea is referenceable; only read abstract and §2 theoretical derivation, no need for full text.

paper.title: Tree-of-Thoughts Reasoning for Text-to-Image In-Context Learning
paper.abstract: In text-to-image in-context learning (T2I-ICL), a model has to infer a latent compositional pattern from fewshot demonstrations for generating a query image. Recent studies show that state-of-the-art multimodal large language models struggle with this setting, particularly due to limited compositional reasoning and sensitivity to prompt construction. In this work, we propose a Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) reasoning framework for T2I-ICL that introduces a multi-stage reasoning and selection layer that

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态大模型在文生图上下文学习（T2I-ICL）场景下组合推理能力不足，对prompt构造敏感，易产生歧义与组合错误
summary.importance: 将已有的Tree-of-Thoughts多分支推理框架迁移到T2I-ICL任务，验证了结构化推理对多模态生成ICL的提升效果
summary.technical_approach: 提出ToT-T2IICL推理流水线，在构造最终生图prompt前，先生成多个候选推理假设，经过评估选择最优连贯解释后再输入图像生成模型，属于已有方法的任务迁移，无原创核心模块
summary.experiments: 在CoBSAT基准上开展定性定量评测，结构化多分支推理相比直接prompt基线提升了T2I-ICL的组合生成准确率，未涉及新模型训练或架构改动

summary_en.core_problem: State-of-the-art MLLMs suffer from limited compositional reasoning and high prompt sensitivity in text-to-image in-context learning settings, leading to ambiguity and compositional errors
summary_en.importance: Transfers the existing Tree-of-Thoughts multi-branch reasoning framework to T2I-ICL, verifying the benefit of structured reasoning for multimodal generative ICL
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ToT-T2IICL inference pipeline that generates, evaluates and selects the best coherent hypothesis from multiple candidates before constructing the final image generation prompt; this is a task transfer of existing methods with no novel core components
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on CoBSAT benchmark with qualitative and quantitative results showing multi-branch reasoning outperforms direct prompting baselines on compositional T2I-ICL accuracy; no new model training or architecture changes involved

recommendation.zh: 把已有ToT推理套用到T2I-ICL的增量工作，无新建模洞见，知道多分支推理能提升该任务效果即可，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Incremental work applying existing ToT to T2I-ICL with no new modeling insights; just note multi-branch reasoning helps this task, no need to read full paper

paper.title: AEGIS: A Mechanism-Guided Defense against Visual Synonym Jailbreaks in Text-to-Image Models
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved high visual fidelity and broad adoption, but remain vulnerable to safety violations when adversaries exploit them to synthesize illicit content. Existing alignment paradigms, from input sanitization to structural feature pruning, are largely organized around unsafe concepts explicitly exposed during filtering, editing, or localization. This leaves a blind spot for visual synonym attacks (VSA), a jailbreak where benign-looking prompts elicit prohibited

summary.core_problem: 解决文生图扩散模型中视觉同义词越狱（VSA）攻击的防御问题，现有静态防御存在安全-效用两难
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出机制引导的动态防御思路，填补了隐式视觉关联类越狱攻击的防御空白
summary.technical_approach: 放弃静态预定义不安全概念的过滤/剪枝思路，转而动态追踪生成过程中不安全语义的收敛过程，构建AEGIS框架在生成阶段抑制隐式不安全语义
summary.experiments: 摘要未提及具体模型参数量与数据集，baseline为现有输入过滤、结构特征剪枝等防御方法，核心效果为缓解VSA攻击的同时降低对良性内容的抑制

summary_en.core_problem: Address defense against visual synonym attacks (VSA) jailbreaks in text-to-image diffusion models, where existing static defenses face a safety-utility trade-off
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a mechanism-guided dynamic defense approach to fill the gap in defending implicit visual-association jailbreaks
summary_en.technical_approach: Abandon static predefined unsafe concept filtering/pruning, instead dynamically trace the convergence of unsafe semantics during generation, build AEGIS framework to suppress implicit unsafe semantics at generation stage
summary_en.experiments: No specific model size or dataset mentioned in abstract; baselines are existing input filtering, structural feature pruning defenses; core effect is mitigating VSA attacks while reducing suppression of benign content

recommendation.zh: 文生图领域的越狱防御思路，动态语义追踪的设计可作为LLM对齐防御的弱参考，仅看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Jailbreak defense for text-to-image models, dynamic semantic tracing design is a weak reference for LLM alignment, read abstract only.

paper.title: A Decomposable Probe for Few-Step Diffusion Models: Prompt, Latent, and Score Selectivity across Backbone Families and Distillation Paradigms
paper.abstract: Few-step distilled diffusion students cut text-to-image inference from ~50 to 1-8 network evaluations, but the quality gap is usually summarised by a single FID/CLIP scalar that cannot say which axis of the conditioning response changed, nor whether a behaviour comes from the architecture, the distillation objective, or simply from being a diffusion model. We replace the scalar with a decomposable probe that injects controlled perturbations along three layers (prompt encoder, denoiser input, den

summary.core_problem: 现有少步蒸馏扩散模型的质量评估仅依赖FID/CLIP等单标量指标，无法区分prompt编码器、去噪器输入、去噪器输出不同层的响应变化，也无法分离架构差异、蒸馏目标、扩散范式本身的影响。
summary.importance: 提出可分解的扩散模型能力探针方法，可定量测量不同网络层对扰动的选择性，首次在统一评估框架下跨23个模型、5个骨干家族、3类架构、5种蒸馏范式做系统性对比。
summary.technical_approach: 设计三层受控扰动注入方案：分别在prompt编码器输出、去噪器输入、去噪器输出三个位置施加均值/方差/尺度三种模式、六种强度的扰动，采用Inception特征上的bootstrap中位数Bures W2²选择性比作为量化指标。
summary.experiments: 覆盖23个模型：5个教师模型、18个蒸馏学生，包含SD1.5/SDXL/SD3.5/PixArt-alpha/FLUX骨干，跨UNet/DiT/MMDiT三类架构、5种蒸馏范式，实证发现三个层对应三个可独立分离的能力因子。

summary_en.core_problem: Quality evaluation of few-step distilled diffusion models relies on scalar metrics like FID/CLIP, which cannot disentangle response changes across the prompt encoder, denoiser input, and denoiser output, nor separate impacts of architecture, distillation objective, and diffusion paradigm.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a decomposable probe for diffusion models that quantitatively measures perturbation selectivity across network layers, enabling the first systematic controlled comparison across 23 models spanning 5 backbone families, 3 architecture classes, and 5 distillation paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Injects controlled perturbations at three layers (prompt encoder output, denoiser input, denoiser output) across three modes (mean, variance, scale) and six strengths, reporting a bootstrap-median Bures W2² selectivity ratio on Inception features as the quantitative metric.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 23 models (5 teachers, 18 distilled students) covering SD1.5/SDXL/SD3.5/PixArt-alpha/FLUX backbones, UNet/DiT/MMDiT architectures, and 5 distillation paradigms, finding three empirically separable capability factors corresponding to the three probed layers.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型分层扰动探针思路可迁移至文本扩散LM分析，无需通读全文，了解探针设计逻辑即可。
recommendation.en: The hierarchical perturbation probe design for diffusion models transfers to text diffusion LM analysis; skip the full text, just note the probe framework.

paper.title: The Illusion of High Utility in Safety Alignment of Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Safety alignment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models aims to suppress harmful generations while preserving utility on benign prompts. Recent methods often appear to deliver high safety with high utility, but this conclusion rests largely on coarse global utility metrics (e.g., FID, CLIPScore) that are insensitive to fine-grained semantic correctness, creating an illusion of high utility. We show that when utility is measured with structured evaluation, this illusion breaks: on TIFA (Text-to-

summary.core_problem: 研究文本到图像扩散模型的安全对齐是否真的能在抑制有害生成的同时保留正常提示词上的语义生成能力。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测与机制分析：指出常用的全局图像质量指标会高估安全对齐后的模型效用，细粒度语义一致性才暴露出真实损失。这对多模态生成模型的对齐评估有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 TIFA 这类结构化问答式图文一致性评估替代只看 FID、CLIPScore 的粗粒度指标，并分析文本编码器的 prompt embedding 空间。核心发现是安全对齐会造成 semantic collapse，即 embedding 分布收缩并扭曲不同 prompt 之间的相似性结构；论文还据此提出一个缓解策略，但摘要中方法名与细节被截断。
summary.experiments: 实验比较若干安全对齐后的 T2I diffusion 模型，在全局指标上看似保持较好效用，但在 TIFA 上出现明显语义保真度下降，错误集中在物体数量、属性和关系等细粒度维度。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据和具体数值提升。
summary.authors_note: Mubarak Shah 是视觉领域知名研究者，长期在视频理解和计算机视觉方向有代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether safety-aligned text-to-image diffusion models truly preserve benign-prompt utility while suppressing harmful generations.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is evaluative and diagnostic: coarse global metrics can make aligned T2I models look useful, while structured semantic evaluation reveals substantial utility loss. This is relevant to alignment evaluation for multimodal generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors replace reliance on FID and CLIPScore with structured TIFA-style question-answering evaluation for image-text faithfulness, then inspect the prompt embedding space of the text encoder. They identify semantic collapse: contracted embedding spread and distorted inter-prompt similarity structure. The abstract also mentions a mitigation method, but the provided text truncates its details.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare safety-aligned T2I diffusion models and show that global metrics can remain favorable while TIFA exposes semantic fidelity drops in object counts, attributes, and relations. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data details, or exact numerical deltas.
summary_en.authors_note: Mubarak Shah is a well-known computer vision researcher with long-running work in video understanding and visual recognition.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练不直接，但“安全对齐压缩语义空间”这个诊断值得记；只看 TIFA 结果和 embedding collapse 分析即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the semantic-collapse diagnosis is worth tracking; read the TIFA results and embedding-space analysis only.
