paper.title: EquiSteer: Cross-Attention Steering Towards a Fairer Text-Guided Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models power everyday creative tasks, but they still reproduce the demographic biases in their training data. On common prompts such as ``a photo of a nurse,'' ``a photo of a CEO'', they skew their outputs toward one gender, driven by the statistics of training data rather than anything in the text. Existing debiasing methods show promise in narrow settings but require retraining, batch-level control, or prompt-specific tuning, limiting their scalability. We propose \emph

summary.core_problem: 文生图扩散模型会复现训练数据中的人口统计偏见，现有去偏方法需重训练、批量控制或特定prompt调优，扩展性差。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需训练的推理时跨注意力引导去偏方案，兼容主流扩散模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 预计算对比prompt的目标属性引导向量，推理时通过prompt感知门控：对属性相关prompt不做处理，对中性prompt清除跨注意力激活中的属性信号并注入均衡目标属性。
summary.experiments: 在SD-1.5、SD-2.1、SDXL、SANA四款主流扩散模型上验证，摘要截断未公开具体 parity gap 降低幅度与基线对比细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Text-to-image diffusion models reproduce demographic biases from training data, while existing debiasing methods require retraining, batch-level control, or prompt-specific tuning, limiting scalability.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a training-free inference-time cross-attention steering debiasing method compatible with mainstream diffusion model architectures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Precomputes steering vectors for target attributes from contrastive prompts; at generation time, a prompt-aware gate leaves attribute-specific prompts untouched, while clearing existing attribute signals from cross-attention activations and injecting balanced target attributes for neutral prompts.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on four mainstream diffusion models: SD-1.5, SD-2.1, SDXL, and SANA; specific parity gap reduction values and baseline comparison details are unavailable due to abstract truncation.

recommendation.zh: 做多模态生成对齐的可参考其跨注意力操纵思路，其余方向无需投入阅读时间。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on multimodal generation alignment can reference its cross-attention manipulation idea, no need for others to spend time reading.

paper.title: UltraFlux: Data-Model Co-Design for High-quality Native 4K Text-to-Image Generation across Diverse Aspect Ratios
paper.abstract: Diffusion transformers have recently delivered strong text-to-image generation around 1K resolution, but we show that extending them to native 4K across diverse aspect ratios exposes a tightly coupled failure mode spanning positional encoding, VAE compression, and optimization. Tackling any of these factors in isolation leaves substantial quality on the table. We therefore take a data-model co-design view and introduce UltraFlux, a Flux-based DiT trained natively at 4K on MultiAspect-4K-1M, a 1M

summary.core_problem: 解决 DiT 类文本到图像模型从约 1K 分辨率扩展到原生 4K、多宽高比生成时的质量退化问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成中的数据-模型协同设计。它把 4K 生成失败归因于位置编码、VAE 压缩和优化目标的耦合，而不是单个模块的局部缺陷。对 LLM 预训练的间接价值在于高分辨率 token 网格下的位置外推、压缩瓶颈和梯度频段分配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UltraFlux，一个基于 Flux 的 4K DiT。数据侧构建 MultiAspect-4K-1M，包含 100 万张 4K 图像、多宽高比分布、双语 caption，以及 VLM/IQA 元数据用于分辨率和宽高比感知采样。模型侧结合 Resonance 2D RoPE 与 YaRN，处理训练窗口、频率和宽高比变化；用非对抗式 VAE 后训练提升 4K 重建；用 SNR-Aware Huber Wavelet objective 在扩散时间步和频率带之间重新平衡梯度。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数量、训练步数或定量指标。实验主张是在原生 4K、多宽高比文本到图像生成上，单独调整位置编码、VAE 或优化目标都不足，组合方案能保留更多质量。由于缺少完整数值，应把结论当作工程配方线索而非闭环证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets quality degradation when scaling DiT-style text-to-image models from roughly 1K resolution to native 4K generation across diverse aspect ratios.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a data-model co-design recipe for multimodal generation. It frames 4K failures as a coupled issue involving positional encoding, VAE compression, and optimization, rather than a single-module bug. For LLM pretraining researchers, the indirect value is in how long 2D token grids stress positional extrapolation, compression, and gradient allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: UltraFlux is a Flux-based DiT trained natively at 4K. The data side introduces MultiAspect-4K-1M, a one-million-image 4K corpus with controlled aspect-ratio coverage, bilingual captions, and VLM/IQA metadata for resolution- and aspect-ratio-aware sampling. The model side combines Resonance 2D RoPE with YaRN, a non-adversarial VAE post-training scheme, and an SNR-aware Huber wavelet objective to rebalance gradients across diffusion timesteps and frequency bands.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not report model size, training compute, or exact quantitative gains. The main empirical claim is that isolated fixes to positional encoding, VAE quality, or the loss leave substantial quality unused, while the combined recipe improves native 4K multi-aspect generation. Treat it as an engineering recipe unless the full paper provides clean ablations.

recommendation.zh: 只看位置编码和 loss ablation；4K DiT 的耦合失败对长网格建模有参考，但离 LLM pretrain 还有一层。
recommendation.en: Read only the positional-encoding and loss ablations; the 4K DiT failure mode is relevant to long-grid modeling, but one step removed from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Quality-Aware Modulation for Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Modern text-to-image diffusion models, such as diffusion transformers (DiT), rely on timestep or prompt embeddings to modulate the strength of the denoising process in each timestep. While this modulation communicates the current noise level, it does not provide any quality-aware information, which can lead to generated images that are unaligned, visually inconsistent, and lacking in fidelity. In this paper, we propose the Quality Representation Module (QRM), a lightweight transformer module tha

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图扩散Transformer（DiT）仅依赖时间步或提示嵌入调制去噪过程，缺乏质量感知信号，导致生成图像对齐差、一致性弱、保真度不足
summary.importance: 多模态生成领域的方法创新，提出轻量质量感知调制模块，无需改动扩散骨干与采样调度即可提升生成质量
summary.technical_approach: 提出质量表示模块（QRM），基于DiT现有输入学习质量感知向量M_qrm，用其调整Transformer块内的自适应LayerNorm调制，注入质量敏感信号；模块参数量小，不修改主干结构与采样流程
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未披露具体模型规模、训练数据集及基准指标提升幅度，仅提及完成QRM损失函数、架构消融，验证了生成质量的一致性提升

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-image Diffusion Transformers (DiT) only use timestep or prompt embeddings to modulate denoising, lacking quality-aware signals, resulting in misaligned, inconsistent, and low-fidelity generated images
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation in multimodal generation; a lightweight quality-aware modulation module that improves output quality without modifying the diffusion backbone or sampling schedule
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Quality Representation Module (QRM) that learns quality-aware vectors M_qrm from existing DiT inputs, which adjust adaptive LayerNorm modulation inside Transformer blocks to inject quality-sensitive signals; minimal parameter overhead, no changes to backbone or sampling pipeline
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale, training dataset, or benchmark metric gains are disclosed in the provided abstract; only reports QRM loss/architecture ablations and consistent generation quality improvements

recommendation.zh: DiT块调制的增量改进，对多模态统一建模的条件注入有弱参考，仅看方法章节的调制设计即可
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement to DiT block modulation; weak reference for conditional injection in unified multimodal modeling, only check the modulation design in method section

paper.title: Mural: Transferring LLM knowledge to image generation via Mixture-of-Transformers
paper.abstract: Leveraging capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in text-to-image (T2I) synthesis is an important research direction. In this work we investigate whether the knowledge of a frozen LLM can be effectively utilized in T2I generation when trained exclusively on standard text-image pairs. We integrate a frozen, reasoning-capable LLM with a diffusion-based image generator via shared attention within the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our experiments span two critical questions: (1)

summary.core_problem: Mural 研究的是一个很具体的问题：在不更新 LLM、不使用交错图文数据、不加入推理监督或额外 caption 数据的条件下，冻结 LLM 的语言知识能否通过结构接口迁移到文本生成图像模型中。它把变量控制在架构层面，重点考察 shared attention 是否足以让 diffusion 图像分支访问 LLM 的表示与知识。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在统一多模态建模接口。它没有选择全参数联合训练，也没有依赖复杂 multimodal data mixture，而是把冻结 LLM 当作稳定的知识源，用可训练图像专家接入每层共享注意力。这个设定的价值在于分离了三个因素：LLM 知识、图像生成训练数据、跨模态交互结构。结果显示，仅用标准 text-image pairs 训练，模型仍出现跨语言生成、颜色引导、emoji/ASCII 场景组合、世界知识引导生成等能力。这说明冻结语言模型中的表示可以通过注意力通道被生成分支利用，而不一定要靠全模型联合更新。对基座研究而言，它提供了一条更轻量的 multimodal expansion 路径：保留语言能力，把新模态能力接到已有 LLM 上，而不是重新调一个复杂混合预训练配方。
summary.technical_approach: Mural 使用 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构。文本 tokens 走冻结的 Qwen2.5 或 Qwen2.5-VL 主干；图像 tokens 来自 VAE latent，由一个可训练的 diffusion image expert 处理。每一层中，图像分支有自己的 layer norm、Q/K/V/O projection、QK norm 和 FFN，隐藏维度与 LLM 对齐。文本和图像 tokens 先经过各自模态的投影，然后拼接在一起做 shared self-attention，注意力完成后再回到各自的 FFN。这样做的关键取舍是：共享 attention 负责跨模态信息流动，模态专属 FFN 和投影负责保持各自分布；LLM 参数冻结，避免语言能力被图像训练破坏。与 DiT/UViT 这类独立图像生成 Transformer 不同，Mural 的图像分支每层都能读取冻结 LLM 的上下文表示。与 Chameleon、Transfusion、BAGEL 这类联合训练路线相比，它不需要更新语言主干，也不需要复杂的交错多模态序列或 CoT 监督来维持语言与生成能力。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕两个问题展开：冻结 LLM 的知识是否可被图像生成分支访问，以及这种访问是否带来训练数据中没有显式监督的能力。模型在 GenEval 上达到 0.85，在 DPG-Bench 上达到 86.75，在 WISE 上达到 0.66。论文还用相同数据和 recipe 训练 dense baseline，结果显示 MoT 结构相对 dense 模型有稳定提升，说明收益不是来自数据或训练技巧的差异。规模实验覆盖 1.5B、3B、7B LLM，并比较纯文本 LLM 与 vision-language backbone 初始化；结果指出 multimodal initialization 在小规模下能加快收敛。能力分析包括跨语言 prompt、颜色控制、emoji/ASCII 到场景生成、依赖常识或世界知识的生成，这些能力未通过专门任务数据训练，因而更能支持 shared attention 迁移 LLM 知识的结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 joint multimodal training 与 frozen-LLM 路线的对比，这决定了论文问题的边界。Framework 部分要看 MoT 的逐层结构，尤其是图像 expert 的 QKV/O projection、QK norm、FFN 与 shared attention 的连接方式。实验部分优先看 controlled dense baseline、不同 LLM scale 的收敛曲线、Qwen2.5 与 Qwen2.5-VL 初始化对比，以及 emergent capability 的 qualitative examples。真正值得深挖的是消融设计：如果 dense baseline 与 Mural 只差共享注意力结构，那么性能和新能力的差异才更能说明架构接口的作用。

summary_en.core_problem: Mural asks whether a frozen LLM can transfer useful knowledge to text-to-image generation when the image generator is trained only on standard text-image pairs. The paper deliberately removes several confounders: no LLM parameter updates, no interleaved multimodal sequences, no reasoning supervision, and no extra image-to-text captioning data. The central mechanism under test is shared attention in a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is the interface between pretrained language models and new generative modalities. Instead of jointly retraining a multimodal foundation model with a delicate data mixture, Mural keeps the language model fixed and attaches a trainable diffusion image expert at every layer. This makes the experiment useful for pretraining research because it separates LLM knowledge, image-pair supervision, and cross-modal communication. The observed behaviors, including cross-lingual generation, color guidance, emoji or ASCII scene composition, and world-knowledge-guided generation, suggest that a frozen LLM can serve as an active representational prior for image generation through attention. This is a practical route for extending an existing LLM into a multimodal generator while preserving its language capability by construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model uses a Mixture-of-Transformers design. Text tokens are processed by a frozen Qwen2.5 or Qwen2.5-VL backbone. Image tokens are VAE latent tokens handled by a trainable diffusion expert. At each Transformer layer, the image branch has its own layer norms, Q/K/V/O projections, QK norms, and feed-forward network, with hidden dimensions matched to the LLM. Modality-specific projections are applied first; then text and image tokens are concatenated for shared self-attention; after attention, tokens are routed back to modality-specific FFNs. The design assigns cross-modal communication to attention while leaving modality-specific computation to separate experts. Compared with standalone DiT or UViT generators, the image branch can access LLM representations at every layer. Compared with joint multimodal training systems such as Chameleon, Transfusion, or BAGEL-style recipes, the LLM is not updated and the training data remains ordinary text-image pairs.
summary_en.experiments: The reported benchmark scores are 0.85 on GenEval, 86.75 on DPG-Bench, and 0.66 on WISE. The key controlled comparison is against a dense baseline trained with the same data and recipe; Mural improves over that baseline, making the architectural contribution easier to isolate. The scaling study covers 1.5B, 3B, and 7B frozen backbones, including both text-only and vision-language initializations. The paper reports that multimodal initialization accelerates convergence at smaller scales. The qualitative analysis is important: cross-lingual prompts, color control, emoji and ASCII scene composition, and world-knowledge-based prompts work without task-specific supervision. These examples support the claim that the image expert is not only learning dataset correlations, but is also using information exposed by the frozen LLM through shared attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the motivation contrasting joint multimodal training and frozen-LLM methods. Then read the framework section carefully, especially the per-layer MoT routing, the image expert components, and the shared-attention computation. In the experiments, focus on the dense baseline comparison, the scaling curves across 1.5B/3B/7B backbones, the Qwen2.5 versus Qwen2.5-VL initialization comparison, and the qualitative capability analysis. The most important details are the controlled ablations that isolate shared attention from data and recipe effects.

recommendation.zh: 看 MoT 共享注意力怎么接冻结 LLM；“训练外能力”先按弱证据处理，重点查数据控制和消融。
recommendation.en: Read the MoT shared-attention interface to a frozen LLM; treat the claimed out-of-training abilities as weak until the data controls and ablations are inspected.

paper.title: SciIR: A Large-scale Training Dataset and Benchmark for Scientific Image Reasoning Generation
paper.abstract: While Text-to-Image (T2I) models have shown remarkable success in generating photorealistic visual content, they still struggle with the rigorous semantic alignment and logical reasoning required for scientific imagery. Inspired by Peirce's Semiotic Triad, we introduce Scientific Image Reasoning (SciIR), a comprehensive resource for training and evaluation of scientific image generation. We formalize scientific reasoning into three core dimensions: Entity Structure (Icon), Scientific Process (In

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像模型在科学图像生成中语义对齐不足、科学过程和规律表达不稳定的问题，同时缓解科学图文训练数据稀缺。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成数据资源和评测资源。SciIR-82k 提供 8 万余高质量科学图文对，SciIR-Bench 提供科学图像推理生成评测；对通用 LLM 预训练不是核心，但对多模态生成数据构造和视觉推理标注形式有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法受 Peirce 符号三元组启发，把科学图像推理拆成 Entity Structure/Icon、Scientific Process/Index、Scientific Law/Symbol 三个维度。数据集从前沿论文中构建科学图文对，并加入 Scientific Reasoning Chain-of-Thought，用显式推理链描述图像背后的视觉逻辑。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确给出 SciIR-82k 规模超过 80,000 对科学 image-text pairs，并提到 SciIR-Bench；未给出训练模型规模、baseline、自动指标、人评指标或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of generating scientific images with rigorous semantic alignment, scientific process consistency, and law-level reasoning, while also tackling the lack of scientific image-text data.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal-generation dataset and benchmark contribution. SciIR-82k provides over 80K scientific image-text pairs, and SciIR-Bench targets scientific image reasoning generation. It is not central to LLM pretraining, but it is useful as a reference for structured multimodal data construction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Peirce's semiotic triad, the paper decomposes scientific image reasoning into Entity Structure/Icon, Scientific Process/Index, and Scientific Law/Symbol. It builds scientific image-text pairs from recent publications and augments them with Scientific Reasoning Chain-of-Thought annotations to expose the visual logic behind the image.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports more than 80,000 high-quality scientific image-text pairs and introduces SciIR-Bench. It does not provide model sizes, baseline details, metric values, or improvement numbers in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据构造和评测维度；Sci-RCoT 是否真提升生成模型，得看消融而不是概念框架。
recommendation.en: Skim the data schema and evaluation axes; whether Sci-RCoT actually helps needs ablations, not the semiotic framing.

paper.title: Qwen-Image-Agent: Bridging the Context Gap in Real-World Image Generation
paper.abstract: While text-to-image (T2I) models have achieved remarkable progress, they struggle with real-world requests that are often underspecified, implicit, or dependent on up-to-date knowledge. We identify this challenge as the Context Gap: the mismatch between the user context and the sufficient generation context for T2I models. To bridge this gap, we propose Qwen-Image-Agent, a unified agentic framework that integrates plan, reason, search, memory and feedback in a context-centric manner. Qwen-Image-

summary.core_problem: 真实场景下文生图请求常存在信息缺失、隐含意图或依赖时效性知识，现有文生图模型训练依赖完整明确的prompt，零散的图像生成agent模块缺乏统一框架，且无系统的agent图像生成能力评测基准。
summary.importance: 明确的Context Gap定义厘清了文生图从可控渲染走向实用落地的核心矛盾；上下文驱动的多模块协同agent范式，为统一多模态（生成类优先）agent的推理/训练流程设计提供参考；IA-Bench可用于探测多模态预训练模型在agent场景下的能力边界，反哺预训练数据构成与目标函数的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出无需训练、兼容现有文生图模型的Qwen-Image-Agent统一框架，核心分为两大模块：1）上下文感知规划，分三层运作：信息层识别缺失上下文并路由对应获取策略，内容层整合已获取的上下文生成详细生成规范，生成层适配多图/多轮交互的上下文分配；2）上下文锚定，从四类来源补全缺失信息：推理挖掘隐含意图、搜索获取时效性事实与视觉参考、记忆调取历史交互与个性化信息、反馈支持迭代优化。同步构建IA-Bench评测基准，覆盖17类真实任务、730个测试样例、1801项细粒度检查项，从规划、推理、搜索、记忆四个维度评测agent图像生成能力，配套结构化VLM评测协议。
summary.experiments: 在IA-Bench、WISE-Verified、MindBench三类基准上，Qwen-Image-Agent表现优于现有强agent基线；消融实验验证了不同来源的补全上下文存在互补效应，去除任意一类上下文均会导致整体性能下降。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读引言中Context Gap的定义与问题 framing、第2章两大核心模块的设计逻辑、IA-Bench的评测维度与构建原则；跳过具体单任务的prompt示例与交互案例细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Real-world text-to-image (T2I) requests are often underspecified, carry implicit user intents, or rely on time-sensitive knowledge, creating a mismatch between user-provided context and the complete generation context T2I models require. Existing fragmented image generation agent components lack a unified design framework, and no systematic benchmark exists for evaluating agentic image generation capabilities.
summary_en.importance: The formalized Context Gap definition clarifies the core barrier for moving T2I systems from controlled prompt rendering to real-world deployment. The context-centric multi-module agent paradigm provides a reference for designing inference/training pipelines of unified multimodal (especially generation-focused) agents. The proposed IA-Bench can also probe the capability boundary of multimodal pretrained models in agent scenarios, informing pretraining data composition and objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Qwen-Image-Agent, a training-free framework compatible with off-the-shelf T2I models, built on two core modules: 1) Context-Aware Planning, operating at three layers: the information layer identifies missing context and routes to appropriate acquisition strategies, the content layer assembles grounded context into detailed generation specifications, the generation layer allocates context for multi-image/multi-turn scenarios; 2) Context Grounding, which retrieves missing information from four sources: reasoning for implicit intent inference, search for time-sensitive facts and visual references, memory for historical interaction and personalized preferences, and feedback for iterative refinement. Also introduces IA-Bench, a benchmark covering 17 real-world tasks, 730 test instances, and 1801 fine-grained checklist items, evaluating agent capabilities across planning, reasoning, search, and memory, paired with a structured VLM-based evaluation protocol.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen-Image-Agent outperforms strong agentic baselines on IA-Bench, WISE-Verified, and MindBench. Ablation studies confirm complementary effects across different context sources: removing any single source of grounded context leads to measurable performance degradation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the Context Gap definition and problem framing in the introduction, the design logic of the two core framework modules in Section 2, and the evaluation dimensions and construction principles of IA-Bench. Skip detailed prompt examples and per-task interaction case details; estimated reading time is 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 头部机构做的图像生成 agent，知道它在重写任务接口就够了；若你做预训练，只需看 benchmark 设计和上下文补全过程。
recommendation.en: A major-lab image-generation agent paper; for pretraining, it is enough to inspect the benchmark design and how context is constructed before generation.

paper.title: ARIA: Adaptive Region-Based Importance Allocation for Conditional Diffusion Distillation
paper.abstract: Distilling conditional diffusion models aims to transfer the behavior of a large teacher to a smaller student while preserving alignment across conditioning inputs. Unlike recognition tasks, knowledge distillation in conditional diffusion often struggles to transfer knowledge beyond the training distribution, since the predicted noise strongly depends on the conditioning signal. As a result, effective distillation requires exploring a large conditioning space. In practical settings, this creates

summary.core_problem: 条件扩散模型蒸馏中，条件空间巨大且配对数据有限，学生模型难以在训练分布外保持与教师的条件对齐。
summary.importance: 多模态生成模型蒸馏方向的方法改进，对统一多模态预训练中的扩散侧效率优化有有限参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ARIA（Adaptive Region-Based Importance Allocation）：在条件切换扩充条件空间的基础上，引入基于区域的自适应重要性分配，聚焦蒸馏中条件对齐更关键的区域与条件样本。
summary.experiments: 针对条件扩散蒸馏场景，在文本到图像等条件生成任务上对比条件切换等基线，ARIA在分布外条件对齐与样本质量上取得提升；具体模型规模与数据量未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: In conditional diffusion distillation, the conditioning space is huge while paired data is limited, making it hard for the student to preserve alignment with the teacher outside the training distribution.
summary_en.importance: A methodological improvement in multimodal generative model distillation, with limited reference value for diffusion-side efficiency in unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ARIA (Adaptive Region-Based Importance Allocation): building on condition-switching to expand the conditioning space, it introduces region-wise adaptive importance allocation to focus on regions and conditioning samples that are more critical for conditional alignment during distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on conditional diffusion distillation settings including text-to-image; compared with condition-switching baselines, ARIA improves out-of-distribution conditional alignment and sample quality. Exact model sizes and dataset sizes are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 条件扩散蒸馏的增量改进，与文本LLM预训练无关，做多模态统一建模的人可扫一眼方法部分。
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement in conditional diffusion distillation; unrelated to text LLM pretraining, only skim the method section if working on unified multimodal modeling.

paper.title: SeFi-Image: A Text-to-Image Foundation Model with Semantic-First Diffusion
paper.abstract: Training image generation foundation models consumes substantial resources. Previous methods have attempted to leverage semantic guidance to accelerate the training process, yet their experiments were only conducted on simple datasets such as ImageNet, at low resolutions, and with small-scale models. In this paper, we propose SeFi-Image, a text-to-image foundation model built upon semantic-first diffusion, a novel latent diffusion modeling paradigm. We instantiate SeFi-Image at three model scale

summary.core_problem: 解决文生图基础模型训练成本过高的问题，尝试用 semantic-first diffusion 在较低训练算力下保持生成质量。
summary.importance: 贡献属于多模态生成中的训练范式与工程规模推进。它不是 LLM 文本预训练论文，但对统一生成建模、AR+diffusion 联合路线和大规模生成模型的 compute efficiency 有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 semantic-first diffusion 这一潜空间扩散建模范式，并实例化为 SeFi-Image 1B/2B/5B 三个规模。核心主张是先建模高层语义，再细化视觉细节，从而提升训练效率并改善 scaling 行为。
summary.experiments: 论文声称训练了 1B、2B、5B 三档模型，其中 5B 仅用约 125K A800 GPU 小时，约为 Z-Image 训练算力的 10%-20%，但在 GenEval、DPG 等多项基准上达到与 Qwen-Image、Z-Image 可比甚至更好的结果。摘要未给出训练数据规模与更细的 ablation，因此结论还需看正文中的对照是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者署名为 SeFi-Team，摘要未明确给出机构与已知代表作者，暂无法确认团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the high training cost of text-to-image foundation models by using semantic-first diffusion to retain quality under a much smaller compute budget.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation paper with implications for training paradigms and engineering efficiency. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is still relevant if you care about unified generative modeling and compute-efficient large-scale training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes semantic-first diffusion, a latent diffusion paradigm that prioritizes high-level semantic modeling before visual detail refinement, and instantiates it as SeFi-Image at 1B, 2B, and 5B scales.
summary_en.experiments: The paper claims 1B/2B/5B models, with the 5B version trained in about 125K A800 GPU hours, roughly 10-20% of the compute reportedly used by Z-Image, while achieving comparable or better results on benchmarks such as GenEval and DPG versus Qwen-Image and Z-Image. The abstract does not specify dataset scale or the cleanliness of ablations, so the strength of the claim depends on the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list is given as SeFi-Team, and the abstract does not clearly identify the institution or well-known authors.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 unified generative pretrain，可只看训练算力账本和 scaling 段落；结论有吸引力，但先确认数据、分辨率和 baseline 是否对齐。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim only if you care about unified generative pretraining; check the compute accounting and scaling sections first, because the headline depends heavily on data, resolution, and baseline alignment.

paper.title: STAR: SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward Allocation for Text-to-Image RL Post-Training
paper.abstract: Existing RL post-training methods for text-to-image generation usually convert the final-image reward into a single scalar advantage and apply it with the same strength to the entire generative trajectory. However, text-to-image generation naturally has temporal and spatial structure: different denoising steps are responsible for different generation stages, and the content that truly determines text alignment often appears only in part of the image. This granularity mismatch makes it difficult

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像扩散/flow模型RL后训练中的奖励分配过粗问题：最终图像奖励被压成单一标量后，无法区分哪些去噪步和哪些图像区域真正影响了文本对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型后训练方法改进。它把RL credit assignment从整条生成轨迹的统一优势值，细化到时间步和空间区域，对扩散类生成模型的训练信号质量有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward Allocation。方法利用生成模型内部的文本-图像注意力，从prompt中的核心内容出发，构造随去噪时间步和rollout动态变化的空间奖励分配图，把最终奖励按时空结构分配到更相关的生成组件上，而不是对所有denoising step施加同等强度更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据、baseline名称和数值提升。可确认实验对象覆盖文本到图像diffusion和flow模型，目标是提升RL post-training后的文本对齐和生成质量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses coarse reward assignment in RL post-training for text-to-image diffusion and flow models, where a final-image reward is collapsed into one scalar advantage and applied uniformly to all denoising steps and image regions.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution for generative-model post-training. Its main value is a finer credit-assignment scheme over both time and space, which is relevant to the quality of RL signals in diffusion-style generators.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed STAR method uses internal text-image attention to identify prompt-relevant content, builds spatial allocation maps that vary across denoising steps and rollouts, and redistributes the final reward toward the generative components most responsible for text alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, training data, concrete baselines, or numerical gains. It states that the method targets text-to-image diffusion and flow models and evaluates RL post-training for alignment-sensitive generation.

recommendation.zh: 对LLM预训练不是主线；只需看reward时空分配设计，可能迁移到diffusion LM或多模态生成RL。
recommendation.en: Not central for LLM pretraining; skim the spatiotemporal credit assignment, which may transfer to diffusion LMs or multimodal RL.

paper.title: RepFusion: Leveraging Multimodal Priors for Denoising in Representation Space
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used in text-to-image (T2I) systems, but they are typically limited to text encoding, while denoising is handled by newly trained generative backbones. The emergence of representation autoencoders (RAEs) shifts the generation target toward semantically structured visual representations, creating a latent space that is more compatible with pretrained LLM priors. Inspired by multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), where an MLP projector is sufficient to align clean visual

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像生成中，如何把预训练多模态/语言模型的表征先验真正用于去噪主干，而不只停留在文本编码侧的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于多模态生成方法创新：它尝试把 MLLM 从条件编码器扩展为噪声表征编码器，检验预训练语义表征是否能替代部分新训练 denoiser 容量。对统一建模和跨模态预训练有间接启发，但不是 LLM 预训练核心论文。
summary.technical_approach: 论文建立在 representation autoencoder 设定上，把生成目标从像素 latent 转到更语义化的视觉表征空间；受 MLLM 中 projector 对齐 clean visual representation 的启发，作者将 MLLM 直接复用为 noisy representation encoder，再把其输出作为 diffusion transformer 的条件信号。核心主张是：预训练 MLLM 已含有足够强的多模态先验，可在 denoising 阶段继续发挥作用，而不必完全依赖新初始化的去噪网络学习。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在相近推理预算下，RepFusion 优于把相当容量分配给新初始化 denoiser 的基线；但未给出模型参数、训练数据规模、具体 FID/GenEval 等指标幅度。可读性主要取决于正文是否做了干净的 capacity matching 和 inference-budget matching。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Saining Xie，通常与 NYU/FAIR 体系的视觉与生成建模工作相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to use pretrained multimodal/LLM priors for the denoising stage of text-to-image generation, rather than limiting them to text encoding.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation method paper. Its main value is testing whether pretrained semantic priors from MLLMs can substitute for part of a newly trained denoiser. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but it does touch unified representation learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on representation autoencoders, the method shifts the generation target toward semantically structured visual representations. Inspired by the fact that MLLMs can align clean visual representations with a lightweight projector, the paper repurposes the MLLM itself as a noisy representation encoder and feeds its outputs as conditioning into a diffusion transformer. The core claim is that pretrained MLLMs carry denoising-relevant priors, not just text-conditioning priors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims gains over baselines that allocate similar capacity to newly initialized denoisers under comparable inference budgets, but gives no model sizes, data scale, or exact metric improvements. The paper is worth checking only if the capacity and budget matching are clean.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Saining Xie, typically associated with strong vision and generative modeling work from the NYU/FAIR ecosystem.

recommendation.zh: 对做统一预训练的人有一点味道：看它是否真把“预训练表征可做去噪器”做成了 clean ablation；若 capacity match 不严，这个结论只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Mildly interesting for unified pretraining: check whether the paper cleanly shows pretrained representations can act as denoisers; if the capacity matching is loose, treat the claim as weak evidence.

paper.title: HPSv3++: Scaling Reward Models Across the Full Spectrum of Diffusion Model Capabilities
paper.abstract: Reward models guide text-to-image (T2I) systems toward outputs aligned with human preferences. However, typical reward models such as HPSv3 are trained on pre-annotated data from earlier T2I models, without accounting for quality discriminative shifts arising from evolving model capabilities and reinforcement learning (RL) iterations, limiting their broader applicability. In this work, we propose HPSv3++, a reward model framework that elevates the HPSv3 model for varying T2I model capabilities a

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图 reward model 多在旧模型输出上训练，面对更强生成器和 RL 迭代后的样本分布时判别能力会漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成对齐中的 reward modeling 数据与训练框架。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对“reward model 随基座能力和 RL 迭代失配”的问题有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HPSv3++ 框架，并构建 HPDv3++，一个 21.2 万规模的双维度偏好数据集，分别标注文本一致性和审美质量。训练上采用两阶段方案：第一阶段用 data-aware orthogonal gradient projection 吸收新数据中的审美偏好，同时尽量保留原 HPSv3 的人类偏好能力；第二阶段面向不同 T2I 模型能力和 RL 迭代阶段做适配。
summary.experiments: 数据标注以较强的 Qwen-Image 生成结果为基础，并有人类监督；摘要强调覆盖模型能力和 RL iteration 的完整谱系，但未给出具体 reward model 规模、基线列表、RL 提升幅度或人评胜率数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing text-to-image reward models are often trained on outputs from older generators and can lose discrimination when generator capability and RL iteration distributions shift.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes a preference dataset and reward-model training framework for image-generation alignment. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to reward-model robustness under changing model distributions.
summary_en.technical_approach: HPSv3++ introduces HPDv3++, a 212K dual-axis preference dataset covering text fidelity and aesthetic quality. The training recipe uses a two-stage design, including data-aware orthogonal gradient projection to absorb new aesthetic signals while preserving useful human-preference behavior from HPSv3.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset is built around outputs from a high-capability Qwen-Image model with human supervision. The abstract claims coverage across capability levels and RL iterations, but does not expose model size, detailed baselines, win rates, or downstream RL gains.

recommendation.zh: 可只看数据构造和梯度投影部分；它提示 reward model 会随生成器能力漂移，但证据强度要看完整人评设置。
recommendation.en: Skim the dataset construction and gradient-projection recipe; the useful signal is reward-model drift across generator capability, but the human-eval setup will decide how much to trust it.

paper.title: Bridging Modal Isolation in Interleaved Thinking: Supervising Modality Transitions via Stepwise Reinforcement
paper.abstract: Interleaved thinking, where a unified multimodal model alternates between textual reasoning and visual generation, has shown promise on spatial and physical tasks. However, in complex long-chain scenarios, we identify a fundamental failure mode: generated images diverge from the textual context while subsequent text ignores the visual evidence, causing the two modalities to alternate without genuinely informing each other. We term this Modal Isolation and attribute it to compounding information

summary.core_problem: 解决统一多模态模型在“文字推理—图像生成—再文字推理”长链过程中，两种模态表面交替但信息没有真正互相约束的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态推理训练方法与失效模式分析。论文把这种失败定义为 Modal Isolation，并把问题定位到模态边界处的信息损失，而不是单纯的文本推理或图像生成质量不足。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MoTiF，两阶段优化模态转换质量。第一阶段 Reflective SFT 让模型识别并修复错误视觉输出；第二阶段用 Flow-GRPO 强化图像生成对文本上下文的忠实度。论文还定义 modality transition loss，用于分别度量 text-to-image 的跨模态幻觉和 image-to-text 的视觉证据利用不足。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升数值。实验重点应是复杂长链空间/物理任务中，比较普通 interleaved thinking 模型与 MoTiF 在模态边界错误累积、图像忠实度、后续文本利用视觉证据方面的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a failure mode in unified multimodal reasoning where text and generated images alternate, but neither modality reliably conditions the next step.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training and diagnostic framework for interleaved multimodal reasoning. It names the failure as Modal Isolation and attributes it to information loss at modality boundaries rather than only weak text reasoning or weak image generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MoTiF optimizes modality transitions in two stages. Reflective SFT trains the model to detect and recover from bad visual outputs, while Flow-GRPO improves image-generation fidelity to the textual context. A modality transition loss decomposes text-to-image hallucination and image-to-text visual utilization deficit at each boundary.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report parameter counts, data scale, or numeric gains. The expected experimental focus is long-chain spatial and physical reasoning, comparing standard interleaved models against MoTiF on boundary-level error accumulation, visual fidelity, and downstream text use of visual evidence.

recommendation.zh: 只看失效定义和 transition loss 设计；它把多模态 CoT 的瓶颈从“单步生成”移到“边界信息守恒”。
recommendation.en: Read the failure definition and transition-loss design; the useful shift is from single-step generation quality to information conservation across modality boundaries.

paper.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models contain rich spatial priors. Synthesizing photorealistic, cluttered scenes requires an understanding of geometry, including perspective and relative scale. Prior works adapt T2I models to leverage this prior for depth prediction, but they require dense depth data and involve complex recipes. We propose Modality Forcing, a simple, scalable post-training recipe for joint image-depth generation using a single DiT trained on sparse depth data. Modality Forcing enables cond

summary.core_problem: 如何利用文本到图像（T2I）模型的空间先验，通过简单的后训练配方实现可扩展的图像和深度联合生成？
summary.importance: 提出Modality Forcing，一种简单且可扩展的后训练方法，仅需稀疏深度数据即可在单个DiT上实现图像和深度的联合生成，避免了以往方法对密集深度数据的依赖和复杂的训练流程。
summary.technical_approach: 通过为每种模态分配独立的噪声水平（Modality Forcing），实现图像和深度在任意排列下的条件和联合生成。使用每种模态的解码器，允许在稀疏的真实世界深度数据上进行训练。通过从头训练一系列T2I模型（370M到3.3B），验证了该方法继承了T2I预训练的可扩展性。
summary.experiments: 训练了370M到3.3B参数的模型，发现更大的模型在更多图像数据上训练能产生更准确的深度。最强模型在深度预测上具有竞争力。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自CMU、Google DeepMind等，Deva Ramanan和Justin Johnson是计算机视觉领域的知名学者。

summary_en.core_problem: How to leverage the spatial priors of Text-to-Image (T2I) models for scalable joint image and depth generation using a simple post-training recipe?
summary_en.importance: Proposes Modality Forcing, a simple and scalable post-training method enabling joint image and depth generation on a single DiT using only sparse depth data, avoiding the reliance on dense depth data and complex pipelines of prior methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Enables conditional and joint generation of image and depth in any permutation by assigning separate noise levels per modality (Modality Forcing). Per-modality decoders allow training on sparse, real-world depth data. Validates that the method inherits T2I pre-training scalability by training a suite of T2I models from scratch (370M to 3.3B).
summary_en.experiments: Trained models from 370M to 3.3B parameters, finding larger models trained on more image data produce more accurate depth. The strongest model is competitive in depth prediction.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from CMU, Google DeepMind, etc. Deva Ramanan and Justin Johnson are well-known scholars in computer vision.

recommendation.zh: 通过独立噪声调度实现多模态（图像+深度）联合生成的后训练方法，对多模态 Diffusion 建模有一定启发，但偏向 CV 任务。
recommendation.en: A post-training method achieving multimodal (image+depth) joint generation via independent noise scheduling, offering some inspiration for multimodal Diffusion modeling, but leans towards CV tasks.

paper.title: The Geometry of Phase Transitions in Generative Dynamics via Projection Caustics
paper.abstract: Continuous-state generative samplers, including diffusion and flow-matching models, evolve through continuous reverse-time dynamics, yet their samples often undergo abrupt qualitative changes: trajectories commit to modes, semantic alternatives collapse, and small perturbations in narrow time windows can produce large downstream effects. This paper develops a geometric account of such phase-transition-like behaviour. We view denoising as gradient descent on a free energy landscape and show that

summary.core_problem: 解释 diffusion 和 flow-matching 采样轨迹中为何会出现突然的模式承诺、语义分支坍缩和窄时间窗敏感性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成动力学的几何分析和诊断工具：它把连续反向采样中的突变现象联系到 projection caustics，并提出可定位敏感时间窗的 Critical Boundary Detector；对研究 diffusion LM 或统一 AR+diffusion 建模的人有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 denoising 看作自由能景观上的梯度下降，认为当到数据支撑集的最近点投影不再唯一时，会形成 projection caustics，从而产生相变式行为。基于这个几何视角，提出 CBD，用 score direction instability 作为实用诊断信号，定位 mode commitment 和可控干预窗口。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 toy models、标准 diffusion models 和 latent text-to-image diffusion models。结果显示 CBD 能定位模式承诺阶段、预测对干预敏感的时间窗，并支持在几何敏感区域进行 targeted control。摘要未给出具体模型规模或量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why continuous diffusion and flow-matching samplers can show abrupt mode commitment, semantic collapse, and narrow intervention-sensitive time windows.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a geometric account of generative dynamics plus a diagnostic tool. It is indirectly relevant to pretraining researchers interested in diffusion language models or hybrid AR-diffusion generation, but the experiments are mainly continuous and image-generation oriented.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors view denoising as gradient descent on a free-energy landscape and attribute sharp transitions to projection caustics, where nearest-point projection onto the data support becomes non-unique. They introduce the Critical Boundary Detector, which diagnoses score-direction instability and identifies sensitive regions along the trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on toy settings, standard diffusion models, and latent text-to-image diffusion models. CBD localizes mode-commitment events, predicts intervention-sensitive windows, and supports targeted control in geometrically sensitive regions. The abstract does not provide model scale or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 diffusion dynamics 直觉材料看摘要和 CBD 图即可；离离散 LM 还有距离，不应直接外推到 MDLM/LLaDA。
recommendation.en: Use it as intuition for diffusion dynamics and skim the CBD figures; do not directly transfer the claims to MDLM or LLaDA-style discrete LMs.

paper.title: PathRelax: Parallel-Path Relaxed Speculative Jacobi Decoding for Accelerating Auto-Regressive Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: The growing need for high-resolution image generation in autoregressive text-to-image models has resulted in extended token sequences, significantly increasing computational costs and inference times. However, existing state-of-the-art methods for accelerating autoregressive text-to-image models rely on chain-structured draft token sequences, leading to inefficient draft token search and limited acceptance lengths. To address this, we propose parallel-path cross-relaxed speculative Jacobi decodi

summary.core_problem: 现有自回归文生图模型的推理加速方法受限于链式草稿结构，早期token被拒绝会导致后续所有草稿失效，接受长度短、加速比低；同时现有松弛验证仅考虑单token相似度，忽略草稿分支间的语义依赖。
summary.importance: 多路径树状结构+跨路径语义聚合的推测解码优化思路可推广到统一多模态基座离散token生成等长序列AR建模的推理加速场景，无需额外训练草稿模型的自推测方向也能降低大模型部署的额外成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PathSpec加速框架，包含两个核心设计：一是PathExplore，将线性链式草稿扩展为多序列树状结构，多个候选token序列并行生成并联合验证，单分支被拒绝不影响其他分支，缓解链式丢弃问题；二是PathRelax跨路径松弛验证，通过跨路径概率聚合建立语义相关分支的关联，利用语义邻居的接受结果提升整体接受率，扩展松弛空间。
summary.experiments: 在Lumina-mGPT上测试，无松弛的PathExplore平均接受长度是原有SJD方法的3.06倍；完整PathSpec框架在不同模型上至少提升20%的推理效率，同时不损失图像生成质量。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言部分对现有自推测解码局限性的分析、多路径树状草稿和跨路径松弛的核心设计，预计阅读时间12分钟，无需深入推导验证概率公式，重点理解对长序列AR解码的通用优化思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing acceleration methods for autoregressive text-to-image generation are limited by chain-structured draft sequences, where rejection of an early token invalidates all subsequent drafts, leading to short acceptance lengths and low speedup ratios. Existing relaxed verification also only considers single-token similarity, ignoring semantic dependencies across draft branches.
summary_en.importance: The multi-path tree structure and cross-path semantic aggregation design for speculative decoding can be generalized to inference acceleration of long-sequence AR modeling, including discrete token generation in unified multimodal foundation models. The draft-model-free self-speculative optimization direction also reduces additional deployment overhead for large models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The PathSpec acceleration framework includes two core components: PathExplore, which extends linear chain drafts to a multi-sequence tree structure, where multiple candidate token sequences are generated in parallel and jointly verified, so rejection of one branch does not affect others, mitigating cascading discard issues; PathRelax cross-path relaxed verification, which builds associations between semantically related branches via cross-path probability aggregation, uses acceptance results of semantic neighbors to improve overall acceptance rate and expand the relaxation space.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Lumina-mGPT, PathExplore without relaxation achieves 3.06x higher average acceptance length than the original SJD method. The full PathSpec framework improves inference efficiency by at least 20% across different models without degrading image generation quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of limitations of existing self-speculative decoding in the Introduction, and the core design of multi-path tree drafts and cross-path relaxation. Estimated reading time is 12 minutes; no need to dive into verification probability derivations, focus on the general optimization ideas for long-sequence AR decoding.

recommendation.zh: 将推测解码（Speculative Decoding）应用于自回归图像生成，通过并行多路径和语义放松验证提升接受率，对关注多模态 AR 模型推理优化的研究员有参考价值，重点看 PathRelax 的设计。
recommendation.en: Applies Speculative Decoding to autoregressive image generation, improving acceptance rates through parallel multi-paths and semantic relaxed verification. Valuable for researchers focusing on inference optimization of multimodal AR models; focus on the design of PathRelax.

paper.title: Beyond Scalar Rewards by Internalizing Reasoning into Score Distributions
paper.abstract: Reward models are central to text-to-image post-training, but visual preference is subjective and better represented as a distribution over rubric scores than as a deterministic scalar. Existing scalar, score-token, and pairwise reward models over-compress uncertainty and fine-grained score differences, while reasoning-based generative rewards provide stronger judgments but are costly to deploy and difficult to use as direct optimization signals. We propose Z-Reward, a teacher-student reward mod

summary.core_problem: 文本到图像后训练中的奖励建模问题：现有标量/分数token/成对奖励模型过度压缩了不确定性和细粒度分数差异，而基于推理的生成式奖励部署成本高且难以直接优化。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出将推理内化到分数分布中的奖励建模范式（Z-Reward），而非传统的标量奖励；核心贡献是分布化奖励表示 + 师生蒸馏框架。
summary.technical_approach: Z-Reward采用师生框架：Teacher是大VLM，使用推理推断符合评分标准的分数分布，通过Group-wise Direct Score Optimization（GDSO）训练，结合分布期望的策略梯度奖励与分数分布和分差的直接监督；Student通过Reasoning-Internalized Score Distillation（RISD）迁移Teacher的推理能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要被截断，实验细节未完整展示。从方法描述看，核心贡献在于框架设计，实验结果未在摘要中给出具体数字。
summary.authors_note: Ming-Ming Cheng（南开大学），团队在多模态和图像领域有积累。

summary_en.core_problem: Reward modeling in text-to-image post-training: existing scalar/score-token/pairwise reward models over-compress uncertainty and fine-grained score differences, while reasoning-based generative rewards are costly to deploy and hard to use as direct optimization signals.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes Z-Reward, a teacher-student reward modeling framework that internalizes reasoning into score distributions, departing from traditional scalar reward paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Z-Reward decouples reasoning-heavy judgment from efficient deployment via teacher-student distillation. Teacher VLM infers rubric-aligned score distributions using reasoning, trained with Group-wise Direct Score Optimization (GDSO) combining policy-gradient from distribution expectations with direct pointwise/pairwise supervision. Student transfers via Reasoning-Internalized Score Distillation (RISD).
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; full experimental results not available. Core contribution lies in framework design; concrete metrics not provided in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Ming-Ming Cheng (Nankai University); group has background in multimodal and image research.

recommendation.zh: 分布化奖励替代标量奖励的思路对LLM RLHF有微弱启发，但核心是图像生成领域，不直接影响LLM预训练；看摘要即可，不必读正文。
recommendation.en: Distributional reward as replacement for scalar rewards has weak relevance to LLM RLHF, but the work is rooted in image generation; read abstract only, skip full paper.

paper.title: Do Models Share Safety Representations? Cross-Model Steering for Safe Visual Generation
paper.abstract: Recent progress in generative modeling has made safety control a central challenge, yet existing approaches remain largely model-specific, requiring retraining or tailored interventions for each new architecture. In this work, we ask whether safety can be represented as a portable latent direction, learned once and reused across heterogeneous generators. We introduce the first framework for cross-model safety steering, in which a safety direction is estimated in a source LLM from paired safe-uns

summary.core_problem: 安全对齐/安全控制能否作为“可移植的表征方向”在不同生成模型间迁移，而不是每个模型单独重训或单独做干预？
summary.importance: 把“steering direction/representation geometry”从单模型扩展到跨模型迁移，并强调目标模型侧不接触 unsafe 数据；对安全对齐与表示可迁移性有启发，但更偏推理期控制与对齐工程，不是预训练核心。
summary.technical_approach: 在源 LLM 上用 safe/unsafe prompt 对估计安全方向；用仅含 benign 数据的轻量对齐把该方向映射到目标生成模型的表示空间；推理时沿该方向做 steering。扩展为多向量以做类别级安全控制。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 text-to-image 等生成器的跨模型安全 steering；强调目标侧不使用 unsafe 数据以隔离“共享几何”假设（摘要未给出具体模型/数据/指标与幅度）。
summary.authors_note: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia; University of Pisa; AImageLab

summary_en.core_problem: Can safety control be represented as a portable latent direction that transfers across heterogeneous generative models, instead of being model-specific?
summary_en.importance: Extends steering/representation-geometry ideas to cross-model transfer while keeping the target side free of unsafe data; useful for thinking about alignment transferability, though it is mainly inference-time control rather than pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Estimate a safety direction in a source LLM from paired safe/unsafe prompts; learn a lightweight alignment on benign data to transport the direction into a target generator’s representation space; apply steering at inference. Add a multi-vector variant for category-specific control.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on text-to-image and other generators with the constraint of no unsafe data on the target side (abstract omits concrete models/metrics/gains).
summary_en.authors_note: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia; University of Pisa; AImageLab

recommendation.zh: 值得当“安全表征是否共享”的弱信号：关键看它的对齐映射是否真能跨架构稳定工作，否则容易是 prompt/数据分布巧合。
recommendation.en: A weak-but-interesting signal on whether safety representations are shared; focus on whether the cross-architecture alignment is stable, not a prompt/distribution coincidence.

institutions: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia

paper.title: Qwen-Image-Flash: Beyond Objective Design
paper.abstract: Few-step distillation has become an effective strategy for accelerating advanced visual generative models, yet prior work has largely focused on distillation objectives. In this work, we revisit few-step distillation from a complementary perspective, focusing on the training recipe that critically shapes student performance. Using Qwen-Image-2.0 as a representative case, we systematically investigate three factors in unified text-to-image generation and instruction-guided image editing distillat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究大视觉生成模型做 few-step distillation 时，为什么只改蒸馏目标不够，以及数据组成、教师选择、任务混合怎样影响 4-step 学生模型的质量。
summary.importance: 它和 LLM 基座预训练不是一条主线，但对大模型训练闭环有参考价值。视觉生成模型的蒸馏类似语言模型里的 teacher-student 压缩和 post-train 数据配方问题：目标函数只是训练信号的一部分，数据分布、教师能力边界、任务比例会显著改变学生模型学到什么。对统一多模态模型而言，这类经验有用，因为未来图像生成、图像编辑、文本渲染等能力很可能要通过蒸馏或持续训练压进更低延迟的模型。
summary.technical_approach: 作者以 Qwen-Image-2.0 为教师体系，采用 Flow Matching 和 DMD 作为基础蒸馏框架。Flow Matching 学习从噪声到数据的速度场；DMD 把多步教师压缩到少步学生，学生 Gθ 从噪声和条件生成 clean sample，再加噪到中间时间，与教师在 noisy state 上的分布或方向信号对齐。论文重点不在重新设计 DMD，而是在 recipe 上做系统分析。第一，研究 T2I 蒸馏数据组成，发现更多样或更贴近目标的数据并不必然更好，单一类别但分布更一致的数据反而可能有较好迁移。第二，研究多教师指导。不同教师在文本生成、编辑、一般图像质量等任务上有互补能力，但直接混合可能不稳定；作者提出 step-wise multi-teacher guidance，让不同教师在训练或采样步骤上分工，以利用各自优势并减小冲突。第三，研究 T2I 和 instruction-guided editing 的联合蒸馏比例，发现任务混合比例对统一模型性能影响很大，较平衡的 T2I:Edit 配比更稳。
summary.experiments: 核心结果是 Qwen-Image-Flash，一个同时支持文本到图像生成和指令式图像编辑的少步模型，推理时 NFE 降到 4。实验观察比单个最终分数更有信息量：T2I 数据规模、类别多样性、目标域相似度和最终质量不是简单单调关系；互补教师的知识迁移需要调度策略，否则容易互相干扰；联合 T2I-editing 蒸馏中，偏向任一任务都会损害统一表现，平衡配比更好。提供内容没有完整 benchmark 数字、人工偏好分数或消融表，因此只能确认这些定性趋势和 NFE=4 的效率设定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–25 分钟。熟悉 Flow Matching 和 DMD 的读者可以快速跳过 Preliminaries。重点看三组 recipe 实验：T2I data composition、multi-teacher guidance、T2I/Edit task mixture。Figure 2 的失败案例和后续消融表比模型展示图更重要。关注点不应只是 Qwen-Image-Flash 的样例质量，而是哪些训练配方结论可迁移到其他大生成模型蒸馏，例如数据一致性是否比多样性更关键、教师能力冲突如何被调度、任务比例如何避免一种能力覆盖另一种能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why objective design alone is insufficient for few-step distillation of advanced visual generative models, and how data composition, teacher guidance, and task mixture determine the quality of a 4-step student.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the training loop around large foundation models. The lesson transfers to teacher-student compression and post-training data recipes: the loss function is only one part of the training signal, while the data distribution, teacher capability profile, and task ratio can strongly shape what the student retains. For unified multimodal systems, this matters because image generation, image editing, and text rendering capabilities will often need to be distilled into lower-latency models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work uses Qwen-Image-2.0 as the representative teacher system and builds on Flow Matching plus DMD. Flow Matching learns a velocity field along a path between data and noise. DMD distills a multi-step teacher into a few-step conditional student generator: the student maps noise and condition to a clean sample, the sample is perturbed to an intermediate noisy state, and the student distribution is aligned with the teacher signal at that state. The paper’s main contribution is not a new distillation loss, but a recipe study. It analyzes T2I data composition and finds that more diversity or more target-specific data does not necessarily improve the student; coherent data from a single category can transfer surprisingly well. It then studies multi-teacher guidance. Teachers with complementary strengths are not trivial to combine, because naive mixing can create unstable or conflicting supervision. The proposed step-wise multi-teacher guidance assigns teacher influence across steps to exploit task-specific strengths while maintaining stability. Finally, it studies joint T2I and instruction-guided editing distillation, showing that the T2I-to-editing ratio is a key control knob and that a balanced mixture gives better unified behavior.
summary_en.experiments: The resulting model, Qwen-Image-Flash, supports both text-to-image generation and instruction-guided image editing with NFE reduced to 4. The most useful experimental results are the recipe findings rather than a single headline score. T2I distillation does not improve monotonically with data diversity, data volume, or apparent target-domain match. Complementary teachers require a scheduling strategy to avoid interference. In joint T2I-editing distillation, over-weighting either task hurts the unified model, while a balanced T2I:Edit mixture works better. The provided content does not include the complete benchmark tables, human preference numbers, or exact ablation values, so the reliable takeaways are the qualitative trends and the 4-step inference setting.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes 15–25 minutes. Readers already familiar with Flow Matching and DMD can move quickly through the preliminaries. The important parts are the three recipe studies: T2I data composition, step-wise multi-teacher guidance, and the T2I/Edit mixture. The failure case around Figure 2 and the ablation tables are more informative than the model showcase images. The transferable questions are whether data coherence can matter more than diversity, how to schedule teachers with conflicting strengths, and how to mix tasks without letting one capability overwrite another.

recommendation.zh: 训练 recipe 对少步蒸馏的影响可能和目标设计同等重要，这对 diffusion LLM / 统一多模态模型的快推理蒸馏有直接借鉴，关注 Section 4 的消融表格。
recommendation.en: Training recipe can matter as much as objective design in few-step distillation — directly transferable to diffusion LLM / unified multimodal distillation; focus on the ablation tables in Section 4.

paper.title: Drifting Preference Optimization for One-Step Generative Models
paper.abstract: One-step text-to-image generators are attractive for deployment because they generate an image with a single forward pass, but preference finetuning them remains difficult: standard alignment methods often rely on policy likelihoods, denoising trajectories, differentiable reward gradients, or test-time optimization. We propose Drifting Preference Optimization (DrPO), an online preference-finetuning method for deterministic one-step generators. For each prompt, DrPO samples candidates from the cu

summary.core_problem: 单步文本到图像生成器的偏好微调困难：标准对齐方法依赖策略似然、去噪轨迹、可微奖励梯度或测试时优化
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出了DrPO——一种在线偏好微调方法，适用于确定性单步生成器，不需要可微奖励
summary.technical_approach: DrPO对每个prompt采样候选图像，用目标奖励排序，利用高低分样本合成特征空间更新方向（非参数偶极子偏好场+参考漂移），通过分离的特征空间回归目标优化
summary.experiments: 摘要中部分被截断，提到了针对单步生成器的评估，具体基线和提升幅度未详述
summary.authors_note: 西湖大学、香港中文大学，作者包括Zhou Jiang, Yandong Wen, Zhen Liu

summary_en.core_problem: Preference finetuning of one-step text-to-image generators is challenging because standard alignment methods require policy likelihoods, denoising trajectories, differentiable rewards, or test-time optimization
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes DrPO, an online preference-finetuning method for deterministic one-step generators that works with black-box/non-differentiable rewards
summary_en.technical_approach: DrPO samples candidates per prompt, ranks them with target reward, and synthesizes feature-space update direction using high/low samples; combines non-parametric dipole preference field with reference drift; optimized via detached feature-space regression target
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; evaluation mentioned for one-step generators but specific baselines and improvement magnitudes not detailed
summary_en.authors_note: Westlake University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong; authors include Zhou Jiang, Yandong Wen, Zhen Liu

recommendation.zh: 偏好优化思路对LLM后训练有微弱启发（无梯度DPO类方法），但应用在图像生成领域，摘要被截断难以评估贡献质量，作为弱信号参考
recommendation.en: Preference optimization approach has marginal relevance to LLM post-training (gradient-free DPO-like methods) but is applied to image generation; abstract truncated making contribution quality hard to assess; weak signal only

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Alignment-Guided Score Matching for Text-to-Image Alignment in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models generate highly realistic images but often struggle with precise text-image alignment. While recent post-training methods improve alignment using external rewards or human preference signals, their performance heavily depends on reward quality and does not directly address alignment within the diffusion process itself. Recent reward-free approaches such as SoftREPA demonstrate that optimizing soft text tokens via contrastive learning can effectively improve text-image representa

summary.core_problem: 文本到图像扩散模型虽然生成质量高，但仍容易在计数、属性绑定和组合语义上出现文本-图像不对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个 reward-free 的扩散模型后训练方法，把对齐信号直接写入 score matching 目标；对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但对“无奖励模型的对齐训练”有类比价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 soft text token 优化的基础上，把 contrastive alignment guidance 融入扩散模型的 score-matching objective。它试图避免 SoftREPA 这类纯对比学习方法对负样本惩罚过强的问题，从扩散过程内部调整对齐方向，而不是依赖外部 reward 或人类偏好模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模或量化指标。它声称该方法是轻量级后训练方法，并针对 SoftREPA 的 over-counting 与 repetition 等失败模式做改进。

summary_en.core_problem: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate realistic images but still fail on precise text-image alignment, especially counting, attribute binding, and compositional semantics.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a reward-free diffusion post-training method that injects alignment guidance into the score-matching objective. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant as an analogy for alignment without external reward models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Building on soft text token optimization, the paper integrates contrastive alignment guidance directly into the diffusion score-matching objective. The goal is to avoid the overly strong negative-pair penalty of methods such as SoftREPA and to steer alignment from within the diffusion process rather than through external rewards or human preference models.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, data scale, or concrete quantitative gains. It claims a lightweight post-training setup and focuses on failure modes such as over-counting and repetition observed in SoftREPA-style contrastive alignment.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 abstract 和目标函数；有价值的是“把对齐方向并入生成 loss”，但图像扩散结论不能直接外推到 LM。
recommendation.en: Skim the abstract and objective; the useful bit is folding alignment direction into the generative loss, but the diffusion-image result should not be projected onto LMs.

paper.title: Orthogonal Negative Guidance in Attention Feature Space for Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) models have become increasingly capable of generating high-quality images. Yet, enforcing the explicit absence of a specified object or attribute remains a fundamentally challenging problem. Existing approaches, including prompt negation, post-hoc editing, and negative guidance, remain insufficient for explicit concept suppression, often failing to remove the target concept or degrading overall image quality. To this end, we propose Orthogonal Negative Guidance in attention f

summary.core_problem: 解决文生图模型难以明确“不要生成某个物体或属性”的问题，同时避免负向提示破坏整体图像质量和语义对齐。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型推理控制方法：在 MM-DiT 文生图 transformer 的 attention feature space 中做训练免费负向引导。对预训练研究的价值有限，但对理解 diffusion transformer 中条件特征的可操作性有一点参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 negative prompt 的 attention output 特征相对 positive prompt 特征做正交化，只减去与正向语义正交的负向成分；这样试图压制不想要的概念，同时保留正向 prompt 的语义和图像质量。属于训练免费 inference-time guidance。
summary.experiments: 实验在 FLUX-dev 和 FLUX-schnell 上进行，比较概念抑制、prompt alignment 和图像质量的 trade-off；摘要提到 human evaluation 显示更好的权衡，但未提供具体数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses explicit concept suppression in text-to-image generation: making a model avoid a specified object or attribute without degrading the desired image content.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time control method for generative models. It operates in the attention feature space of MM-DiT text-to-image transformers. It is not a pretraining paper, but it offers a useful view of how conditional features can be manipulated inside diffusion transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Orthogonal Negative Guidance orthogonalizes negative-prompt attention features against positive-prompt features and subtracts only the orthogonal component. This is meant to remove unwanted concepts while preserving positive-prompt semantics, with no additional training.
summary_en.experiments: The method is tested on FLUX-dev and FLUX-schnell. The evaluation focuses on the trade-off among concept suppression, prompt alignment, and image quality, with human evaluation mentioned but no detailed numbers in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和特征正交化设定；这是推理期控制技巧，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and feature-orthogonalization setup; this is an inference-time control trick, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Qwen-Image-Bench: From Generation to Creation in Text-to-Image Evaluation
paper.abstract: Text-to-Image generation has evolved from basic image synthesis into a frequently used core capability in professional creative workflows, where simple text-image alignment can no longer satisfy users' pressing demands for faithful real-world reconstruction and genuine creative expression. Existing benchmarks, however, remain anchored in these foundational criteria and do not yet capture the nuanced capabilities that matter in authentic artistic practice, making it difficult to reliably distingu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“再做一个文生图榜单”，而是现有 T2I 评测已经难以区分前沿模型，且评测目标与真实创作流程脱节。全文把问题拆成两层：一是传统 benchmark 主要看文本对齐、通用画质、CLIP 类相似度，面对新一代生产级模型时区分度明显下降；二是专业创作者真正关心的能力——真实世界还原与创意生成——缺少结构化定义，也缺少以专业人类标准为中心的评测协议。作者因此提出一个 creator-centric benchmark，试图把“生成是否像”扩展为“是否忠于世界、是否具备创作能力、是否符合专业工作流中的审美与表达要求”。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于训练方法，而在于评测目标的重定义。它提醒文生图模型的上限不再只是 prompt following，而是更细的世界知识、文字渲染、文化与物理一致性、视觉叙事和风格控制。对预训练研究员来说，这会反过来影响数据配比、文本编码器设计、奖励模型监督来源，以及是否需要把“创作工作流中的能力”显式纳入训练与评测闭环。贡献量级属于中等偏上：不是提出新生成模型，而是试图把评测坐标系从通用感知指标拉回到真实创作需求，并对“单一 MLLM judge 充当标准答案”的做法提出了较具体的质疑。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 benchmark 设计，而不是新模型。全文强调三点。第一，评测 taxonomy 不是平铺罗列维度，而是按专业创作流程自上而下设计，围绕 Real-world Fidelity、Creative Generation，以及传统的 Quality、Aesthetics、Text-Image Alignment 五个主轴展开，再细化到更贴近创作者需求的子维度，如 World Knowledge、Text Rendering、Visual Storytelling 等。第二，数据构建采用 1000 条 expert-crafted structured prompts，并通过严格过滤与分层采样保证覆盖面和评测效率。这里的“structured”很关键，意味着 prompt 不是随意自然语言，而是围绕可评测能力进行约束式设计，以减少不同维度互相污染。第三，评测立场上明显反对把未校准的 MLLM judge 当作唯一标准。作者在引言中点名一些近期工作直接用 Gemini 等模型输出做监督，认为这会把 judge 的系统偏差固化进 reward model 或 benchmark 分数。Qwen-Image-Bench 因而强调与专业艺术家共建 taxonomy 和标注标准，试图让评测更接近专业人类判断，而不是模型互评。就方法取舍而言，它没有走“更大规模自动化合成题库”的路线，而是选择较小规模、强结构、专家参与的高密度 benchmark，这更像高信噪比诊断集，而不是覆盖一切的排行榜数据池。
summary.experiments: 从已给出的全文内容看，最重要的实验目标是验证新 benchmark 的判别力和与专业人类判断的一致性，而不是追求样本规模。可确认的硬信息包括：benchmark 含 1000 个结构化 prompt，采用三级 taxonomy，覆盖五个主轴，并强调 Real-world Fidelity 与 Creative Generation 两类过去较弱的能力。引言明确声称现有 benchmark 在强模型上出现分数压缩和 benchmark drift，而新基准旨在更好地区分 production-grade 模型。摘要片段与引言没有给出完整的模型排名、相关系数或 judge-human agreement 数字，因此不能编造具体提升幅度。阅读全文时应重点核对三类结果：一是不同前沿模型在五大主轴及子维度上的分布，是否真的拉开差距；二是专家标注与自动 judge 的一致性，尤其是创意类维度；三是与旧 benchmark 的相关性和失配案例，看看作者所谓 drift 是否有足够实证支撑。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 taxonomy 设计部分，确认作者到底如何定义 Real-world Fidelity 与 Creative Generation，这决定了 benchmark 是否站得住。然后看数据构建流程，重点关注 structured prompt 的模板化方式、分层采样规则、专家参与深度，以及如何避免不同维度混杂。最后看评测协议与人类一致性实验，尤其是作者如何处理 MLLM judge 的偏差问题。如果时间有限，优先看图 1、taxonomy 总表、数据构建章节和 human-vs-judge 对比表。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主线；若要判断其是否能指导训练数据和 reward 设计，再细看失败案例与维度定义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not trying to add yet another T2I leaderboard. Its target is a more structural issue: current text-to-image benchmarks no longer separate frontier models well, and their evaluation targets are misaligned with real creative workflows. The full text frames this as a two-part gap. First, most existing benchmarks still emphasize prompt alignment, generic visual quality, and CLIP-like similarity, which are increasingly saturated for production-grade models. Second, capabilities that matter to professional creators—faithful reconstruction of the real world and genuine creative generation—are poorly defined and weakly supervised in current evaluation setups. Qwen-Image-Bench is proposed to shift evaluation from “does the image match the prompt” toward “does it respect reality, support creation, and meet the standards of expert artistic practice.”
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model researchers is mainly on the evaluation side, not on model training. The paper argues that T2I progress is now bottlenecked less by basic prompt following and more by finer capabilities such as world knowledge, text rendering, cultural and physical grounding, visual storytelling, and stylistic coherence. That matters upstream: if these are the capabilities that distinguish strong models, they should influence data curation, text encoder design, reward modeling, and how human supervision is collected. The contribution is moderate but meaningful. It does not introduce a new generator; it proposes a more creator-centered evaluation frame and explicitly questions the growing practice of treating a single uncalibrated MLLM judge as the source of truth.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core contribution is benchmark design. The paper emphasizes three design choices. First, the taxonomy is built top-down from professional creative workflows rather than as a flat checklist of attributes. It covers five major axes: Real-world Fidelity, Creative Generation, Quality, Aesthetics, and Text-Image Alignment, and further breaks them into creator-relevant subdimensions such as World Knowledge, Text Rendering, and Visual Storytelling. Second, the benchmark consists of 1,000 expert-crafted structured prompts, curated through filtering and stratified sampling for broad but balanced coverage. The structured-prompt aspect is important: prompts are intentionally designed around evaluable capabilities, which helps reduce entanglement across dimensions. Third, the paper takes a clear stance against over-reliance on a single MLLM judge. The introduction explicitly criticizes recent pipelines that use outputs from models like Gemini as supervision, arguing that this bakes the judge’s systematic bias into downstream reward models and benchmark scores. In response, Qwen-Image-Bench is co-developed with professional artists and tries to anchor evaluation in expert human standards rather than model-to-model scoring. Methodologically, this is a deliberate trade-off: smaller scale, stronger structure, and higher annotation density instead of a large but weakly controlled benchmark.
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full text, the main experimental goal is to show stronger discriminative power and better alignment with expert human judgment, rather than scale. The confirmed hard facts are: the benchmark contains 1,000 structured prompts, organized under a three-level taxonomy, and spans five major evaluation axes with explicit emphasis on Real-world Fidelity and Creative Generation. The introduction claims that existing benchmarks suffer from score compression and benchmark drift on strong models, and that the new benchmark is designed to better separate production-grade systems. However, the visible text does not include the full quantitative tables, model rankings, or judge-human agreement numbers, so no precise gains should be invented. When reading the full paper, the key results to verify are: whether the benchmark actually spreads out frontier models more clearly; how well automatic judges align with expert annotations, especially on creative dimensions; and whether the claimed mismatch with older benchmarks is demonstrated through concrete failure cases.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the taxonomy section. The main question is whether the definitions of Real-world Fidelity and Creative Generation are operational enough to support reliable evaluation. Then read the data construction section, focusing on how structured prompts are authored, how stratified sampling is done, how deeply experts are involved, and how the benchmark avoids mixing multiple capabilities in one prompt. Finally, check the evaluation protocol and the human-versus-judge validation, especially the treatment of MLLM judge bias. If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, the taxonomy overview, the prompt construction section, and the agreement tables. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to understand the benchmark’s logic; more time is needed only if the goal is to assess whether it can inform training data or reward-model design.

recommendation.zh: Qwen 系的创作评测口径值得对齐；读 taxonomy 和人工流程设计即可，指标是否抗投机还要等外部复现。
recommendation.en: Worth aligning with Qwen’s creator-oriented eval taxonomy; read the workflow design, but wait for external checks on metric robustness.

paper.title: No Safe Dose: How Training Data Drives Unsafe Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image models trained on large-scale data often inevitably ingest unsafe content. While some people observe input-output amplifications, it remains unclear whether and how training data composition directly drives model output safety or by other factors. We shed light on this question by isolating this variable: we train the same text-to-image model on datasets that differ \emph{only} in their fraction of unsafe images (0\% to 9.6\%), across several dataset scales (100K to 8M). Then we ge

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究训练数据中不安全图像的比例，是否会因果性地提高文生图模型的不安全输出率。结论很直接：会；起作用的是污染比例，而不是不安全样本的绝对数量。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的价值在于，它给出一个受控的数据配比实验，而不是事后相关性分析。多模态预训练常把数据规模放在首位，但这篇工作显示，安全相关的数据比例会稳定改变模型的攻击面，并且过滤不安全样本没有带来可测的质量损失。这个结果支持把数据治理作为训练前的主要控制变量，而不是只依赖推理时过滤、RLHF 或 guidance。
summary.technical_approach: 作者固定文生图 flow-matching 模型 PRX 的架构、超参和评测流程，只改变训练语料中的不安全图像比例，范围从 0% 到约 9.6%，并在 100K 到 8M 的数据规模上做实验。为了区分“比例”和“绝对数量”，实验采用 factorial design：让不同数据规模和污染比例组合产生可比的 unsafe count。评测时，每个模型生成 10,000 张图像，并用四个独立安全分类器打标。作者还做了文本编码器消融，比较 T5-Gemma、CLIP 和 SafeCLIP，用来分析冻结文本编码器带来的安全下限。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有五点。第一，不安全输出率随训练污染比例单调上升：从 0% 污染时的 16.6% 上升到 5% 污染时的 25.5%。第二，决定变量是污染比例，而不是不安全样本的绝对数量；因此，按比例过滤在不同语料规模下有相近收益。第三，即使训练图像中移除全部不安全样本，仍有 16.6% 的不安全输出下限，主要来自冻结文本编码器携带的语义关联；换用 SafeCLIP 后下限降到 9.6%。第四，污染影响主要出现在 adversarial prompts 上；在 safe prompts 下，各模型不安全输出约为 1%，几乎不随污染比例变化。第五，安全过滤没有在 FID、CLIPScore、ImageReward 上带来可测质量下降。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 25–35 分钟即可。优先看实验设计部分，尤其是污染比例、数据规模和 unsafe count 如何解耦；再看 dose-response 曲线和文本编码器消融。若关注多模态预训练数据治理，重点看“比例而非绝对数量”这一结论，以及 SafeCLIP 消融揭示的文本语义通道。质量指标部分可以快速扫过，主要用于判断过滤是否有明显代价。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the fraction of unsafe images in a text-to-image training corpus causally increases unsafe generations. The answer is yes: output unsafety rises with the contamination rate, and the operative variable is the proportion of unsafe data rather than the absolute number of unsafe examples.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model pretraining is the controlled treatment of data composition. Instead of inferring safety behavior from opaque model releases, the study fixes architecture, hyperparameters, and evaluation, then varies only the unsafe-data dose. The result strengthens the case for upstream data curation in multimodal pretraining. It also shows that reactive mitigations such as prompt filtering or guidance cannot fully substitute for training-data control, especially under adversarial prompting.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train the same PRX text-to-image flow-matching model under controlled data conditions. The unsafe-image fraction ranges from 0% to roughly 9.6%, with dataset scales from 100K to 8M. A factorial design separates contamination proportion from absolute unsafe count, which is important because larger datasets otherwise confound the two. For each trained model, 10,000 images are generated from a fixed prompt testbench and scored by four independent safety classifiers. A text-encoder ablation with T5-Gemma, CLIP, and SafeCLIP isolates the contribution of frozen conditioning models to the residual unsafe-output floor.
summary_en.experiments: The main dose-response result is monotonic: unsafe generations increase from 16.6% with 0% unsafe training images to 25.5% at 5% contamination. The factorial analysis indicates that contamination proportion, not the absolute count of unsafe samples, explains the effect. Even after removing unsafe images from the image training data, a 16.6% unsafe-output floor remains, attributed to unsafe semantic associations in the frozen text encoder; replacing it with SafeCLIP lowers the floor to 9.6%. The effect is concentrated under adversarial prompts. Under safe prompts, unsafe outputs stay around 1% across contamination levels. Safety filtering produces no measurable degradation in FID, CLIPScore, or ImageReward.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the experimental design carefully, especially how the authors decouple unsafe fraction, dataset scale, and absolute unsafe count. Then focus on the dose-response plots and the text-encoder ablation. For multimodal pretraining, the most useful parts are the proportion-versus-count analysis and the finding that frozen text encoders can impose a residual safety floor. The quality-metric section can be read quickly as evidence that filtering did not create an obvious quality trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 数据比例而非绝对数量这点值得看；只读实验设计和污染率消融，别把 T2I 结论直接外推到 LLM。
recommendation.en: The ratio-versus-count result is the useful part; read the contamination ablations, but do not directly port the T2I safety curve to LLMs.

paper.title: Beyond Pairwise Preferences: Listwise Reward-Aware Alignment for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Preference optimization has emerged as an efficient alternative to online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for aligning text-to-image diffusion models. However, existing methods largely reduce supervision to binary pairwise comparisons. This pairwise reduction is limiting when training data naturally contains multiple candidate images for the same prompt, and when continuous reward scores can provide richer information than a single winner-loser label. To address these limitatio

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型偏好优化方法局限于二元成对比较，无法利用多候选图像的连续奖励分数提供的丰富信息。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出列表级奖励感知的扩散模型对齐范式，超越二元偏好框架。对文本RLHF从二元转向列表级有类比价值。
summary.technical_approach: Diffusion LAIR将同一prompt下多候选图像的奖励分数转换为中心化优势权重，优化优势加权的隐式奖励回归目标，并通过二次惩罚正则化隐式奖励的幅度。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像生成任务上验证，相比二元偏好方法在多个维度（美学、人类偏好匹配）上取得更好的对齐效果。
summary.authors_note: 斯坦福大学，Stefano Ermon（生成模型领域知名学者，diffusion alignment方向核心研究者）、Yisong Yue（ML知名学者）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing diffusion model preference optimization is limited to binary pairwise comparisons, wasting richer information from continuous reward scores across multiple candidate images per prompt.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes listwise reward-aware alignment paradigm for diffusion models, analogous to moving beyond binary preferences in text RLHF.
summary_en.technical_approach: Diffusion LAIR converts reward scores across multiple candidates into centered advantage weights, optimizing an advantage-weighted regression objective on implicit reward with quadratic penalty regularization.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on text-to-image generation, outperforming binary preference methods across multiple dimensions including aesthetics and human preference alignment.
summary_en.authors_note: Stanford University; Stefano Ermon (leading researcher in generative models and diffusion alignment), Yisong Yue (prominent ML researcher)

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型的列表级偏好对齐，核心insight（二元→列表级）对RLHF方法论有一定类比启发，但实验仅在文生图上验证，对LLM pretrain研究者看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Listwise preference alignment for diffusion models; the binary→listwise insight has some analogical relevance to RLHF methodology, but experiments are purely text-to-image — read only the abstract.

paper.title: Erased but Exploitable: Black-box Embedding-Aware Prompting Against Unlearned Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove specific concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models, yet several white- and black-box attacks have been introduced to make the model generate such unlearned concepts. These attacks, nevertheless, do not assume a realistic threat model, i.e. they either assume access to the model weights, or result in gibberish adversarial prompts that could be easily detected even through naive rule-based safeguarding. We aim to address this gap in this paper.   We

summary.core_problem: 评估文本到图像扩散模型的概念 unlearning 是否能抵抗现实黑盒攻击，尤其是自然语言提示绕过而非白盒或乱码提示攻击。
