summary.importance: 贡献是生成模型安全和 unlearning 评估中的攻击方法；对 LLM 预训练不直接相关，但对安全评测、概念擦除和提示空间搜索有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BEAP，一种黑盒、embedding-aware 的对抗提示搜索方法；它用 LLM 迭代生成自然语言提示，并用概念出现、文本-图像对齐和图像质量等多奖励信号优化，目标是在不触发简单安全过滤的情况下恢复被擦除概念。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型、概念集合、攻击成功率或对比数值；核心实验应比较 BEAP 与已有白盒攻击、黑盒攻击和乱码式 adversarial prompt 在成功率与可检测性上的差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models survives realistic black-box attacks using natural prompts rather than weight access or gibberish adversarial strings.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an attack and evaluation method for generative-model unlearning. It is not LLM pretraining work, but it is relevant to safety evaluation, concept erasure, and prompt-space search.
summary_en.technical_approach: BEAP is a black-box embedding-aware adversarial prompting method. It uses an LLM to iteratively propose natural prompts and optimizes multiple rewards, including erased-concept presence, text-image alignment, and image quality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide target models, concept sets, attack success rates, or numerical comparisons. The likely evaluation contrasts BEAP with prior white-box and black-box attacks on effectiveness and detectability.

recommendation.zh: 可看攻击目标函数和黑盒搜索设计；它提醒 unlearning 评估不能只看概念词过滤。
recommendation.en: Worth checking the attack objective and black-box search design; it shows unlearning evaluation cannot stop at keyword filtering.

paper.title: ERNIE-Image Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce ERNIE-Image, an open-source text-to-image generation model built upon an 8B single-stream DiT architecture. ERNIE-Image aims to bridge the gap between current open-source models and leading closed-source systems through more effective mining of large-scale pre-training data and improved supervision quality throughout training. During pre-training, we adopt a bottom-up data construction pipeline that combines fine-grained image categorization, rich caption annotation, aesthetic asses

summary.core_problem: 这篇技术报告解决的是开放文本生成图像模型里一个很现实的组合问题：在不把参数规模继续无节制做大的前提下，怎样同时提升复杂指令遵循、长文本渲染和审美质量，并把模型做成可开源、可部署、可继续微调的工业级系统。它不是在提出新的生成范式，而是在 latent diffusion + DiT 这条主线上，把数据构造、标注增强、采样平衡、偏好对齐和蒸馏加速串成一套完整 recipe。
summary.importance: 如果从狭义“纯文本 LLM 预训练”看，这篇论文相关性有限；但从更广义的基座预训练与跨模态统一建模看，它有两点启发。第一，作者把性能提升主要押在数据工程和训练信号质量上，而不是继续堆更大的 backbone，这和当前语言模型里“数据质量、分布控制、后训练信号”越来越重要的趋势是一致的。第二，它展示了一个较完整的 pretrain→post-train→turbo distillation 闭环：预训练阶段用细粒度分类、caption enrichment、审美清洗改善底座分布；后训练阶段用高一致性数据和少量 DPO 做偏好校正；最后再做低步数加速模型。对做多模态基座的人，这种 pipeline 设计比单点模块更值得看。
summary.technical_approach: 模型主体是 8B 参数的单流 DiT latent diffusion model，VAE 采用 FLUX.2 VAE，文本编码器不是常见的大型 T5/LLM，而是更小的 Ministral-3 3B。作者强调，小文本编码器在长复杂指令条件下仍能提供足够好的条件表示，同时显著降低显存和部署门槛。训练上最核心的是数据 pipeline。预训练阶段采用 bottom-up 数据构造：先从大规模原始图像池出发，训练一个 1 万类的细粒度图像分类器，把图像映射到细语义类别；这样后续采样可以按细粒度类别做平衡，避免头部视觉概念淹没长尾。然后用强 VLM 为全部图像生成更结构化、更细的 caption，尤其补充图中可见文本和关系描述，以增强 instruction following 和世界知识覆盖。审美方面，作者训练了 ERNIE-Image-Aes 作为审美打分模型，用于清洗和筛选数据，提高高质量视觉样本占比。后训练阶段采用 top-down 数据构造，为高需求场景人工或半自动整理高一致性训练数据，并通过多样化 annotation 覆盖不同用户提示风格，减少 caption 模型带来的表达偏置。偏好对齐上使用改进版 DPO，作者的经验判断是：当 base model 和 reward model 都足够强时，只需很少 DPO 步数就能把分布轻推到目标区域，从而减少 reward hacking。加速阶段训练 ERNIE-Image-Turbo，只需 8 NFEs。为避免只用子集数据蒸馏时出现能力漂移，作者提出 MT-DMD，用多个能力侧重不同的 expert variant 共同提供监督信号，让 turbo 模型尽量保留全能力。最后还加了一个轻量 Prompt Enhancer，把短 prompt 扩展成更结构化的视觉描述，提升实际使用时的 controllability。
summary.experiments: 从全文可见，作者把实验重点放在系统能力展示和若干内部组件有效性上，而不是像学术论文那样给出非常细的统一 ablation 表。可以明确提取的关键信息包括：主模型为 8B DiT，文本编码器为 3B Ministral-3，turbo 版本推理只需 8 NFEs。论文声称在复杂指令遵循、中文与长文本渲染、审美质量上接近顶级闭源模型，并在多张表格中与 Qwen-Image、HunyuanImage、Z-Image 及若干商业系统做比较。更值得注意的是作者给出的经验性结论：早期训练阶段加入更详细的图像描述，能同时改善复杂 instruction following 和世界知识保留；细粒度 1 万类平衡采样有助于保住长尾概念；当 reward model 足够强时，DPO 不需要很多步，否则更容易把分布推偏。由于你给出的全文片段没有包含完整表格数字，无法负责任地复述具体 benchmark 分数；但从技术报告结构看，最该关注的是这些 recipe 与能力变化之间的对应关系，而不是单个榜单名次。
summary.reading_guide: 建议按 pipeline 顺序读。先看 Introduction，把作者想解决的三件事记住：复杂指令、文本渲染、审美质量。然后直接看 Model Training，重点抓四个设计：1 万类细粒度分类与平衡采样、VLM caption enrichment、审美模型清洗、后训练高一致性数据。接着看 DPO 和 Turbo 训练部分，尤其是“少量 DPO 步数”和 MT-DMD 这两个经验点。最后再看 Prompt Enhancer，理解它是产品层补偿还是模型能力的一部分。若只想泛读，40 到 60 分钟足够。若要深挖，建议重点问三个问题：为什么 3B 文本编码器够用；细粒度类别平衡是否比直接按 caption/embedding 聚类更稳；MT-DMD 与常见 consistency distillation 或 progressive distillation 相比，监督信号到底多了什么。
summary.authors_note: 百度 ERNIE 团队技术报告；从文中表述看属于工业研发团队的系统性开源工作，具体作者名单在给定全文片段中未展开。

summary_en.core_problem: This technical report tackles a practical open-model problem in text-to-image generation: how to improve complex instruction following, long-text rendering, and aesthetic quality without relying only on brute-force parameter scaling, while keeping the system open, deployable, and fine-tunable. It does not propose a new generative paradigm. Instead, it assembles a full recipe around latent diffusion and DiT, with most gains coming from data construction, annotation quality, preference alignment, and acceleration.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to narrow LLM pretraining is limited, but it is useful from a broader foundation-model perspective. Two aspects stand out. First, the report places the main burden of improvement on data quality and training signals rather than on ever-larger backbones, which mirrors an important trend in language model work. Second, it presents a fairly complete pretrain-to-post-train-to-turbo pipeline: pretraining improves the base distribution through fine-grained balancing, caption enrichment, and aesthetic filtering; post-training adds high-consistency scenario data and light preference alignment; then a fast model is distilled for low-NFE inference. For multimodal foundation-model researchers, that end-to-end recipe is more interesting than any single module.
summary_en.technical_approach: The base model is an 8B single-stream DiT latent diffusion model using FLUX.2 VAE. A notable design choice is the text encoder: instead of a larger T5-style encoder or a full LLM, the system uses Ministral-3 3B, with the claim that it still supports long and complex prompts while reducing memory cost. The most important part is the data pipeline. In pretraining, the authors use a bottom-up construction strategy: starting from a massive raw image pool, they train a 10,000-way fine-grained image classifier and use those categories for balanced sampling, aiming to preserve long-tail concepts rather than letting dominant visual categories overwhelm the distribution. They then run a strong VLM to generate richer captions, including structural descriptions and visible text, so the model sees more explicit supervision for instruction following and world knowledge. For quality control, they train an aesthetic scorer, ERNIE-Image-Aes, and use it to clean the corpus. In post-training, they switch to a top-down pipeline with highly consistent data for high-demand scenarios, and diversify annotations to cover different user prompt styles, reducing caption-model bias. Preference alignment is done with an improved DPO variant; the practical claim is that if both the base model and reward model are strong, only a few DPO steps are needed, which helps avoid reward hacking. For acceleration, they train ERNIE-Image-Turbo with only 8 NFEs. To reduce capability drift during fast-model training on subsets, they introduce MT-DMD, where multiple expert variants provide supervision jointly. A lightweight Prompt Enhancer expands short user prompts into richer structured descriptions before generation.
summary_en.experiments: The report is more system-oriented than benchmark-centric, so the most useful evidence is tied to design choices rather than a single clean ablation table. The explicit facts available from the text are: the base model is 8B, the text encoder is 3B, and the turbo model runs at 8 NFEs. The authors claim strong performance on complex instruction following, Chinese and long-text rendering, and aesthetic quality, with comparisons against open models such as Qwen-Image, HunyuanImage, and Z-Image, as well as commercial systems. The more useful empirical lessons are qualitative but concrete: adding detailed image descriptions early in training improves both instruction following and retention of world knowledge; 10k-category balancing helps preserve long-tail concepts; and DPO should be applied lightly when the reward model is already strong, otherwise distribution drift becomes more likely. Since the provided full-text excerpt does not include the full result tables, it would be unsafe to restate exact benchmark numbers. The main thing to extract is the mapping between each recipe component and the capability it is meant to improve.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it in pipeline order. Start with the introduction and keep the three target capabilities in mind: complex instructions, text rendering, and aesthetics. Then go to the training section and focus on four ingredients: 10k-way fine-grained categorization and balanced sampling, VLM-based caption enrichment, aesthetic filtering, and high-consistency post-training data. After that, read the DPO and turbo sections, especially the claims about using only a few DPO steps and the MT-DMD strategy for preserving capability during acceleration. Leave the Prompt Enhancer for the end and treat it as a product-facing layer on top of the model. A 40-60 minute skim should be enough. For deeper reading, ask three questions: why a 3B text encoder is sufficient; whether fine-grained category balancing is more stable than clustering by captions or embeddings; and what extra supervision MT-DMD provides compared with standard consistency or progressive distillation.
summary_en.authors_note: Technical report from Baidu's ERNIE team. The provided excerpt does not include the full author list.

recommendation.zh: 百度 ERNIE-Image 的技术报告，重点看其 pretrain 和 post-train 阶段的数据清洗和构造 pipeline，对做多模态生成的同学有工程参考价值。
recommendation.en: Baidu's ERNIE-Image technical report; focus on its data cleaning and construction pipelines in pre-train and post-train stages, valuable engineering reference for multimodal generation.

paper.title: Concept Unlearning via Cross-Attention Activation Projection for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Concept unlearning aims to erase a target concept from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model without retraining. Closed-form methods are attractive in this setting because they apply a single deterministic edit to the cross-attention weights and add no inference-time cost. Existing closed-form methods, however, represent the target concept through the text encoder's response to a few short anchor prompts that name it, and paraphrased prompts that evoke the concept without naming it consiste

summary.core_problem: 在不重新训练、且不增加推理成本的条件下，从预训练文本到图像扩散模型中删除目标概念，并提升对改写提示词的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型安全与模型编辑方法。它对 LLM 预训练不是主线，但“在激活空间定义要遗忘的概念”这个判断对语言模型 unlearning、表示编辑和安全后处理有一定旁路参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PURE，即 Projection in U-Net Rendering for Erasure。区别于只用少量显式 anchor prompt 的文本编码器响应来表示目标概念，PURE 从每层 cross-attention activation 中构建 forget basis 和 retain basis，再对 U-Net 的 cross-attention 权重做一次闭式投影编辑。核心假设是 cross-attention activation 更接近模型将要渲染的内容，因此比文本 embedding 更能覆盖不直接命名目标概念的 paraphrase。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、底座模型、数据集、baseline 或具体数值。实验重点应是目标概念删除率、保留概念的损伤、对显式命名提示与 paraphrased prompt 的鲁棒性，以及无额外推理开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper removes a target concept from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model without retraining or adding inference-time cost, while improving robustness to paraphrased prompts.
summary_en.importance: This is a model editing and safety method for generative diffusion models. It is peripheral to LLM pretraining, but the idea of defining what to forget in activation space rather than input-embedding space is relevant to unlearning and representation editing more broadly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, PURE, stands for Projection in U-Net Rendering for Erasure. Instead of representing the target concept using text-encoder responses to a few anchor prompts, it builds forget and retain bases from per-layer cross-attention activations and applies a closed-form projection edit to U-Net cross-attention weights. The key assumption is that cross-attention activations better describe what the model is about to render than text embeddings do.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, base models, datasets, baselines, or quantitative gains. The relevant evaluation should measure concept removal, damage to retained concepts, robustness to explicit and paraphrased prompts, and the absence of inference overhead.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 paraphrase 实验；激活空间 unlearning 的 prior 可借鉴，但不要外推到 LLM 预训练。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and paraphrase tests; activation-space unlearning is a useful prior, but do not over-transfer it to LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Towards Anatomically Plausible Human Image Generation via Synthetic Localized Preferences
paper.abstract: Large-scale text-to-image foundation models have achieved remarkable visual realism, yet generating human images with correct anatomical structures remains challenging. Existing approaches enforce anatomical constraints through part-specific modules or localized loss weighting during supervised fine-tuning on high-quality human photos, but such datasets are limited and often provide ambiguous optimization signals due to confounding factors such as lighting, pose, and background. Preference-based

summary.core_problem: 改善文本到图像模型生成人体时的局部解剖结构错误，尤其是手、肢体等局部伪影。
summary.importance: 贡献是把偏好优化用于图像生成的局部结构对齐，并用可控合成偏好对减少真实人像数据中姿态、光照、背景等混杂因素。对 LLM 研究的价值主要在于偏好数据构造和局部化 DPO 信号，而不是视觉任务本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ASAP，即 Alignment via Synthetic Anatomical Preference。方法从高质量人体图像出发，通过 localized degradation 生成受控的偏好对，再进行偏好式对齐；核心是让优化信号集中在解剖错误区域，而不是像标准 DPO 那样对所有像素等权处理。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在人体图像生成上进行实验，目标是提升解剖合理性；未给出使用的基础 T2I 模型、训练样本规模、baseline、自动指标或人工评测提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets anatomical errors in human image generation, focusing on localized artifacts such as incorrect body parts.
summary_en.importance: Its useful idea is preference alignment with controlled, localized synthetic preference pairs. For LLM researchers, the transferable part is the construction of cleaner preference signals, not the human-image generation task itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: ASAP constructs preference pairs by applying localized degradations to high-fidelity human images. It then aligns the generator with preference optimization that emphasizes anatomical artifact regions rather than treating all pixels equally as in standard DPO.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on human image generation and anatomical plausibility, but does not specify the base model, data scale, baselines, metrics, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 值得记的是“可控局部退化造偏好对”，可迁移到 RLHF 数据质量讨论；视觉结果不必细读。
recommendation.en: The reusable idea is controlled localized degradation for preference-pair construction; the image-generation results themselves are not worth deep reading.

paper.title: Lens: Rethinking Training Efficiency for Foundational Text-to-Image Models
paper.abstract: We introduce Lens, a 3.8B-parameter T2I model that achieves performance competitive with, and in several cases surpassing, state-of-the-art models with more than 6B parameters across various benchmarks, while requiring significantly less training compute. For example, Lens requires only about 19.3% of the training compute used by Z-Image. The training efficiency of Lens stems from two key strategies beyond its compact model size. First, we maximize data information density per training batch by

summary.core_problem: 提升基础 text-to-image 模型的训练效率，在较小参数量和较低训练计算量下保持强生成质量。
summary.importance: 这是多模态生成预训练的工程与数据配方研究。对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值不在图像生成结果本身，而在信息密度更高的数据、batch 构造和收敛加速如何改变 compute-quality tradeoff。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 3.8B 参数的 Lens。核心策略有两类：第一，提高每个 batch 的数据信息密度，包括使用 Lens-800M，包含 8 亿 GPT-4.1 生成的密集 caption 图文对，平均 caption 约 109 个词，并在 batch 内混合多分辨率、多长宽比图像；第二，通过架构选择改善收敛速度。摘要未完整展开具体架构细节。
summary.experiments: Lens 在多个 text-to-image benchmark 上达到或超过若干 6B 以上模型的表现。训练计算量约为 Z-Image 的 19.3%。摘要未列出完整 baseline、指标表和训练步数，但给出了 3.8B 参数、Lens-800M 数据规模和相对训练 compute 的关键数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Baining Guo、Fangyun Wei、Dongdong Chen 等多模态与视觉生成方向知名研究者；输入信息未明确给出机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve the training efficiency of foundation text-to-image models, achieving strong generation quality with fewer parameters and substantially less compute.
summary_en.importance: This is a data-and-recipe study for multimodal generative pretraining. Its relevance to LLM pretraining lies in how denser supervision, batch construction, and convergence-oriented architecture choices reshape the compute-quality tradeoff.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Lens, a 3.8B-parameter text-to-image model. Its main strategies are increasing information density per batch and improving convergence. The data side uses Lens-800M, 800M image-text pairs with GPT-4.1-generated dense captions averaging about 109 words, and batches images with multiple resolutions and diverse aspect ratios. The abstract also mentions architectural choices for faster convergence, but does not provide the full details.
summary_en.experiments: Lens is reported to be competitive with, and in several cases better than, text-to-image models above 6B parameters across benchmarks. It uses about 19.3% of the training compute used by Z-Image. The abstract provides the key numbers of 3.8B parameters, 800M dense-caption pairs, and relative compute, but not the full metric table or training schedule.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Baining Guo, Fangyun Wei, and Dongdong Chen, who are known for multimodal and visual generation research. The provided metadata does not state the institutions.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据和 batch recipe；图像生成细节可略过，密集 caption 的 compute 收益值得迁移思考。
recommendation.en: Read the data and batch recipe; skip most image-generation details, but the compute gain from dense captions is worth mapping to LM data design.

paper.title: SEGA: Spectral-Energy Guided Attention for Resolution Extrapolation in Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have emerged as a dominant architecture for text-to-image generation, yet their performance drops when generating at resolutions beyond their training range. Existing training-free approaches mitigate this by modifying inference-time attention behavior, often through Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) extrapolation combined with attention scaling. However, these strategies apply a uniform and content-agnostic scaling across RoPE components with distinct frequency cha

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像 Diffusion Transformer 在超出训练分辨率生成时结构一致性和细节质量下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成推理阶段的训练-free 分辨率外推方法。它不直接改变预训练 recipe，但对使用 RoPE 的生成式 Transformer 在位置外推时的频率分量处理有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SEGA，即 Spectral-Energy Guided Attention。与统一缩放 RoPE attention 不同，SEGA 根据每个 denoising step 中 latent 的空间频率结构，对不同 RoPE 频率成分做动态缩放，试图同时保留全局结构和恢复高频细节。
summary.experiments: 在多个目标高分辨率设置上测试，报告相比已有训练-free 高分辨率合成方法有稳定改进；摘要未说明所用 DiT 模型、数据集、分辨率范围、指标和具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Toronto 和 Vector Institute。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses resolution extrapolation for text-to-image Diffusion Transformers, where image quality drops when generation resolution exceeds the training range.
summary_en.importance: It is a training-free inference method for multimodal generation. While not a pretraining recipe, it is relevant to how RoPE-based generative Transformers handle positional extrapolation and frequency-specific attention behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: SEGA dynamically scales attention across RoPE components according to the latent spatial-frequency structure at each denoising step. This contrasts with uniform, content-agnostic RoPE scaling and aims to preserve both global structure and fine details.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports consistent improvements across multiple high-resolution targets over existing training-free extrapolation methods, but does not specify the DiT models, datasets, resolution ranges, metrics, or exact margins.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Toronto and Vector Institute.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RoPE 频率分量分析；这是图像生成推理补丁，但对位置外推的频域 failure mode 有参考。
recommendation.en: Read only the RoPE frequency analysis; it is an image-generation inference patch, but the extrapolation failure mode is useful.

paper.title: RankE: End-to-End Post-Training for Discrete Text-to-Image Generation with Decoder Co-Evolution
paper.abstract: Discrete autoregressive (AR) text-to-image (T2I) models pair a VQ tokenizer with an AR policy, and current post-training pipelines optimize only the policy while keeping the VQ decoder frozen. Recent diffusion T2I work, exemplified by REPA-E, has shown that the VAE itself constitutes a key alignment bottleneck, yet no analogous investigation exists for discrete AR models. We show that policy-only optimization induces Latent Covariate Shift: as the policy evolves, the resulting token distribution

summary.core_problem: 解决离散自回归文生图模型在后训练阶段只优化policy、冻结VQ decoder所导致的对齐分数上升但解码图像质量下降的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献在于指出 discrete AR T2I 中被忽视的 decoder 对齐瓶颈，并提出 policy 与 decoder 联合后训练。对基座研究员的启发不在图像生成本身，而在“上游分布漂移会让冻结tokenizer/decoder失配”这一接口问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RankE，一个端到端后训练框架，让AR policy和decoder交替协同进化。作者把问题形式化为 Latent Covariate Shift：policy更新后生成token分布偏离decoder训练时见过的真实token分布。方法上，两部分都优化基于排序的alignment目标，并加稳定性正则，避免联合训练崩掉。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体参数量和数据规模，但实验主线是比较 policy-only post-training 与 RankE 的差异，验证 reward 提升与视觉质量退化的背离，并展示联合优化能同时改善对齐分数和解码质量。基线应包括固定decoder的离散AR文生图后训练方案。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括西湖大学、浙江大学、清华大学、香港科技大学、上海AI Lab。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a failure mode in discrete autoregressive text-to-image post-training: optimizing only the policy while freezing the VQ decoder can improve reward scores yet degrade decoded image quality.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is identifying the decoder as an alignment bottleneck in discrete AR T2I and proposing joint post-training of the policy and decoder. For foundation-model researchers, the transferable lesson is about interface mismatch when an upstream generator shifts the token distribution seen by a frozen tokenizer/decoder.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes RankE, an end-to-end post-training framework where the AR policy and decoder co-evolve through alternating optimization. The key diagnosis is Latent Covariate Shift: after policy updates, generated token distributions drift away from the ground-truth token distribution used to train the decoder. Both modules are trained with ranking-based alignment objectives plus stability regularization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size or data scale, but the experimental story compares policy-only post-training against RankE, showing a reward-quality mismatch under frozen decoders and improved alignment plus visual quality under joint optimization. Baselines likely include standard discrete AR T2I post-training with fixed decoders.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Westlake University, Zhejiang University, Tsinghua University, HKUST, and Shanghai AI Lab.

recommendation.zh: 图像方向，但“冻结decoder会被上游分布漂移拖死”这个诊断很像 tokenizer/interface 问题；看问题定义和联合优化框架即可。
recommendation.en: It is a vision paper, but the diagnosis—frozen decoders break under upstream distribution shift—maps cleanly to tokenizer/interface issues; read the problem setup and the co-training recipe.

institutions: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: MONET: A Massive, Open, Non-redundant and Enriched Text-to-image dataset
paper.abstract: Training large text-to-image models requires high-quality, curated datasets with diverse content and detailed captions. Yet the cost and complexity of collecting, filtering, deduplicating, and re-captioning such corpora at scale hinders open and reproducible research in the field. We introduce MONET, an open Apache 2.0 dataset of approx. 104.9M image--text pairs collected from 2.9B raw pairs across heterogeneous open sources through successive stages of safety filtering, domain-based filtering,

summary.core_problem: 解决开放文本到图像训练中，高质量大规模图文数据难以公开复现的问题，尤其是采集、去重、过滤和重描述成本过高。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是数据资产与数据处理流水线：从 29 亿原始图文对中构建约 1.049 亿开放图文对，并附带 embeddings 与注释。对研究者的价值在于观察大规模图文数据清洗、去重、recaption 的工程配方，而不是语言模型本身。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 MONET 数据集，采用多阶段流水线：安全过滤、域过滤、精确与近重复去除、使用多个 VLM 进行短到长描述的重标注，并加入合成样本增强。数据以 Apache 2.0 开放，并提供预计算特征以降低训练门槛。
summary.experiments: 用 MONET 独立训练一个 4B 参数 latent diffusion 模型，在 GenEval 和 DPG 上达到有竞争力的结果，以验证数据集质量。摘要未给出更细的对比对象和提升幅度，但实验重点显然是证明“只靠该数据集也能训出像样的 T2I 模型”。
summary.authors_note: Jasper Research 团队。若关注开放图文数据构建、去重和 recaption pipeline，这篇有一定参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of open, reproducible, large-scale, high-quality image-text corpora for training text-to-image models, where collection, filtering, deduplication, and recaptioning are expensive.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a data asset plus a data-processing pipeline: building an open 104.9M image-text dataset from 2.9B raw pairs, with embeddings and annotations included. The value is mostly in the engineering recipe for large-scale multimodal data curation rather than language modeling itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: MONET is built through a multi-stage pipeline: safety filtering, domain filtering, exact and near-duplicate removal, recaptioning with multiple VLMs from short to long descriptions, and synthetic augmentation. The dataset is released under Apache 2.0 with precomputed features.
summary_en.experiments: The authors train a 4B-parameter latent diffusion model exclusively on MONET and report competitive GenEval and DPG scores, aiming to show that the dataset alone is sufficient to train a capable T2I model. The abstract does not provide detailed baselines or margins.
summary_en.authors_note: From Jasper Research. Useful if you care about open image-text data construction, deduplication, and recaptioning pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM 论文，但数据清洗、去重、recaption 这套图文配方可迁到多模态预训练；只看数据流水线和去重策略即可。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the curation, dedup, and recaption recipe is transferable to multimodal pretraining; read the data pipeline, not the whole paper.

paper.title: Linear-DPO: Linear Direct Preference Optimization for Diffusion and Flow-Matching Generative Models
paper.abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is successful for alignment in LLMs but still faces challenges in text-to-image generation. Existing studies are confined to denoising diffusion models while overlooking flow-matching, and suffer from an objective mismatch when applying discrete NLP-based DPO to regression-based generative tasks.\ In this paper, we derive a generalized DPO objective that covers both diffusion and flow-matching via a unified reverse-time SDE framework, and point out from a gra

summary.core_problem: 解决 DPO 直接迁移到文本到图像 diffusion / flow-matching 模型时的目标错配问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是偏好优化方法改造。它把 LLM 中常用的 DPO 对齐思想重新推导到连续回归式生成模型上，尤其补上了 flow-matching 模型这一支，对多模态生成模型的偏好训练有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在统一 reverse-time SDE 框架下推导 diffusion 与 flow-matching 的广义 DPO 目标，并从梯度角度指出标准 sigmoid 型 DPO utility 对图像生成过于激进。Linear-DPO 用线性 utility 替代 sigmoid utility，使偏好梯度更持续，同时引入 EMA 更新的 reference model 稳定训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 SD1.5、SDXL 等 denoising diffusion 模型，以及 SD3-Medium 这类 flow-matching 模型。论文报告定性和定量指标均优于已有 diffusion preference optimization baseline，但摘要未给出具体数据规模和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哈尔滨工业大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the objective mismatch that appears when DPO is directly applied to text-to-image diffusion and flow-matching models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a preference-optimization method for continuous generative models. It re-derives DPO-style alignment outside discrete autoregressive language modeling and explicitly includes flow-matching models, which makes it relevant to multimodal generation training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors derive a generalized DPO objective under a unified reverse-time SDE formulation for both diffusion and flow matching. They argue from the gradient form that the standard sigmoid-based DPO utility is too aggressive for regression-based image generation, then propose Linear-DPO with a sustained linear utility and an EMA-updated reference model.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on SD1.5, SDXL, and SD3-Medium. The paper claims qualitative and quantitative gains over existing baselines, but the abstract does not provide exact dataset sizes or improvement numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Harbin Institute of Technology.

recommendation.zh: 只看目标推导和梯度分析即可；它对连续生成模型的 DPO 迁移有用，但离 LLM 预训练主线较远。
recommendation.en: Read only the objective derivation and gradient analysis; useful for DPO in continuous generators, but peripheral to LLM pretraining.

paper.title: FAGER: Factually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement of Text-to-Image Models
paper.abstract: Existing text-to-image (T2I) evaluation metrics mainly assess whether generated images align with information explicitly stated in the prompt, but often fail to capture factual requirements that are implicit, externally grounded, or identity-defining. As a result, they are not well suited for evaluating factual correctness in prompts involving scientific knowledge, historical facts, products, or culture-specific concepts. We propose FActually Grounded Evaluation and Refinement (FAGER), an agenti

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图评测更偏“字面 prompt 对齐”，难以衡量隐含/外部知识支撑的“事实正确性”，也缺少可操作的改进反馈。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏评测与诊断：把“可视觉验证的事实”显式结构化成 rubric，并给出可用于模型改进的反馈链路；对多模态对齐/事实性评测有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FAGER：先用 LLM 提议事实点，再结合参考引导的视觉事实抽取与核验，构建结构化 factual rubric；再把 rubric 转成 QA 对，用 VLM 做问答式评估，从而得到事实性分数与可执行的修正建议；并引入 Factual A/B test 作为验证该指标有效性的评测协议。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模与量化结果细节；主要实验应围绕：与既有 T2I 指标/评测协议对比、在“科学/历史/产品/文化概念”等事实依赖 prompt 上的区分度，以及 A/B test 下与人类偏好/事实判断的一致性。
summary.authors_note: Boston University；IBM Research。

summary_en.core_problem: Most T2I metrics focus on explicit prompt alignment and miss factually grounded requirements (implicit or external-knowledge-dependent), and they rarely provide actionable refinement feedback.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an evaluation/diagnostics contribution: it operationalizes “visually verifiable facts” into a structured rubric and closes the loop with actionable feedback, useful for multimodal factuality assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: FAGER builds a structured factual rubric via LLM-based fact proposal plus reference-guided visual fact extraction/verification, converts the rubric into QA pairs, and uses a VLM for QA-style evaluation to score factuality and generate improvement feedback; introduces a Factual A/B test protocol to validate the metric.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model/data scales or exact numbers; experiments likely compare against prior T2I metrics and evaluate agreement with human factual judgments on fact-heavy prompts (science/history/products/culture), using the proposed A/B test.
summary_en.authors_note: Boston University; IBM Research.

recommendation.zh: 偏评测工程：把“事实”拆成可问答的 rubric 这点可借鉴，但强依赖参考与 VLM 判题，结论当弱信号看即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly evaluation engineering: the rubric-to-QA decomposition is reusable, but heavy reliance on references and VLM judging makes the claims a weak signal.

paper.title: PixVerve: Advancing Native UHR Image Generation to 100MP with a Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset
paper.abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have recently seen notable progress around 1K and 2K resolution. With the extreme desire for better visual experience and the rapid development of imaging technology, the demand for Ultra-High-Resolution (UHR) image generation has grown significantly. However, UHR image generation poses great challenges due to the scarcity and complexity of high-resolution content. In this paper, we first introduce PixVerve-95K, a high-quality, open-source UHR T2I dataset curated with

summary.core_problem: 如何把文本到图像模型推进到“原生”100MP超高分辨率生成，并解决UHR数据稀缺与评测缺位。
summary.importance: 数据集+benchmark+训练方案的组合贡献；对“高分辨率生成的训练稳定性/数据管线/评测”有工程参考，但不直接触及LLM预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建PixVerve-95K（每张≥100MP）并提供七维标注；在此基础上提出三种训练方案把多种T2I foundation model扩展到原生100MP生成；评测上结合传统指标与基于多模态LLM的自动评估，提出PixVerve-Bench。
summary.experiments: 核心规模信息来自摘要：95K张≥100MP图文数据；对“多种T2I基础模型”做100MP训练与对比，并用PixVerve-Bench评估，但摘要未给出具体模型参数量、训练算力与定量提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Enabling native 100MP text-to-image generation while addressing the scarcity of ultra-high-resolution data and the lack of proper evaluation.
summary_en.importance: A combined dataset+benchmark+training-scheme contribution; useful engineering reference for UHR generation pipelines and evaluation, but not directly about LLM pretraining paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Releases PixVerve-95K (each image ≥100MP) with 7D annotations; proposes three training schemes to extend multiple T2I foundation models to native 100MP; introduces PixVerve-Bench using both conventional metrics and MLLM-based assessment.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract: 95K UHR image-text pairs (≥100MP). Trains multiple T2I foundation models for 100MP generation and evaluates on PixVerve-Bench; model sizes/compute and exact deltas are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把它当“UHR数据管线+评测”资料库：只需看数据筛选/标注维度和LLM评测设计，训练方案细节未必可复用。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a UHR dataset/pipeline + evaluation reference—skim the curation/annotation and the MLLM-based eval; the training recipes may be highly model-specific.

paper.title: Benchmarking and Evolving Reason-Reflect-Rectify for Reflective Visual Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models and Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual generation. However, their reliance on a single-pass generation paradigm limits their ability to handle complex prompts requiring iterative refinement. To enable multi-round Reflective Visual Generation (RVG), we formalize the Reason-Reflect-Rectify (R^3) loop as a core framework and introduce R^3-Bench, a benchmark of over 600 expert-annotated instances that quantifies iterative reasoning

summary.core_problem: 现有文生图模型和统一多模态模型采用单轮生成范式，无法处理需要迭代修正的复杂提示，且缺乏对应评测基准
summary.importance: 贡献了首个面向反射式视觉生成的600+实例专家标注基准R^3-Bench，同时提出双阶段优化框架提升迭代修正能力，属于benchmark+方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化Reason-Reflect-Rectify(R^3)循环作为反射式视觉生成核心框架，提出的R^3-Refiner采用分组相对策略优化(GRPO)和分层奖励机制，对齐修正动作与反思推理过程

paper.title: Pareto-Guided Optimal Transport for Multi-Reward Alignment
paper.abstract: Text-to-image generation models have achieved remarkable progress in preference optimization, yet achieving robust alignment across diverse reward models remains a significant challenge. Existing multi-reward fusion approaches rely on weighted summation, which is costly to tune and insufficient for balancing conflicting objectives. More critically, optimization with reward models is highly susceptible to reward hacking, where reward scores increase while the perceived quality of generated images

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论多 reward 对齐中的 reward hacking：在文本生成图像模型的偏好优化里，不同 prompt 对应的图像域有不同 reward 上界，但现有方法常用统一全局目标或加权求和目标，容易让部分样本沿着 reward model 的漏洞优化，分数升高而人类感知质量下降。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 与训练信号质量有参考价值。它把 reward hacking 的原因从“reward model 不够好”进一步拆到“不同样本的可达 reward 边界不同”。这个视角也适用于 LLM 的 RLHF、RLAIF 和多目标偏好优化：如果不同任务、语言、难度区间的 reward 分布和上界不同，用同一个全局 margin、baseline 或目标值，会把一部分样本推向不可靠区域。贡献主要在目标构造和评估指标，而不是模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Pareto Frontier-Guided Optimal Transport，简称 PG-OT。核心做法不是把多个 reward 线性加权成一个标量后统一最大化，而是为每个 prompt 构造 prompt-specific Pareto frontier。生成样本 batch 被视为源分布，Pareto frontier 被视为目标分布，然后用 optimal transport 将样本分布映射到对应 frontier。这样做的动机是尊重不同 prompt 的 reward 上界差异，避免把低上界样本硬推向不可达的全局目标。方法还区分强弱 reward model：对较可靠的 reward model 使用 online strategy，在训练中动态收集并更新 Pareto frontier；对较弱、容易坍缩的 reward model 使用 offline strategy，先预生成样本并提取 frontier，再作为更稳定的优化目标。评价上，作者提出 Joint Domination Rate 和 Joint Collapse Rate。JDR 衡量样本是否在所有 reward 上同时优于 baseline，JCR 衡量是否在所有 reward 上同时退化，比只看 reward 均值更能反映多目标优化是否真的协同。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 PG-OT 在多 reward 文生图偏好优化上优于强 baseline。关键结果包括：JDR2 达到 47.98%，提升约 11 个百分点；JDR4 达到 17.10%，提升约 3.4 个百分点；JCR4 下降 0.2%，说明在四个 reward 同时退化的样本比例上有所抑制。人工评测中，方法获得接近 80% 的 win rate。实验结论主要支持两点：第一，均值 reward 提升不足以说明对齐质量提升；第二，prompt-specific Pareto frontier 能减少多 reward 优化里的全局目标错配。需要注意的是，全文片段没有展示完整 reward model 组合、训练超参和人评协议，复现时这些细节会决定结论强度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 分钟。优先看 Mechanisms Behind Reward Hacking，理解作者如何把 heterogeneous reward bounds 和 unified global target 联系起来。然后看 PG-OT 方法部分，重点是 prompt-specific Pareto frontier 的构造、OT loss 如何进入训练、online/offline 两种策略的适用条件。实验部分重点看 JDR/JCR 与传统均值 reward 指标是否出现分歧。若研究 LLM RL，可以把文生图细节放在次要位置，重点思考它对多任务 reward normalization、per-prompt baseline、难度自适应目标和 reward model 可靠性分层的启发。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies reward hacking in multi-reward preference optimization for text-to-image models. Different prompts induce image domains with different attainable reward ranges, but common methods optimize toward a shared global target or a weighted sum of rewards. This mismatch can increase reward scores while degrading human-perceived quality.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training and reward-signal design than to pretraining. Its useful contribution is the diagnosis that reward hacking can be caused by heterogeneous reward upper bounds, not only by weak reward models. The same issue can appear in LLM RLHF or multi-objective alignment: tasks with different difficulty, languages, or domains may not share a single reachable reward target. A global margin, baseline, or scalarized objective can push some samples into regions where the reward model is unreliable.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Pareto Frontier-Guided Optimal Transport, or PG-OT. Instead of collapsing multiple rewards into a single weighted scalar and maximizing it against one global target, the method builds a prompt-specific Pareto frontier. Generated samples for the same prompt form the source distribution, while the corresponding Pareto frontier is used as the target distribution. Optimal transport then maps the source samples toward that frontier. This design respects prompt-level differences in attainable reward boundaries. The method also separates reward models by reliability. For stronger reward models, it uses an online strategy that dynamically collects and updates Pareto frontiers during training. For weaker reward models that are more prone to collapse, it uses an offline strategy that precomputes samples and extracts frontiers before optimization. The paper also introduces Joint Domination Rate and Joint Collapse Rate. JDR measures whether samples improve over the baseline on all rewards at once, while JCR measures simultaneous degradation on all rewards.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show consistent gains in multi-reward text-to-image alignment. PG-OT reaches 47.98% JDR2, about 11 percentage points higher than the compared baseline, and 17.10% JDR4, about 3.4 points higher. JCR4 decreases by 0.2%, indicating a reduction in samples that collapse across all four rewards. Human evaluation reports a win rate close to 80%. The main empirical message is that average reward scores are not sufficient for judging multi-reward alignment, and that prompt-specific Pareto targets can reduce global-target mismatch. Reproduction would require checking the exact reward model set, training recipe, frontier construction details, and human evaluation protocol.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 minutes. Start with the section on the mechanism behind reward hacking, especially the argument about heterogeneous reward bounds and unified global targets. Then read the PG-OT method, focusing on how the prompt-specific Pareto frontier is built, how optimal transport is used as the optimization signal, and when the online or offline strategy is chosen. In the experiments, compare JDR and JCR against mean reward metrics. For LLM RL researchers, the transferable parts are reward normalization, per-prompt or per-task baselines, adaptive targets, and reliability-aware use of reward models.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫§方法和reward hacking实验；若Pareto构造干净，可借来审视LLM多reward RL的标量化假设。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and reward-hacking experiments; if the Pareto construction is clean, it is a useful stress test for scalarized multi-reward RL in LLMs.

paper.title: Skill-Aligned Annotation for Reliable Evaluation in Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) generation has advanced rapidly, making reliable evaluation critical as performance differences between models narrow. Existing evaluation practices typically apply uniform annotation mechanisms, such as Likert-scale or binary question answering (BQA), across heterogeneous evaluation skills, despite fundamental differences in their nature. In this work, we revisit T2I evaluation through the lens of skill-aligned annotation, where annotation strategies reflect the underlying c

summary.core_problem: 解决 text-to-image 生成评测中不同能力维度使用同一种人工标注协议，导致评测信号不稳定和标注一致性不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型评测协议改进。它不改训练目标或模型结构，但对多模态生成模型的评估可靠性有参考价值，尤其适合需要细粒度 prompt-following 和空间关系评测的场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 skill-aligned annotation 思路，即不同评测技能采用与其性质匹配的标注方式，而不是统一使用 Likert 分数或二元问答。还给出一个自动化流水线，用于生成可扩展的、带空间 grounding 的细粒度反馈。
summary.experiments: 系统比较 skill-aligned annotation 与统一标注 baseline，报告更高的标注者一致性和跨模型稳定性。摘要未给出具体模型列表、样本规模或数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 KAUST；Tong Zhang 是机器学习领域知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies unreliable evaluation in text-to-image generation caused by applying one uniform annotation protocol across heterogeneous evaluation skills.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation-method improvement rather than a modeling or pretraining advance. It is still relevant for multimodal generation because evaluation noise can hide real differences between models as they become closer in quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes skill-aligned annotation: each evaluation skill uses an annotation mechanism suited to its structure instead of relying uniformly on Likert scores or binary QA. The paper also introduces an automated pipeline for scalable, fine-grained evaluation with spatially grounded feedback.
summary_en.experiments: The authors compare skill-aligned annotation against uniform annotation baselines and report higher inter-annotator agreement and better stability across models. The abstract does not provide model names, dataset size, or exact effect sizes.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from KAUST; Tong Zhang is a well-known machine learning researcher.

recommendation.zh: 不是训练论文；若做 T2I/VLM 评测，只看协议设计和一致性分析，别把分数当建模结论。
recommendation.en: Not a training paper; if you run T2I/VLM evals, read the protocol and agreement analysis, not the scores as modeling evidence.

paper.title: EPIC: Efficient Predicate-Guided Inference-Time Control for Compositional Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Recent text-to-image (T2I) generators can synthesize realistic images, but still struggle with compositional prompts involving multiple objects, counts, attributes, and relations. We introduce EPIC (Efficient Predicate-Guided Inference-Time Control), a training-free inference-time refinement framework for compositional T2I generation. EPIC casts refinement as predicate-guided search: it parses the original prompt once into a fixed visual program of object variables and typed predicates, covering

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像模型在组合式提示词中经常弄错对象数量、属性和关系的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理时控制方法，而不是预训练或后训练方法。它对基座研究的间接价值在于：把复杂 prompt 拆成可验证谓词，再用 verifier 指导局部编辑或重采样，这类闭环可作为多模态 RL 或数据合成的弱参考。
summary.technical_approach: EPIC 是 training-free 的 inference-time refinement 框架。它先把 prompt 解析成固定 visual program，包含对象变量和类型化谓词，如存在性、计数、属性和关系。每次生成或编辑后，用图像证据检查所有谓词；局部失败触发 targeted editing，全局失败触发 resampling，整个过程中 visual program 不变。
summary.experiments: 论文在 GenEval2 上报告提升 prompt-level accuracy，但摘要截断，未给出完整数值。方法主要与常规 T2I 推理、重采样和编辑式控制方法比较；摘要未提供模型规模、基础生成器和 verifier 细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 POSTECH Graduate School of Artificial Intelligence。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses failures of text-to-image generators on compositional prompts involving multiple objects, counts, attributes, and relations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time control framework rather than a training or pretraining method. Its indirect relevance is the verifier-driven loop: parse the prompt into predicates, check generated images, and use failures to route edits or resampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: EPIC parses a prompt once into a fixed visual program with object variables and typed predicates. Each generated or edited image is verified against those predicates using visual evidence. Failed local predicates trigger targeted editing, while global failures trigger resampling, without changing the program.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports improved prompt-level accuracy on GenEval2, but the provided abstract is truncated before the exact numbers. It appears to compare against standard generation, resampling, and editing-based control setups; model scale and verifier details are not available in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the Graduate School of Artificial Intelligence at POSTECH.

recommendation.zh: 不必细读生成结果；看 verifier 如何把失败谓词路由到编辑或重采样就够了。
recommendation.en: Skip the image results; the useful bit is how failed predicates route the loop toward editing or resampling.

institutions: Graduate School of Artificial Intelligence, POSTECH

paper.title: When Policy Entropy Constraint Fails: Preserving Diversity in Flow-based RLHF via Perceptual Entropy
paper.abstract: RLHF is widely used to align flow-matching text-to-image models with human preferences, but often leads to severe diversity collapse after fine-tuning. In RL, diversity is often assumed to correlate with policy entropy, motivating entropy regularization. However, we show this intuition breaks in flow models: policy entropy remains constant, even while perceptual diversity collapses. We explain this mismatch both theoretically and empirically: the constant entropy arises from the fixed, pre-defin

summary.core_problem: 解决 Flow-matching 文本到图像模型在 RLHF 微调后出现的严重多样性崩溃问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了在 Flow 模型中，传统的策略熵（Policy Entropy）无法有效表征和维持生成多样性，并提出了新的感知熵（Perceptual Entropy）指标。
summary.technical_approach: 理论和实验证明 Flow 模型的策略熵因固定的噪声调度而保持不变，多样性崩溃源于策略梯度的寻模特性。提出在感知空间中计算的“感知熵”来捕捉多样性，并基于此设计了感知熵约束（PEC）和感知约束策略优化（PCPO）两种正则化策略。
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像生成任务上验证，相比标准 RLHF 方法，所提方法在提升奖励的同时，显著缓解了多样性崩溃。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯优图实验室（Tencent Youtu Lab）及东南大学等机构合作，第一作者在腾讯实习期间完成。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the severe diversity collapse in flow-matching text-to-image models after RLHF fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: Reveals that traditional policy entropy fails to represent and maintain generation diversity in flow models, and proposes a novel Perceptual Entropy metric.
summary_en.technical_approach: Theoretically and empirically demonstrates that policy entropy in flow models remains constant due to fixed noise schedules, while diversity collapse is driven by the mode-seeking nature of policy gradients. Proposes 'Perceptual Entropy' calculated in a perceptual space to capture diversity, and introduces Perceptual Entropy Constraint (PEC) and Perceptual Constrained Policy Optimization (PCPO) regularization strategies.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on text-to-image generation tasks, the proposed methods significantly mitigate diversity collapse while improving rewards compared to standard RLHF.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Tencent Youtu Lab, Southeast University, etc. Work done during the first author's internship at Tencent Youtu Lab.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 Flow 模型做 RLHF 时传统 entropy penalty 失效的机制，对做多模态对齐的同学有一定启发，但对纯文本 LLM 预训练参考价值有限。
recommendation.en: Identifies why traditional entropy penalty fails during RLHF for flow models; insightful for multimodal alignment but of limited relevance to pure text LLM pretraining.

institutions: Southern University of Science and Technology
Work done during Xiaofeng Tan’s internship at Tencent Youtu Lab

paper.title: Flow-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Existing Flow Matching (FM) text-to-image models suffer from two critical bottlenecks under multi-task alignment: the reward sparsity induced by scalar-valued rewards, and the gradient interference arising from jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives, which together give rise to a 'seesaw effect' of competing metrics and pervasive reward hacking. Inspired by the success of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in the large language model community, we propose Flow-OPD, the first unified post-training

summary.core_problem: 现有流匹配（FM）文生图模型在多任务对齐时存在标量奖励稀疏、多目标优化梯度干扰问题，导致性能跷跷板效应与普遍的奖励黑客
summary.importance: 范式迁移创新，首次将LLM领域的On-Policy Distillation（OPD）引入流匹配模型的后训练，提出统一的多任务对齐框架
summary.technical_approach: 提出Flow-OPD两阶段对齐策略：第一阶段通过单奖励GRPO微调训练多个领域专用教师模型，第二阶段经流冷启动、on-policy采样、任务路由三步编排整合异构专家知识到单个学生模型
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置与量化结果，仅说明方法可缓解流匹配多任务对齐的跷跷板效应与奖励黑客问题
summary.authors_note: 中国科学技术大学、加州大学、香港中文大学、小红书联合团队，无公开知名业界研究者背景

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Flow Matching (FM) text-to-image models suffer from scalar reward sparsity and gradient interference in multi-objective optimization during multi-task alignment, leading to performance seesaw effects and pervasive reward hacking
summary_en.importance: Paradigm migration innovation, first introduces On-Policy Distillation (OPD) from LLM field to post-training of Flow Matching models, and proposes a unified multi-task alignment framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Flow-OPD two-stage alignment strategy: first stage trains multiple domain-specialized teacher models via single-reward GRPO fine-tuning; second stage consolidates heterogeneous expertise into one student via three-step orchestration including flow cold start, on-policy sampling and task routing
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup and quantitative results are not disclosed in the abstract, only stated that the method alleviates seesaw effect and reward hacking in Flow Matching multi-task alignment
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from USTC, UC, CUHK, Xiaohongshu Inc, no well-known industry researchers publicly identified

recommendation.zh: 做多模态生成对齐或流匹配训练的可参考其多专家OPD编排思路，纯文本预训练研究员仅需知晓该迁移方向
recommendation.en: Researchers working on multimodal generative alignment or Flow Matching can reference its multi-expert OPD orchestration; pure text LLM pretrain researchers only need awareness of this direction

paper.title: Arena as Offline Reward: Efficient Fine-Grained Preference Optimization for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) effectively promotes preference alignment of text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models. To improve computational efficiency, direct preference optimization (DPO), which avoids explicit reward modeling, has been widely studied. However, its reliance on binary feedback limits it to coarse-grained modeling on chosen-rejected pairs, resulting in suboptimal optimization. In this paper, we propose ArenaPO, which leverages Arena scores as offline rewards to

summary.core_problem: 解决文本到图像扩散模型直接偏好优化依赖二元反馈、建模粒度粗导致优化效果不佳的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将Arena排名得分作为离线奖励引入扩散模型偏好优化，结合RLHF细粒度反馈优势与DPO效率优势
summary.technical_approach: 提出ArenaPO，构建模型竞技场将每个模型能力建模为高斯分布，通过成对偏好标注推断模型能力，将输出图像作为对应能力分布的样本得到细粒度离线奖励，无需显式训练奖励模型
summary.experiments: 在文本到图像生成任务上效果优于基线DPO方法，具体提升幅度未在提供摘要中明确
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中科院自动化所、UC伯克利、UC圣巴巴拉

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the limitation of coarse-grained binary feedback in DPO for text-to-image diffusion model preference alignment, which leads to suboptimal optimization results
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first introduces Arena ranking scores as offline rewards for diffusion model preference optimization, combining fine-grained feedback advantage of RLHF and efficiency of DPO
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ArenaPO, constructs a model arena where each model's capability is modeled as Gaussian distribution, infers capabilities via pairwise preference annotations, treats output images as samples from corresponding capability distributions to get fine-grained offline rewards without explicit reward model training
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms baseline DPO method on text-to-image generation preference alignment tasks, specific improvement metrics are not specified in the given abstract
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Institute of Automation CAS, UC Berkeley, UC Santa Barbara

recommendation.zh: 细粒度偏好优化思路可迁移至LLM DPO改进，仅需看方法核心逻辑，无需深入CV实验细节
recommendation.en: The fine-grained preference optimization idea can be migrated to improve LLM DPO, only read core method logic, skip CV-specific experiment details

paper.title: Diverse Sampling in Diffusion Models with Marginal Preserving Particle Guidance
paper.abstract: We present EDDY (Exact-marginal Diversification via Divergence-free dYnamics), a guidance mechanism for diffusion and flow matching models that promotes diversity among samples generated while maintaining quality. EDDY exploits symmetries of the Fokker-Planck equation, using drift perturbations that change particle trajectories while preserving the evolving marginal distribution. We instantiate this principle through kernel-based anti-symmetric pairwise matrix fields, constructed from the repuls

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散、流匹配模型的引导生成方法难以同时保证样本质量与多样性，高计算量限制其在文生图等复杂场景的应用
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出无需额外训练的多样性引导机制，在不改变样本边际分布的前提下提升生成多样性
summary.technical_approach: 提出EDDY引导框架，利用Fokker-Planck方程的对称性构造无散漂移扰动，调整粒子生成轨迹的同时保留边际分布；针对感知嵌入场景的高计算成本问题设计实用近似方案
summary.experiments: 在合成分布、文生图任务上验证，EDDY可在不降低生成质量的前提下有效提升样本多样性，近似方案计算开销可控

summary_en.core_problem: Existing guidance methods for diffusion and flow matching models fail to balance sample quality and diversity, and high computational cost limits their application in complex scenarios like text-to-image generation
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes a training-free diversity guidance mechanism that improves generation diversity without altering the marginal distribution of samples
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes EDDY guidance framework, exploits symmetries of the Fokker-Planck equation to construct divergence-free drift perturbations, adjusts particle trajectories while preserving marginal distribution; designs practical approximation for high-cost scenarios with perceptual embeddings
summary_en.experiments: Verified on synthetic distributions and text-to-image generation tasks: EDDY improves sample diversity without degrading generation quality, and the approximation has controllable computational overhead

paper.title: Towards General Preference Alignment: Diffusion Models at Nash Equilibrium

paper.title: Large Language Models are Universal Reasoners for Visual Generation
paper.abstract: Text-to-image generation has advanced rapidly with diffusion models, progressing from CLIP and T5 conditioning to unified systems where a single LLM backbone handles both visual understanding and generation. Despite the architectural unification, these systems frequently fail to faithfully align complex prompts during synthesis, even though they remain highly accurate at verifying whether an image satisfies those same prompts. We formalize this as the \emph{understanding-generation gap} and prop

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是“图像生成质量不够”这个泛问题，而是统一多模态生成系统里的一个更具体缺口：同一个 LLM 作为视觉理解器时，往往能较可靠地判断一张图是否满足复杂提示词；但作为生成控制器时，却不能把这种理解能力稳定转化为生成约束，尤其在计数、空间关系、属性绑定、物理合理性这类组合语义上容易失真。作者把它定义为 understanding-generation gap。关键点在于，问题不只是文本条件不强，而是生成阶段缺少一个显式的“中间可检验对象”和“基于该对象的纠错信号”，导致模型只能把所有约束一次性压进扩散条件里，难以把验证能力转成可执行的生成指导。
summary.importance: 对预训练和统一建模研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它给“同一 backbone 同时做理解和生成”这条路线补上了一个很重要的机制视角：架构统一不等于能力自动打通，理解强于生成时，需要显式把 verifier 变成 generator 的控制信号。第二，它提出的不是替换扩散 backbone，而是在冻结生成器的前提下，通过 LLM 产生 draft 和 grounded evaluation 来增强条件，这对已有 AR+diffusion、MLLM+image generator 体系都比较容易嫁接。第三，它把多模态生成问题重新表述成一个更接近 reasoning-guided generation 的范式：先形成粗场景计划，再做自我批判，再把批判结果送入生成器。这种“先判后生”的接口设计，对统一预训练、test-time reasoning、以及后续把 verifier / reward model 接到生成模型上的工作都有启发。量级上，它不是基础架构改写，但属于把统一多模态系统从“共享 backbone”推进到“共享推理闭环”的一类方法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Draft-Evaluate-Diffuse 三阶段流水线，重点不在单个模块新，而在三个条件信号如何互补。

第一步是 Draft。给定文本提示 p，LLM 先生成离散视觉 token 形式的粗草图 d。这里的 draft 不是最终图像，而是一个低保真、场景级别的视觉计划。作者强调必须让 LLM 先落到一个具体视觉实例上，否则后续 evaluation 只能退化成对原 prompt 的改写，缺少 grounded reference。

第二步是 Evaluate。用同一个 LLM 读取原始 prompt 和 draft，对二者是否一致做评估，输出 grounded evaluation e。这个 e 不是泛泛的重写提示词，而是围绕当前 draft 的缺陷给出纠错描述，例如数量不对、关系错位、属性遗漏等。这里的设计抓住了论文最重要的观察：统一模型在“看图判错”上比“直接画对”更可靠，因此应先让它生成一个可批判对象，再把批判结果转成控制信号。

第三步是 Diffuse。冻结扩散模型 SANA，只改条件输入，让扩散过程联合条件于 (p, d, e)。原始 prompt 提供全局语义目标，draft 提供空间锚点和场景布局，evaluation 提供局部纠错指令。作者反复强调三者缺一不可：只看 draft 会继承草图错误；只看 evaluation 而没有 draft，会退化成 prompt rewriting；只看 prompt 则回到标准文本条件扩散，难以处理复杂组合约束。

从方法定位看，它和传统 prompt enhancement 不同，因为 evaluation 是基于具体视觉草图产生的 grounded feedback；也和两阶段 coarse-to-fine 生成不同，因为 refinement 信号不是隐式 latent，而是 LLM 产出的显式语言批注。与把 LLM 直接接到 diffusion cross-attention 的做法相比，这里更像在生成前插入一个 reasoning loop，把“生成失败后容易诊断”的能力前移到生成条件构造阶段。

从预训练研究视角，更值得注意的是它默认了一个能力分工：LLM 负责离散规划与语义校验，diffusion 负责高保真渲染。这种分工比“让单一模型同时学会精细像素生成和复杂组合推理”更现实，也更符合当前统一多模态系统的训练动态。
summary.experiments:
实验结论很直接：在不改动底层扩散 backbone、使用同一个冻结 SANA 的情况下，UniReasoner 主要提升的是复杂提示词对齐，而不是单纯视觉质量。文中给出的核心数字是：GenEval 从 0.79 提升到 0.88，绝对提升 0.09；DPG-Bench 从 84.50 提升到 86.30，提升 1.8 分。前者是更典型的组合对齐评测，因此这个增幅更说明方法确实在修复 understanding-generation gap。

从论文叙述看，作者重点分析了计数、空间关系、物理合理性等失败模式，并展示统一模型在直接生成时会犯错，但在事后评估同一结果时能指出错误。例如 prompt 要求四个苹果，生成出五个，但模型在评估阶段能正确数出五个并识别不匹配。这类案例支撑了方法假设，而不是只靠 benchmark 分数。

消融层面，最关键的比较应是：只用 prompt、prompt+draft、prompt+evaluation、prompt+draft+evaluation。论文主张联合条件最好，原因是 draft 和 evaluation 分别承担“视觉锚定”和“纠错说明”两种不同信息。如果只加 draft，生成器会被错误草图牵着走；如果只加 evaluation，则缺少具体空间参照，纠错信号不够落地。虽然给出的全文片段没有列出全部表格数字，但从方法论证和主结果可以确定，性能提升主要来自这两个条件的互补，而不是单纯增加 token 数量。

另一个值得注意的实验设定是 frozen SANA。这意味着收益主要来自条件构造与推理链路，而不是通过联合训练把生成器重新适配新条件。这个设定让结果更干净，也更说明该方法可作为现有 T2I 系统的外挂式增强模块。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 里 Figure 1 对 understanding-generation gap 的例子。那一页基本决定这篇工作的价值：如果认同“模型会判不会画”是统一生成系统的真实瓶颈，后面的设计就顺理成章。

然后重点读 Method 的三段：Draft、Evaluate、Diffuse。阅读时不要只看流程图，要抓住作者为什么坚持需要 grounded evaluation，而不是直接做 prompt rewriting。这里是方法和已有 prompt engineering / self-refinement 工作的真正分界线。

实验部分优先看两类内容。第一类是 GenEval、DPG-Bench 的主表，确认收益集中在哪些组合约束。第二类是案例分析和消融，尤其是去掉 draft 或去掉 evaluation 后的失败样例。那部分最能说明三种条件信号各自承担什么角色。

如果要深挖，建议追三个问题。1）draft 的离散视觉 token 质量是否形成上限，若 draft 太差，evaluation 是否还能稳定纠错；2）evaluation 的文本长度、粒度、措辞是否影响扩散器吸收纠错信号；3）这种 pipeline 是否能进一步闭环成多轮 draft-evaluate-refine，而不是单轮。真正有研究空间的地方不在“再加一个模块”，而在如何把 verifier 信号更稳定地转成 generator 可利用的训练或推理接口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in unified multimodal generation systems: the same LLM is often much better at verifying whether an image satisfies a complex prompt than at generating such an image in the first place. The gap shows up on counting, attribute binding, spatial relations, and physical plausibility. The authors call this the understanding-generation gap. Their claim is not merely that text conditioning is weak, but that current generation pipelines lack an explicit intermediate visual object to inspect and an explicit corrective signal derived from that inspection. As a result, all constraints are compressed into one-shot conditioning for diffusion, which is a poor interface for compositional control.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and unified modeling, the contribution is meaningful in three ways. First, it sharpens an important distinction: sharing one backbone across understanding and generation does not automatically transfer the stronger capability into the weaker one. If verification is stronger than direct synthesis, the system needs an explicit mechanism to turn verifier signals into generator control. Second, the method is lightweight from a systems perspective. It keeps the diffusion backbone frozen and improves conditioning through an LLM-produced draft plus grounded evaluation, which makes it easy to attach to existing LLM+diffusion or native multimodal generation stacks. Third, it reframes image generation as reasoning-guided generation: produce a coarse plan, critique it, then render with explicit corrections. That interface is relevant beyond T2I. It suggests a general route for connecting verifiers, reward models, or reasoning modules to generative backbones without retraining the whole system.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a three-stage Draft-Evaluate-Diffuse pipeline. The novelty is less about any single component and more about how the three conditioning signals complement each other.

Stage 1 is Draft. Given a prompt p, the LLM generates a coarse visual draft d in the form of discrete vision tokens. This draft is not treated as the final image. It is a low-fidelity scene plan. The paper argues that this step is necessary because, without a concrete visual instance, later evaluation would collapse into generic prompt rewriting rather than grounded diagnosis.

Stage 2 is Evaluate. The same LLM takes the original prompt and the draft, compares them, and outputs a grounded evaluation e: a concise textual description of what is wrong or missing in the draft. This is the key move in the paper. The system exploits the empirical asymmetry that the unified model is better at post hoc diagnosis than at one-shot generation. Instead of asking the model to satisfy all constraints directly, it first asks it to create something inspectable and then to critique that object.

Stage 3 is Diffuse. A frozen SANA diffusion model is conditioned jointly on (p, d, e). The prompt provides the global semantic target, the draft provides a spatial anchor and scene layout, and the evaluation provides localized corrective instructions. The paper repeatedly argues that these signals are complementary: draft alone would preserve its own mistakes, evaluation alone without a visual anchor would reduce to prompt rewriting, and prompt alone returns to the standard text-conditioned diffusion setup.

Relative to prior work, this is not just prompt enhancement, because the evaluation is grounded in a specific visual draft. It is also different from generic coarse-to-fine generation, because the refinement signal is explicit language feedback rather than an implicit latent refinement path. From a pretraining perspective, the method also encodes a practical division of labor: the LLM handles discrete planning and semantic verification, while diffusion handles high-fidelity rendering. That division is more realistic than expecting one model to jointly master fine-grained pixel synthesis and compositional reasoning at the same level.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is clear: with the same frozen SANA diffusion backbone, UniReasoner improves prompt faithfulness rather than merely image quality. The headline numbers reported in the paper are 0.79 to 0.88 on GenEval, an absolute gain of 0.09, and 84.50 to 86.30 on DPG-Bench, a gain of 1.8 points. The larger signal on GenEval is especially important because that benchmark stresses compositional alignment.

The paper also provides qualitative evidence for the central hypothesis. Typical examples include counting failures where the model generates five apples for a prompt asking for four, yet correctly identifies the mismatch when asked to evaluate the generated image. Similar patterns appear for spatial relations and physical plausibility. These examples matter because they validate the claimed asymmetry directly, rather than relying only on benchmark aggregates.

The most important ablations are the conditioning variants: prompt only, prompt plus draft, prompt plus evaluation, and prompt plus both. The paper’s argument is that the full combination works best because draft and evaluation carry different information: visual anchoring versus explicit correction. Draft alone can lock the generator into the draft’s mistakes; evaluation alone lacks a concrete spatial reference. Even though the provided excerpt does not include every table entry, the logic of the ablation and the reported gains strongly suggest that the improvement comes from complementary conditioning rather than from simply adding more tokens.

Another important design choice is the frozen generator. Since SANA is not retrained, the gains can be attributed mainly to the reasoning and conditioning interface, which makes the result cleaner and more transferable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the motivating example around the understanding-generation gap. That example is the paper’s foundation. If the asymmetry feels real, the rest of the design becomes easy to follow.

Then read the method section with one question in mind: why is grounded evaluation necessary, instead of plain prompt rewriting or self-refinement text? The answer defines the paper’s real contribution. The draft is not there for quality; it is there to create an inspectable object. The evaluation is not there to paraphrase the prompt; it is there to produce actionable corrections tied to that object.

In the experiments, prioritize two things. First, the main benchmark tables on GenEval and DPG-Bench, especially where the gains concentrate. Second, the ablations and failure cases when draft or evaluation is removed. Those parts reveal the role of each conditioning signal.

For deeper study, three questions are worth tracking. How sensitive is the method to draft quality? How much does the wording and granularity of the evaluation affect diffusion guidance? And can the single-pass pipeline be extended into a multi-round draft-critique-refine loop? Those are the places where the idea could evolve into a broader training or inference framework.

recommendation.zh: 读框架图和消融即可；它把 LLM 放在 draft-critique-control 环里，比单纯加大条件编码器更像可复用接口。
recommendation.en: Read the framework and ablations; putting the LLM in a draft-critique-control loop is a more reusable interface than merely scaling the conditioning encoder.

paper.title: The Thinking Pixel: Recursive Sparse Reasoning in Multimodal Diffusion Latents
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved success in high-fidelity data synthesis, yet their capacity for more complex, structured reasoning like text following tasks remains constrained. While advances in language models have leveraged strategies such as latent reasoning and recursion to enhance text understanding capabilities, extending these to multimodal text-to-image generation tasks is challenging due to the continuous and non-discrete nature of visual tokens. To tackle this problem, we draw inspirat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何把扩散模型做得更大”，而是一个更具体的问题：扩散式文生图模型在复杂文本约束下，往往缺少类似语言模型那种可递归、可分步的内部推理过程，因此对结构布局、对象关系和细粒度文本跟随的处理不稳定。作者关注的是 joint attention 这一层里视觉 token 与文本 token 对齐的关键位置，试图让模型在一次去噪步内部再做多次轻量递归更新，而不是只靠单次前向把跨模态对齐一次性做完。难点在于视觉 latent 是连续表示，不像离散文本 token 那样容易做显式 reasoning；如果直接堆更多层或更多 denoising steps，计算代价又很高，且不一定把额外算力用在真正需要推敲的局部结构上。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不算强，因为主体仍是文生图扩散模型，而不是语言模型预训练范式本身。但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把“latent reasoning / recursive computation”从文本域迁到连续视觉 latent，并且不是简单加深网络，而是在条件对齐最关键的模块里做稀疏递归，这对研究非 AR 建模、diffusion LM、以及 test-time / train-time adaptive compute 有参考意义。第二，它把 MoE 路由、Gumbel-Softmax 稀疏选择、adapter 化轻量递归三者结合，展示了一种在大 backbone 上插入可控额外计算的方式。贡献量级更像方法探索而不是范式改写，适合把它当成“连续 latent 上如何做稀疏递归推理”的案例来读。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把一个递归稀疏模块插入到 diffusion transformer，尤其是 SD3 这类 MMDiT block 的 joint attention 部分。作者的判断是：joint attention 负责文本-视觉结构对齐，若要提升复杂 prompt 的遵循能力，最值得加计算的地方不是所有层平均加深，而是这些负责跨模态结构建模的层。

具体做法分三层。第一层是 recursive sparse reasoning。给定当前视觉 token、扩散 timestep、以及条件信息（类别标签或文本 embedding），模型在一个 block 内执行多个 latent recursion steps。每一步并不启用完整新子网络，而是从一组共享 neural modules 中稀疏选出少量模块，对视觉 token 做迭代细化。这样做的目的，是让不同递归步或不同 token 区域可以调用不同“功能模块”，形成某种分工，而不是所有样本都走同一条固定计算路径。

第二层是 sparse routing 与可学习专家分化。作者没有用普通 soft mixture，而是引入 Gumbel-Softmax 近似离散选择，并采用 winner-takes-all 式梯度分配，让被选中的模块得到更明确的训练信号。这样做是为了避免软路由下所有模块都学成平均化残差修正器，难以形成真正 specialization。路由条件不仅看视觉 token，还看 diffusion timestep 和文本条件，这意味着专家选择既依赖当前图像状态，也依赖生成阶段和语义约束。

第三层是 mixture-of-adapters 与 recursive adapter updates。作者没有为每个递归步复制完整 attention/MLP，而是用 adapter 形式承载递归更新，并在多步递归中累积这些 adapter 输出。这样把额外参数和计算压到较低水平，适合在已有 DiT/SD3 上做微调式改造，而不是从头训练一个大得多的模型。

从设计取舍看，这套方法和“直接增加 denoising steps”不同，后者把更多计算平均分配到整个采样轨迹；这里则是在单步内部、在跨模态对齐关键层、按条件稀疏分配计算。它也不同于标准 MoE FFN，因为这里的专家调用带有递归时间维度，目标不是单层容量扩展，而是多次内部状态修正。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的实验主要分三块。第一块是 class-conditioned ImageNet generation，在 DiT 设置下用 FID、sFID、IS、precision、recall 评估。作者声称递归稀疏模块在相近或更低额外计算下优于常规基线，说明收益不只是来自参数增加，而是来自把计算放在更合适的位置。第二块是 text-to-image，对 SD3 类模型在 GenEval 上评估文本-图像对齐，重点看复杂 prompt 的遵循。文中还提到 DPG 等文本跟随评测，结论是递归细化能改善结构布局和语义一致性。第三块是分析实验，包括 token trajectory visualization，用来展示不同模块在递归过程中出现功能分化，这部分是理解方法是否真的学到 specialization 的关键证据。

不过，从给出的全文片段看，具体数字、参数规模、递归步数、专家数、训练 token / 图像规模等细节没有完整展开，至少当前材料里无法可靠复述精确提升幅度。能确认的是：作者先在较简单的 class-conditioned DiT 上验证，再扩展到更复杂的 SD3；并且强调 sparse activation of lightweight shared modules 带来更好的计算-效果折中。若要判断方法是否扎实，必须去看主表里相对基线的绝对提升是否稳定，以及消融里“递归本身”“稀疏路由”“Gumbel winner-take-all”“adapter 累积”各自贡献多少。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，不建议投入精读级时间。优先看三处。第一，看方法图和 joint attention 改造公式，确认递归到底发生在 block 内、denoising step 内，还是采样轨迹层面；这是理解它和普通多步采样区别的关键。第二，看消融表，重点找四个问题：不用递归只加 adapter 是否还能提升；不用稀疏路由是否退化；Gumbel-Softmax 是否真的让专家更分化；递归步数增加后收益是否饱和。第三，看可视化部分，判断所谓“thinking pixel”是否只是命名包装，还是确实出现了与布局、对象关系、文本属性相关的模块专门化。

如果只从预训练研究角度取材，阅读时间控制在 20 到 30 分钟即可。重点不是记住具体架构细节，而是抓住一个思路：在连续 latent 生成模型里，如何把额外计算做成条件化、稀疏化、递归化，而不是简单堆深度或堆采样步数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific weakness of diffusion-based text-to-image models: they generate high-quality images, but their internal computation is still weak at structured, multi-step reasoning under complex textual constraints. In practice, text-image alignment inside diffusion transformers is often handled in a single forward pass per denoising step, which makes object relations, layout constraints, and fine-grained prompt following brittle. The authors ask whether diffusion models can benefit from an internal recursive reasoning process, similar in spirit to latent reasoning in language models, but adapted to continuous visual latents rather than discrete text tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core LLM pretraining paper, so its direct relevance to foundation-language-model pretraining is limited. Still, it is useful for two reasons. First, it explores recursive latent computation in a continuous multimodal setting, which is relevant to diffusion LM, non-AR modeling, and adaptive compute research. Second, it combines sparse routing, Gumbel-based hard selection, and lightweight adapter-style recursion in a way that may transfer to other foundation-model settings. The contribution is better viewed as a design pattern for inserting targeted extra computation into a large pretrained backbone, rather than a broad shift in modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method inserts a recursive sparse reasoning module into diffusion transformers, with particular focus on the joint attention blocks of MMDiT-style architectures such as SD3. The key design choice is to spend extra computation where text and visual latents are structurally aligned, instead of uniformly deepening the whole network.

The first component is recursive latent refinement. Within a block, the model performs multiple latent recursion steps. At each step, it updates visual tokens using a small set of shared neural modules rather than a full new transformer block. The routing decision depends on the current visual tokens, the diffusion timestep, and the conditioning signal such as class labels or text embeddings. This gives the model a conditional internal computation path instead of a fixed one.

The second component is sparse expert routing. Rather than using a soft mixture over all modules, the paper uses Gumbel-Softmax to approximate discrete selection and allocates gradients in a winner-takes-all manner. The motivation is clear: soft routing often leads to averaged experts with weak specialization, while harder selection encourages distinct module roles to emerge.

The third component is a mixture-of-adapters design with recursive adapter updates. Instead of duplicating full attention or MLP layers for each recursion step, the recursive computation is carried by lightweight adapters whose outputs are accumulated across steps. This keeps parameter and compute overhead manageable and makes the method suitable for adaptation on top of existing DiT or SD3 backbones.

Conceptually, this differs from simply increasing denoising steps. More denoising steps spread compute across the whole sampling trajectory, while this method concentrates extra compute inside alignment-critical layers and allocates it sparsely. It also differs from standard MoE FFNs, because the experts here are used across recursive latent steps, not just as a wider feed-forward layer.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around three settings. First, class-conditional ImageNet generation with DiT-style models, evaluated by FID, sFID, IS, precision, and recall. The claimed result is that recursive sparse reasoning improves generation quality under a favorable compute trade-off, suggesting the gain is not just from adding parameters. Second, text-to-image evaluation on SD3-like models using GenEval and related prompt-following benchmarks such as DPG, where the method is reported to improve semantic alignment and structural consistency under complex prompts. Third, the paper includes analysis experiments such as token trajectory visualizations, intended to show that different modules specialize during recursive refinement.

That said, the provided full-text excerpt does not expose enough reliable numeric detail to restate exact gains, model sizes, recursion depth, number of experts, or training scale. What can be stated safely is that the paper validates the idea first on simpler class-conditioned DiTs and then extends it to SD3, while emphasizing sparse activation of lightweight shared modules as the main efficiency mechanism. The most important thing to verify in the actual tables is whether the gains remain stable after controlling for added compute, and how much each ingredient contributes in ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, not a must-read. Focus on three parts. First, inspect the architecture figure and the equations around the modified joint attention block. You want to pin down exactly where recursion happens: inside a block, inside a denoising step, or across the sampling trajectory. Second, read the ablations with four questions in mind: does recursion help beyond simply adding adapters; does sparse routing matter; does Gumbel hard selection actually improve specialization; and where do returns saturate as recursion depth increases. Third, check the visualization section carefully. The paper’s central claim is not just better scores, but that recursive sparse modules develop differentiated roles tied to layout and prompt semantics.

For a pretraining-oriented reader, 20 to 30 minutes is enough. The main takeaway is a modeling idea: in continuous latent generative models, extra compute can be made conditional, sparse, and recursive instead of being spent through uniform depth or more sampling steps.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和 ablation；若递归步数带来真实组合泛化，而非只加算力，这是视觉 latent reasoning 的有用信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations; if recursive steps improve compositional generalization beyond extra compute, it is a useful signal for visual latent reasoning.
