paper.title: Refinement via Regeneration: Enlarging Modification Space Boosts Image Refinement in Unified Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding and generation within a single framework. For text-to-image (T2I) tasks, this unified capability allows UMMs to refine outputs after their initial generation, potentially extending the performance upper bound. Current UMM-based refinement methods primarily follow a refinement-via-editing (RvE) paradigm, where UMMs produce editing instructions to modify misaligned regions while preserving aligned content. However, editing instruction

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态模型（UMM）做 T2I 生成时，如何把“初次生成的图”进一步提升到更高的 prompt 对齐上限。论文指出主流的“先理解差异→生成编辑指令→局部编辑”(RvE) 会被两类约束卡住：编辑指令对 mismatch 的描述天然粗糙且不完备；编辑任务要求未编辑区域像素级保持，导致可修改空间过小，难以做结构性修正（多物体、关系、布局类 prompt 尤其明显）。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性中等：它不是在改预训练目标或数据配比，而是在“统一生成/理解模型”的推理与训练数据构造上，给出一种更贴近生成建模本质的 refinement 形式。启发点在于：当模型同时具备理解与生成能力时，很多“编辑式”中间表征（指令、mask、局部约束）可能是人为加的瓶颈；把 refinement 重新表述为条件生成，并在训练监督里显式放松像素一致性约束，能显著抬高对齐上限。这对 AR+diffusion/flow 的统一建模路线（UMM 里既有 ViT 语义 token，也有 VAE latent/flow matching）在“训练信号如何定义”上有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Refinement via Regeneration (RvR)：不再生成编辑指令，也不再把输入图的 VAE latent 作为强条件去做局部编辑；而是把 refinement 当成“再生成一遍”的条件生成问题，条件只保留输入图的高层语义（ViT semantic tokens）+ 目标 prompt。关键设计是扩大 modification space：
1) 数据层面：监督不再来自严格的 editing pair（同一张图的前后编辑），而来自“同一 prompt 下独立采样得到的不同对齐程度样本”。用对齐更好的样本作为目标，让模型学会从一个较差样本的语义表征出发，生成更符合 prompt 的新图；因为目标图不要求与源图像素对应，训练信号天然鼓励结构性修正。
2) 管线层面：丢弃像素级 VAE conditioning（避免把模型锁死在外观保持上），只用 ViT 语义 token 作为对输入图的表征，让模型在语义约束下自由重排布局/对象数量/关系。
整体上，这是把“编辑问题”改写为“带语义参考的条件生成”，用更弱的保持约束换取更大的可行解空间，从而提升复杂 prompt 的对齐。
summary.experiments: 论文在多个 prompt 对齐基准上报告显著提升，核心数字包括：Geneval 0.78→0.91；DPGBench 84.02→87.21；UniGenBench++ 61.53→77.41。文中强调提升主要来自语义复杂 prompt（多对象、属性、关系）场景，符合“放松像素一致性→允许结构性改动”的动机。当前给出的全文片段未包含更细的消融表（例如：仅换数据监督/仅去 VAE conditioning/不同 ViT token 注入方式/迭代次数与收益曲线/与 RvE 的公平计算预算对比），这些需要在方法与实验章节对照确认。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看方法部分对 RvE 两个瓶颈的论证：编辑指令的信息瓶颈与像素保持带来的可行域收缩，理解它为何会限制上限。
- 重点看“训练监督如何构造”的细节：独立采样的正负（或差/好）样本如何配对、对齐程度如何度量/筛选、是否引入偏差（例如只学会向某类风格/构图坍缩）。
- 再看“去 VAE conditioning 只用 ViT token”的实现：ViT token 注入到 backbone 的位置、是否做 cross-attn、是否冻结 ViT、以及这对保真度/多样性的影响。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟抓主线；若要复现或迁移到其它 UMM，再额外 30–60 分钟细读数据构造与训练细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to push prompt-image alignment beyond the ceiling of editing-based refinement in unified multimodal models (UMMs). The paper argues that the dominant “refine via editing” pipeline is bottlenecked by (1) lossy intermediate edit instructions that only partially describe mismatches, and (2) the pixel-level preservation constraint inherent to editing, which shrinks the feasible modification space and prevents structural fixes for complex prompts (multi-object, attributes, relations, layout).
summary_en.importance: Moderate relevance to pretraining-centric readers: it does not introduce a new pretraining objective or scaling result, but it is a meaningful re-formulation of refinement for UMMs that jointly do understanding + generation (often with ViT semantic tokens plus VAE/flow latents). The key takeaway is about training signal design: when a model can re-generate conditioned on semantics, forcing an editing-style intermediate representation and strict pixel consistency can be an artificial ceiling. Relaxing those constraints in supervision and conditioning can materially improve alignment on hard prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Refinement via Regeneration (RvR): treat refinement as another round of conditional generation rather than instruction-driven local editing. Conditioning uses the target prompt plus high-level semantic tokens (ViT features) extracted from the initial image; importantly, it drops pixel-level VAE-latent conditioning to avoid anchoring the output to the original appearance.
Two mechanisms enlarge the effective modification space:
1) Data/supervision: build training pairs from independently generated T2I samples under the same prompt with different alignment quality, instead of true editing pairs. The target (better-aligned) image is not required to be a pixel-consistent edit of the source (worse-aligned) image, so the model is rewarded for semantic correction even if it requires global restructuring.
2) Pipeline: rely on semantic ViT representations only, enabling broad revisions guided by semantics rather than appearance preservation.
Overall, it reframes refinement as “semantic-reference conditional generation”.
summary_en.experiments: Reported gains on alignment-focused benchmarks are large: Geneval improves from 0.78 to 0.91; DPGBench from 84.02 to 87.21; UniGenBench++ from 61.53 to 77.41. The narrative attributes the biggest improvements to semantically complex prompts where structural changes are needed. The provided full-text excerpt does not include detailed ablations (e.g., supervision-only vs conditioning-only, iteration count vs gains, compute-matched comparisons to RvE), which should be verified in the main experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the motivation section that pinpoints the two ceilings of RvE (instruction bottleneck and pixel-preservation constraint).
- Focus on how supervision pairs are constructed from independently sampled images: how “better aligned” is defined/filtered, and whether this introduces mode/style bias.
- Check the implementation details of using ViT semantic tokens without VAE conditioning: where tokens are injected, whether the encoder is frozen, and the impact on fidelity/diversity.
Time: ~20–30 minutes for the main idea; add ~30–60 minutes if you want to reproduce or port it to another UMM.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和失败案例即可；它提醒 UMM 生成闭环里，过强 preservation 约束会限制纠错空间。
recommendation.en: Read the method and failure cases; the useful signal is that strong preservation constraints can choke the correction space in UMM generation loops.

paper.title: Golden RPG: Confidence-Adaptive Region-Aware Noise for Compositional Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Compositional text-to-image (T2I) generation requires a model to honour multiple sub-prompts that describe distinct image regions. Recent work shows that the \emph{starting noise} of a diffusion model carries significant semantic information: ``golden'' noise predicted from text can substantially raise prompt fidelity. We observe that this noise prediction is, however, fundamentally global: the same network is asked to summarise a long, multi-region prompt with a single text embedding, which bec

summary.core_problem: 解决组合式文本到图像生成中，多区域、多实体 prompt 难以被同一个全局起始噪声充分表达的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成方法改进。它把“文本预测起始噪声”从全局条件扩展到区域条件，对理解扩散模型起始噪声中的语义承载有一定参考价值，但不直接涉及 LLM 预训练或统一建模。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Golden RPG，在冻结的 NPNet 噪声预测器上加入两个可训练模块：按区域 sub-prompt 调制噪声的 FiLM adapter，以及插入 Swin backbone 中间层的 Region Cross-Attention，使不同空间位置能关注不同文本片段。方法属于在既有 T2I 扩散生成框架上的区域条件化改造。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、训练数据、baseline 名单和定量提升。可确认实验目标是提升组合式 T2I 的 prompt fidelity，尤其是空间分离实体和多区域描述的遵循能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets compositional text-to-image generation where a single global predicted starting noise fails to represent long prompts with multiple spatially separated regions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a method-level improvement for multimodal generation. It is useful as a signal about how semantic information is encoded in diffusion initial noise, but it does not directly inform LLM pretraining or unified language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Golden RPG extends a frozen NPNet noise predictor with two trainable components: per-region FiLM adapters that modulate predicted noise according to sub-prompts, and a Region Cross-Attention layer inserted into the Swin backbone so different spatial locations attend to different prompt tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full model scale, training data, baseline list, or numeric gains. The evaluation is centered on compositional T2I prompt fidelity, especially for multi-region and spatially separated entities.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图即可；它说明 diffusion 初始噪声可被区域化控制，但离统一预训练范式还有距离。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram only; it is a useful hint about region-conditioned diffusion noise, not a pretraining-level result.

paper.title: Benchmarking Layout-Guided Diffusion Models through Unified Semantic-Spatial Evaluation in Closed and Open Settings
paper.abstract: Evaluating layout-guided text-to-image generative models requires assessing both semantic alignment with textual prompts and spatial fidelity to prescribed layouts. Assessing layout alignment requires collecting fine-grained annotations, which is costly and labor-intensive. Consequently, current benchmarks rarely provide comprehensive layout evaluation and often remain limited in scale or coverage, making model comparison, ranking, and interpretation difficult. In this work, we introduce a close

summary.core_problem: 评估 layout-guided text-to-image diffusion 模型时，现有指标难以同时衡量文本语义对齐和空间布局一致性，且细粒度标注成本较高。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型评测 benchmark。它把封闭集合的可控能力测试和开放集合的真实场景测试放在同一评估框架下，试图让不同布局引导生成模型的比较更稳定。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 C-Bench 和 O-Bench：C-Bench 用受控 prompt 与 layout 隔离不同生成能力，O-Bench 用真实 prompt 和 layout 测量开放场景表现；同时设计统一评估协议，把语义准确性与空间准确性合成为单一得分。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出被评估模型清单、数据规模或具体排名结果，只说明 benchmark 覆盖不同 prompt 结构和 layout 复杂度，并用于模型比较、排序和解释。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Padova。摘要中没有显示与 LLM 基座或大型多模态预训练团队的直接关联。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets evaluation of layout-guided text-to-image diffusion models, where semantic prompt alignment and spatial layout fidelity are both required but expensive to annotate at scale.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a generation-model benchmark. It combines controlled closed-set testing with open-set real-world evaluation, aiming to make comparisons among layout-guided generators more consistent.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce C-Bench for controlled prompts and layouts, O-Bench for real-world prompts and layouts, and a unified evaluation protocol that merges semantic and spatial accuracy into one score.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the evaluated model list, benchmark size, or numerical leaderboards. It states that the benchmarks vary prompt structure and layout complexity and support model ranking and interpretation.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Padova. The abstract does not indicate a direct connection to LLM foundation-model pretraining groups.

recommendation.zh: 这是生成评测工具，不会改变预训练判断；若关心图像 token 或统一生成评估，看指标定义即可。
recommendation.en: This is an evaluation artifact, not a pretraining signal; skim the metric design only if layout control matters to your multimodal pipeline.

paper.title: TextGround4M: A Prompt-Aligned Dataset for Layout-Aware Text Rendering
paper.abstract: Despite recent advances in text-to-image generation, models still struggle to accurately render prompt-specified text with correct spatial layout -- especially in multi-span, structured settings. This challenge is driven not only by the lack of datasets that align prompts with the exact text and layout expected in the image, but also by the absence of effective metrics for evaluating layout quality. To address these issues, we introduce TextGround4M, a large-scale dataset of over 4 million promp

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是文生图模型的文字渲染与布局对齐问题：模型不仅要生成正确的文字内容，还要把 prompt 中指定的多个文本片段放在正确空间位置。现有数据通常只有 OCR 文本或框，缺少“prompt 中哪段指令对应图中哪段文字和位置”的显式对齐。
summary.importance: 这项工作与 LLM 预训练的交集在于 AR 图像生成和统一多模态建模的数据监督。TextGround4M 提供了 span-level 文本内容、prompt grounding 和 bounding box 的联合标注，可作为训练 autoregressive T2I 或 Chameleon/Janus 这类统一模型的高质量视觉文本数据。它的价值不在通用语言能力，而在提醒多模态预训练数据需要更细的条件—内容—空间三元对齐；仅靠图文 caption 对很难学好精确文本渲染。
summary.technical_approach: TextGround4M 包含约 4.1M prompt-image pairs，每个样本标注 prompt 所蕴含的可见文字 span 及其 bounding boxes。数据管线从 11.7M 原始图文对开始，其中约 8M 来自公开数据集，包括 Mario10M、Anyword3M、TextScenesHQ 等，另有约 3.7M 来自 CommonCrawl 挖掘。作者使用 GPT-4o 构造领域—主题—子主题层级查询，用于补充公开数据中不足的文本密集和结构化场景；再结合 OCR、VLM captioning、规则对齐、合并和多阶段质量过滤，筛出 prompt-grounded 文本 span。训练方法是 Layout-posting：针对 AR T2I 模型，在训练时先预测 image tokens，再把结构化布局 token 作为后续 autoregressive target，包括渲染短语和坐标。这样不改模型结构，也不在推理时增加额外输入；布局监督作为训练期的隐式约束进入模型。
summary.experiments: 工作构造了按文本 span 数量和 prompt 复杂度分层的 benchmark，并提出两个 layout-aware 指标，用于评估文字内容保真和空间位置质量。作者在 Janus-Pro 上验证 Layout-posting，称其能带来接近 pre-layout 方式的改进，同时保持自由形式输入，不增加推理开销。给出的内容没有包含具体指标表和数值提升，因此需要在全文实验部分确认：商业模型和开源模型的差距、Janus-Pro 微调后的 OCR 准确率、布局指标变化，以及多 span 场景下性能下降曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看数据构建流程图和过滤规则，判断标注噪声是否可控；再看 Layout-posting 的 token 格式，确认坐标离散化、span 顺序和 image token 之后追加监督的训练细节。实验部分重点看新指标定义、难度分层 benchmark，以及 Janus-Pro 的主结果和消融。对预训练研究更有用的是数据 schema 和训练目标，而不是海报生成这类应用场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses prompt-grounded text rendering in text-to-image models. The model must render the specified text correctly and place multiple text spans at the intended locations. Existing datasets often provide OCR text or boxes, but they do not explicitly align prompt phrases with the corresponding rendered text and spatial regions.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining lies in data supervision for autoregressive image generation and unified multimodal modeling. TextGround4M provides joint supervision over text spans, prompt grounding, and bounding boxes, which is useful for AR T2I models and unified systems such as Chameleon- or Janus-style models. The main lesson is that multimodal pretraining data needs fine-grained condition-content-space alignment; generic image-caption pairs are too weak for precise text rendering.
summary_en.technical_approach: TextGround4M contains about 4.1M prompt-image pairs. Each sample annotates visible text spans entailed by the prompt and their bounding boxes. The pipeline starts from 11.7M raw image-text pairs: around 8M from public sources such as Mario10M, Anyword3M, and TextScenesHQ, plus about 3.7M mined from CommonCrawl. GPT-4o is used to expand a domain-topic-subtopic taxonomy into search queries, improving coverage of text-rich and structurally diverse scenes. OCR, VLM captioning, rule-based alignment, merging, and multi-stage filtering are then used to identify prompt-grounded text spans. The training method, Layout-posting, targets AR T2I models. During training, the model first predicts image tokens and then predicts structured layout tokens containing rendered phrases and coordinates. This adds layout supervision without architectural changes and without extra inference-time inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The work builds a difficulty-aware benchmark stratified by the number of text spans and prompt complexity, and introduces two layout-aware metrics for evaluating content fidelity and spatial quality. Experiments are reported on Janus-Pro. Layout-posting is described as achieving improvements comparable to pre-layout supervision while preserving free-form input and adding no inference overhead. The provided content does not include the exact metric values, so the main tables to check are the open-source versus commercial model comparison, OCR/text accuracy, layout metric changes after Janus-Pro training, and degradation under multi-span prompts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the data construction figure and filtering rules to assess annotation noise. Then read the Layout-posting token format: coordinate discretization, span ordering, and how layout targets are appended after image tokens. In the experiments, focus on the metric definitions, difficulty-stratified benchmark, Janus-Pro main results, and ablations. For pretraining research, the useful parts are the data schema and the training objective rather than the poster-design application setting.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座 pretrain 主线，但数据接口设计很干净；若你做统一 AR 多模态，重点看 span token 这套最小侵入式训练改法。
recommendation.en: Not core foundation-model pretraining, but the data interface is clean; if you work on unified AR multimodal models, focus on the minimally invasive span-token training trick.

paper.title: $Z^2$-Sampling: Zero-Cost Zigzag Trajectories for Semantic Alignment in Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved unprecedented success in text-aligned generation, largely driven by Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). However, standard CFG operates strictly on instantaneous gradients, omitting the intrinsic curvature of the data manifold. Recent methods like Zigzag-sampling (Z-Sampling) explicitly traverse multi-step forward-backward trajectories to probe this curvature, significantly improving semantic alignment. Yet, these explicit traversals triple the Neural Function Evaluatio

summary.core_problem: 解决 text-to-image diffusion 采样中语义对齐和采样成本的冲突：显式 Zigzag-sampling 能利用轨迹曲率，但需要约 3 倍 NFE 并引入 off-manifold 误差。
summary.importance: 贡献是 diffusion 采样方法改进，偏理论化地尝试把显式前向-后向 zigzag 轨迹化简成零额外成本的隐式更新。它对图像生成采样和 guidance 机制有参考价值，但不是语言建模或基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Implicit Z-Sampling / Z²-Sampling，声称通过算子对偶性把 zigzag 中间状态代数消去，从而避免显式多步前向-后向遍历；目标是在保留曲率感知语义对齐收益的同时，把额外 NFE 降到理论下界，并减少 off-manifold 近似带来的累计漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集和指标。论文声称相对标准 CFG 可改善语义对齐，相对显式 Z-Sampling 可避免约 3 倍 NFE 成本和截断误差；需要查看实验部分确认是否覆盖主流 text-to-image 模型、不同 guidance scale 和采样步数。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构包括 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)、Griffith University 和 Data61/CSIRO。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tradeoff between semantic alignment and sampling cost in text-to-image diffusion: explicit Zigzag-sampling can probe trajectory curvature, but it costs roughly 3x NFE and introduces off-manifold truncation error.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a diffusion sampling method with a theoretical flavor: reducing explicit forward-backward zigzag trajectories to a zero-extra-cost implicit update. It is relevant to image-generation sampling and guidance mechanisms, but not directly to language-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Implicit Z-Sampling / Z²-Sampling. The claimed idea is to algebraically eliminate intermediate zigzag states through operator dualities, avoiding explicit multi-step forward-backward traversal. The goal is to retain curvature-aware semantic alignment while reducing extra NFE to the theoretical lower bound and avoiding accumulated off-manifold drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list concrete models, datasets, or metric numbers. It claims better semantic alignment than standard CFG and lower cost/error than explicit Z-Sampling, which reportedly requires around 3x NFE. The experimental section would need to be checked for coverage across common text-to-image backbones, guidance scales, and sampler step counts.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions include The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Griffith University, and Data61/CSIRO.

recommendation.zh: 读理论化简和采样消融即可；若零额外 NFE 成立，对 diffusion guidance 有用，但别外推到 LM。
recommendation.en: Read the algebraic reduction and sampler ablations only; if the zero-extra-NFE claim holds, it matters for diffusion guidance, not for LMs.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: Knowledge Visualization: A Benchmark and Method for Knowledge-Intensive Text-to-Image Generation
paper.abstract: Recent text-to-image (T2I) models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in photorealistic synthesis and instruction following. However, their reliability in knowledge-intensive settings remains largely unexplored. Unlike natural image generation, knowledge visualization requires not only semantic alignment but also strict adherence to domain knowledge, structural constraints, and symbolic conventions, exposing a critical gap between visual plausibility and scientific correctness. To systemat

summary.core_problem: 这项工作评测并改进知识密集型文生图：模型生成的图像看起来合理，但可能违反教材中的结构、符号、空间关系和领域约定。
summary.importance: 它对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性不强，更偏多模态生成评测和约束式生成。但其中的 checklist 分解有参考价值：复杂知识生成不能只看整体偏好分，而应拆成可验证的原子约束。这对多模态 reward、自动评测器、基于约束的数据合成有启发。
summary.technical_approach: KVBench 覆盖高中六个学科：生物、化学、地理、历史、数学和物理。每个学科整理 150 个知识概念，并提供中英双语 prompt，总计 1,800 个样本。它不采用单一整体评分，而是从权威教材中抽取原子 checklist，逐项检查实体、标签、空间关系、结构组成和学科符号是否正确。方法部分提出 KE-Check，分两步：先做 Knowledge Elaboration，把抽象 prompt 扩展成结构化、领域化描述；再做 Checklist-Guided Refinement，构造约束清单，逐项审计生成结果，并用约束指导编辑。这个设计把知识注入和约束修正拆开，避免只靠更长 prompt 解决所有问题。
summary.experiments: 实验比较了多个文生图模型在 KVBench 上的知识可视化能力，结论是现有模型在视觉真实感之外仍存在稳定缺陷，包括结构遗漏、符号错误、关系不一致和中英文鲁棒性差异。KE-Check 能提升科学正确性，尤其有助于缩小开源模型和闭源模型之间的差距。给定材料中明确的规模数字是 1,800 个双语样本、六个学科、每学科 150 个知识概念；具体模型分数和分项提升幅度需要看实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议重点看 KVBench 的数据构造、checklist 标注规范和 KE-Check 的 refinement 流程。实验部分主要看按学科和按错误类型拆分的结果，不必在意单个文生图模型的排名。若关注多模态 reward 或自动评测，可以多看 checklist 如何从教材标准转成可执行判据。

summary_en.core_problem: The work studies knowledge-intensive text-to-image generation, where an image may look plausible but still violate textbook-level structure, symbols, spatial relations, or domain conventions.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to LLM pretraining is limited; it is mainly a multimodal generation benchmark and refinement method. The useful part is the checklist-based decomposition of correctness. For complex knowledge generation, a holistic preference score is often too coarse. Atomic, verifiable constraints are more informative for multimodal rewards, automatic evaluators, and constraint-aware data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: KVBench covers six high-school subjects: Biology, Chemistry, Geography, History, Mathematics, and Physics. It curates 150 knowledge concepts per subject and provides bilingual English-Chinese prompts, resulting in 1,800 samples. Instead of using a single global judgment, the benchmark derives atomic checklist items from authoritative textbooks. These items verify entities, labels, spatial relations, structural components, and symbolic conventions. The proposed KE-Check framework has two stages. Knowledge Elaboration expands an abstract prompt into a structured, domain-specific description. Checklist-Guided Refinement then builds a constraint list, audits the generated image item by item, and applies constraint-guided editing. The separation is important: knowledge injection and constraint enforcement are handled as different steps rather than being folded into one longer prompt.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate several text-to-image systems on KVBench and show persistent failures beyond visual realism, including missing structures, incorrect symbols, inconsistent relations, and multilingual robustness gaps. KE-Check improves scientific fidelity and narrows part of the gap between open-source and proprietary models. The supplied material gives the benchmark scale clearly: 1,800 bilingual samples across six subjects, with 150 concepts per subject. Exact model scores and per-category improvements require checking the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the KVBench construction process, checklist annotation rules, and the KE-Check refinement pipeline. In the experiments, prioritize breakdowns by subject and error type rather than the ranking of individual image generators. For readers working on multimodal rewards or automatic evaluation, the most useful details are how textbook standards are converted into executable checklist criteria.

recommendation.zh: 把T2I从“像不像”拉回“对不对”的评测很实用；只看任务定义与失败类型统计，别指望它给出训练配方。
recommendation.en: Useful for shifting T2I evaluation from “looks right” to “is correct”; read the task spec and failure taxonomy, but don’t expect actionable training recipes.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: TwoHamsters: Benchmarking Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety in Text-to-Image Models
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable synthesis capabilities of text-to-image (T2I) models, safeguarding them against content violations remains a persistent challenge. Existing safety alignments primarily focus on explicit malicious concepts, often overlooking the subtle yet critical risks of compositional semantics. To address this oversight, we identify and formalize a novel vulnerability: Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety (MCCU), where unsafe semantics stem from the implicit associations of individually

summary.core_problem: 在文生图模型里，很多不安全语义不是来自单一显式概念（裸露、血腥等），而是来自“两个各自无害的概念组合后触发的隐含语境”。论文要解决的是：如何把这种 Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety (MCCU) 形式化、系统构造评测集，并用可量化指标评估模型与防御方法在“安全性—可用性”之间的权衡。
summary.importance:
对 LLM 基座预训练本身的直接贡献有限（更偏 T2I safety benchmark），但对“跨模态统一预训练/对齐”团队有两点启发：
1) 安全风险不只在显式 token/概念层面，组合语义会引入新的攻击面，且与模型的指令遵循能力正相关（论文称 Instruction-Safety dilemma）。
2) 评测指标设计强调同时度量防御率与概念保真（避免把正常概念一刀切抹掉），这类指标在多模态对齐/概念擦除训练里很实用。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 TwoHamsters 基准：
- 形式化标注单元为 (s, c, v1, v2, p)：安全标签 s、风险类别 c、两个原子概念 v1/v2、以及 prompt p，把“风险”锚定到概念对。
- 构建层级 taxonomy：10 个主风险类、51 个细粒度概念对，来源于多平台安全政策整理。
- 多阶段数据管线：相似度过滤与视觉有效性筛查（剔除生成图像未体现目标概念的 prompt），再用 VLM 做风险推理扩增，最后专家人工复核。
- 为自动化评测提供两个检测器：MCCU-ViT（高吞吐）与 MCCU-VLM（可解释、细粒度）。
- 指标体系：MDR（MCCU Defense Rate，拦截/防御率）、SCR（Single-Concept Retention，单概念保留能力）、NCR（Non-target Concept Retention，非目标概念保留），用来刻画“防住组合风险”与“保留正常生成能力”的张力。
- 大规模对比：评测多种 T2I 模型、NSFW filter、concept erasure 方法，归纳 8 条经验性结论。
summary.experiments:
数据规模：5.8k 高风险 MCCU 场景、共 17.5k prompts。
评测覆盖：10 个 SOTA T2I 模型与 16 种防御机制（文中另称总计评测 26 个模型/过滤器/概念擦除方法，需以正文表格口径为准）。
核心结论：
- 主流 NSFW 过滤器对 MCCU 失效，原因是它们依赖显式视觉特征，难以捕捉隐含语境。
- 概念擦除方法面临两难：要抑制 MCCU 往往需要伤害组成概念本身，导致 SCR/NCR 明显下降。
- “Instruction-Safety dilemma”：模型越能遵循 prompt、生成越贴合语义，越容易把 benign 概念组合成有害隐喻，从而 MCCU 风险上升。
（具体数值与各模型排名主要在 benchmark 表格与 8 insights 对应实验中，建议直接看正文结果表。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Introduction 里 MCCU 定义与 Figure 1/2（理解问题边界与数据构建流程）。
- 再看 benchmark 章节的 taxonomy、数据管线与三指标（MDR/SCR/NCR），这是可迁移的设计。
- 最后扫结果表与“8 insights”，把握哪些防御在 MDR 提升时牺牲了 SCR/NCR。
预计阅读时间：25–40 分钟（以理解 benchmark 设计为主，不必逐条看所有模型结果）。

summary_en.core_problem: Text-to-image models can produce unsafe semantics not from an explicitly malicious concept, but from the composition of two individually benign concepts that triggers harmful contextual associations. The paper formalizes this as Multi-Concept Compositional Unsafety (MCCU) and builds a benchmark to measure how vulnerable models and defenses are under this compositional threat model.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a T2I safety benchmark rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is indirect but practical for multimodal pretraining/alignment: (1) safety failures can be compositional and correlate with better instruction-following (the paper’s “Instruction–Safety dilemma”); (2) the evaluation framework explicitly measures the safety–utility trade-off via concept retention metrics, which is useful when training or evaluating concept suppression/erasure methods in multimodal systems.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TwoHamsters benchmark design:
- Annotation unit is (s, c, v1, v2, p): binary safety label, hazard category, two atomic concepts, and the prompt—explicitly tying risk to concept pairs.
- A hierarchical taxonomy with 10 top-level risk categories and 51 fine-grained concept pairs, derived from multiple platform safety policies.
- Multi-stage curation: similarity filtering, visual validity screening (discard prompts whose generations do not realize the target concepts), VLM-based risk reasoning for augmentation, and expert human verification.
- Two automated detectors for scalable evaluation: MCCU-ViT (throughput-oriented) and MCCU-VLM (interpretable, fine-grained).
- Metrics: MCCU Defense Rate (MDR), Single-Concept Retention (SCR), and Non-target Concept Retention (NCR) to quantify safety vs collateral utility loss.
- Broad evaluation across models, NSFW filters, and concept erasure defenses, summarized into eight empirical insights.
summary_en.experiments:
Scale: 5.8k high-risk MCCU scenarios and 17.5k curated prompts.
Coverage: evaluation on 10 SOTA T2I models and 16 defense mechanisms (the introduction also mentions 26 total models/filters/erasure methods—confirm exact counting in the main tables).
Key findings:
- Mainstream NSFW filters miss MCCU because they rely on explicit visual cues rather than contextual/compositional semantics.
- Concept erasure methods struggle: mitigating MCCU often damages benign concept generation, reflected as drops in SCR/NCR.
- “Instruction–Safety dilemma”: stronger prompt adherence can increase MCCU susceptibility.
(Exact per-model MDR/SCR/NCR numbers are concentrated in the results tables and the section enumerating the eight insights.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the Introduction and the figures defining MCCU and the curation pipeline to understand the threat model.
- Focus on the benchmark section for taxonomy + MDR/SCR/NCR metrics (the most reusable design).
- Then scan the main results tables and the “eight insights” summary to see which defenses trade MDR for SCR/NCR.
Time: ~25–40 minutes, benchmark-design oriented.

recommendation.zh: 把“组合语义绕过安全”做成可复现基准，适合用来压测自家T2I/guard；只看leaderboard没用，重点读他们对16种防御失效的归因。
recommendation.en: A reproducible benchmark for compositional safety bypass—useful to red-team your T2I/guards; skip the headline rates and focus on the failure analysis across 16 defenses.

paper.title: Enhanced Text-to-Image Generation by Fine-grained Multimodal Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 统一多模态大模型在文生图生成中缺乏对prompt细粒度属性的可控反思与纠错，导致细节控制弱。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把“理解侧能力”以可解释的细粒度反馈形式注入生成流程：用分解式VQA逐项核验prompt语义单元，为生成提供可定位的纠错信号；对“反思-修正”式生成范式有启发，但更偏应用到T2I控制。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FiMR：将输入prompt分解为最小语义单元（实体/属性/关系等），对每个单元构造VQA问题并在生成中/后进行核验，得到显式细粒度反馈；再基于反馈进行有针对性的局部prompt/生成修正（反思与精炼循环）。整体属于把多模态推理链路用于生成控制的框架化方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据规模与明确SOTA幅度信息；主要应在细粒度属性一致性、可控性与生成质量上对比“整体对齐判断/打分-重采样”类基线与若干多模态反思生成方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Unified multimodal models underutilize fine-grained reasoning for text-to-image generation, leading to weak control over detailed prompt attributes.
summary_en.importance: Key contribution is turning understanding-side capability into explicit, fine-grained corrective signals for generation via decomposed VQA verification. It is conceptually relevant to reflection-and-rectification generation paradigms, though primarily an application-level control framework for T2I.
summary_en.technical_approach: FiMR decomposes a prompt into minimal semantic units (entities/attributes/relations), verifies each unit through constructed VQA queries during/after generation to obtain explicit feedback, and then performs targeted, localized refinements based on that feedback in an iterative reflection loop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model/data scale or clear SOTA margins; evaluation likely focuses on attribute-level faithfulness/controllability and image quality against holistic alignment-judgment baselines and prior reasoning-based generation methods.

recommendation.zh: 把VQA式逐项核验当生成纠错信号，思路可借但工程堆叠重、对预训练结论弱；知道有这套路即可。
recommendation.en: Uses VQA-style attribute checks as a correction signal for T2I; neat pattern but heavily engineered and weakly informative for pretraining—good to know, not to study.

paper.title: Bias at the End of the Score

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦于一个被T2I流水线长期默认但缺乏系统验证的问题：作为“图像质量/对齐/审美”的代理指标，Reward Model（RM）在训练、筛选、评测与reward-guided优化（如ReNO）中是否对人口统计属性（性别/种族）具有系统性偏置与脆弱性，并且这种偏置是否会在“用RM去优化生成结果”的闭环中被放大，导致与prompt无关的人口属性漂移、刻板印象强化与安全风险（如性化/NSFW）上升。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值不在于提出新预训练算法，而在于揭示“评分函数/偏好模型作为训练信号”的结构性风险：当RM被当作可微或可优化的目标时，其隐含的频率先验与社会偏见会变成强梯度，驱动生成分布发生系统性坍缩（demographic convergence）与安全属性恶化（hypersexualization）。这对RLHF/RLAIF、reward pretrain、数据过滤与合成数据闭环都有直接警示意义：1）reward并非中性度量，2）reward偏置会在迭代优化中指数级累积，3）需要把“reward的鲁棒/公平/校准”当作与模型loss同等重要的训练对象与评测维度。
summary.technical_approach: 全文是两段式审计框架，对应“后果”与“机制”。(I) 后果层：把RM放进ReNO式reward-guided优化流程中（RM作为优化目标，对生成图像进行迭代改写/选择），观察优化前后与prompt未指定属性相关的变化，重点量化：人口属性是否被改变（如Black→White、female→male）、以及NSFW/皮肤暴露等安全指标是否上升，并比较不同RM（PickScore/HPS/ImageReward/CLIP等）与不同base生成模型组合下的差异。(II) 机制层：构造/使用反事实(counterfactual)数据集，使图像在语义与质量近似的前提下主要差异来自种族/性别呈现；在这些对照条件下直接测量RM打分差异，并进一步分析这些差异是否与现实世界频率先验（如职业性别比例）和有害刻板印象相关。核心方法论贡献是把RM当作“可被统计检验的评分器”，用反事实对照把人口属性从混杂因素中剥离出来，从而把偏置定位为RM本身的可预测信号，而不是生成模型或prompt分布的偶然产物。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了两类关键结果（文中给出明确量化结论）：(1) ReNO优化放大性化/NSFW：在所有评估的reward与base模型组合中，PickScore导致NSFW分类率与skin exposure提升最大；且对女性影响显著更大——女性NSFW率平均增加19%，男性增加7%，女性增幅约为2.7×。(2) demographic convergence：用HPS与ImageReward做优化时，多样主体向White收敛最强；ImageReward与HPS使“Black主体被分类为White”的比例超过80%。在性别维度，使用ImageReward与CLIP优化时，带female标签的图像分别有超过39%与26%被重新分类为male。(3) 评分层偏置：在主要差异为种族/性别呈现的反事实对照中，各RM稳定偏好特定群体；例如HPS与ImageReward总体更偏好White；VQAScore在“正向prompt”更偏好White、在“负向prompt”反向偏好Black；CLIP通常把Black排在更后。(4) 频率先验：职业prompt下reward分数与美国劳工统计局职业女性占比相关，表明RM不仅评估“质量”，还在奖励“符合主流分布的呈现”。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：优先看Introduction里两段式问题设定（RM在T2I中的多重角色 + 偏置闭环风险），然后直接跳到两部分实验：Part I/对应章节（ReNO优化导致的属性漂移与NSFW/SE变化）看关键表格/图（尤其是按性别/种族分组的前后对比）；Part II/对应章节（counterfactual数据集上的打分差异）看“不同RM对不同群体的排序/分数差”与“职业-性别比例相关性”分析。阅读时重点抓：1）他们如何控制混杂（反事实构造与评测协议），2）哪些RM偏置方向一致/相反（如VQAScore的正负prompt翻转现象），3）为什么这些偏置在优化环节会变成强分布漂移（把RM当目标函数时的放大机制）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits a largely unvalidated assumption in modern text-to-image pipelines: reward models (RMs), used as proxies for alignment/aesthetics/overall image quality, may exhibit systematic demographic bias (race/gender) and lack robustness. Crucially, when RMs are used not only for evaluation/filtering but as optimization objectives (e.g., ReNO-style reward-guided optimization), these biases can be amplified, causing prompt-irrelevant demographic attribute drift, stereotype reinforcement, and safety regressions (e.g., increased sexualization/NSFW).
summary_en.importance: While not a pretraining-method paper per se, it is highly relevant to foundation-model training loops that rely on learned scorers (reward/preference models) for data curation, synthetic data feedback, and RL-style optimization. The key takeaway for pretraining/RL-pretrain is that a reward function is not a neutral metric: it can encode frequency priors and social biases that become strong gradients in closed-loop optimization, leading to demographic collapse and safety degradation. This directly informs how we should design, train, calibrate, and evaluate reward models used in RLHF/RLAIF, dataset filtering, and iterative self-improvement pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a two-stage audit separating downstream effects from scoring mechanisms. (I) Outcome-level analysis: plug multiple widely used RMs into a reward-guided optimization framework (ReNO) and quantify how optimized images change along demographic attributes not specified by the prompt, and how safety-related properties (NSFW rate, skin exposure) shift—broken down by gender/race and across different RM/base-model combinations. (II) Mechanism-level analysis: evaluate RM score disparities on counterfactual datasets where images are matched except for demographic presentation, enabling statistical tests of whether demographic attributes significantly predict RM scores. The paper further probes whether score disparities align with real-world frequency priors (e.g., occupation gender shares) and harmful stereotypes, reframing RMs as measurable, bias-bearing scoring functions rather than faithful “quality” estimators.
summary_en.experiments: Key reported findings include: (1) Reward-guided optimization amplifies sexualization/NSFW, with PickScore producing the largest increases; the NSFW rate increases by ~19% for female subjects vs ~7% for male subjects (≈2.7× larger). (2) Demographic convergence under optimization: HPS and ImageReward drive strong shifts toward White subjects; for Black subjects, >80% of images are classified as White after optimization. For gender, optimization with ImageReward and CLIP causes female-labeled images to be reclassified as male more than ~39% and ~26% of the time, respectively. (3) Score-level demographic bias: across counterfactual comparisons, each RM consistently favors certain demographics; e.g., HPS/ImageReward tend to rank White subjects highest, CLIP often ranks Black subjects last; VQAScore exhibits a polarity effect (White favored under positive prompts, Black favored under negative prompts). (4) Frequency priors: with occupation prompts, reward scores correlate with real-world female employment shares, suggesting RMs reward conformity to dominant demographic patterns beyond image quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim plan (30–45 minutes): read the Introduction for the pipeline roles of RMs and the closed-loop risk framing; then focus on the two experimental blocks—(i) the ReNO optimization section for before/after demographic drift and NSFW/skin-exposure deltas (especially subgroup breakdowns), and (ii) the counterfactual scoring section for direct evidence of demographic score disparities and the occupation-frequency correlation analysis. Pay attention to how confounders are controlled via counterfactual design, which RMs show consistent directional bias vs prompt-dependent reversals (e.g., VQAScore), and why optimization turns small score biases into large distribution shifts.

recommendation.zh: 作为闭环风险备查：它把“RM偏置会被优化放大”讲得够硬，提醒做reward筛选/优化时必须把公平与校准当一等指标，否则分布会系统性跑偏。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a loop-risk reference: it makes a strong case that RM bias amplifies under optimization, so fairness/calibration must be first-class metrics when using rewards for filtering or guidance.

paper.title: Nucleus-Image: Sparse MoE for Image Generation

summary.core_problem: 在扩散式文生图中同时做到“接近/达到SOTA画质”与“显著降低单次采样计算与显存”，并解决稀疏MoE扩散Transformer在timestep调制下的路由不稳定、以及文本条件在多步扩散中KV重复计算带来的推理低效问题。
summary.importance: 对“生成模型的Scaling与效率”给出一条可复用路线：用MoE把总容量推到17B但每步只激活约2B，从而在质量-效率Pareto上前移；同时把文本条件从主干Transformer中剥离并做跨步KV共享，属于面向推理的结构性改造。对做大规模预训练/持续训练的研究者，价值主要在：1）MoE在扩散Transformer上的工程化与稳定性设计；2）数据控制平面（metadata+信号）驱动的可迭代数据科学流程；3）训练课程（curriculum）与质量分层在生成预训练中的系统化落地。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 架构：采用稀疏MoE Diffusion Transformer，每层64个routed experts，总参数约17B，但每次前向仅激活约2B参数。路由使用Expert-Choice Routing（专家选择token）以获得更均衡的专家利用率，减少/避免依赖大权重的load-balancing辅助损失。
2) 文本条件与注意力：将文本token从Transformer主干中完全移除（不与图像latent token一起走主干层），改用joint attention机制，使文本侧KV可在扩散多时间步之间共享，减少每步重复编码与KV构建开销。
3) 路由稳定性：扩散模型常用timestep modulation（随时间步调制特征/层归一化等）会干扰路由打分分布，作者提出decoupled routing，将路由分支与timestep调制影响解耦（路由使用更“静态/稳态”的表征或单独分支），提升训练稳定性与专家分配一致性。
4) 训练目标与课程：使用rectified flow监督（替代/改造传统扩散噪声预测范式），并采用多阶段课程学习：训练早期覆盖更广数据，后期提高高质量tier样本权重，以提升最终生成质量。
5) 数据科学与管线：构建约700M图像、约1.5B图文对的语料；以“像素资产存储(GCS) + Parquet元数据控制平面”解耦，所有过滤、打分、caption来源、质量tier、curriculum bucket、路由tag等都写入元数据列，支持快速回溯与版本化迭代；清洗分CPU两级（解码/几何/格式一致性；直方图与内容启发式、极端纵横比、letterbox等），把昂贵标注/打分留给高存活样本。
summary.experiments:
论文主张在GenEval、DPG-Bench、OneIG-Bench上达到/超过领先模型，同时每次前向仅激活约2B参数（总容量17B，64 experts/layer）。在给定的全文片段中，除“激活2B/总17B/数据700M与1.5B pairs/课程K=8分桶/最终SOTA模型最高约71.58%”等信息外，缺少更细的表格数字（如各基线分数、采样速度、FID/CLIPScore、训练token/step、消融增益）。建议以原文实验章节与附录表格为准补齐：
- MoE vs dense同算力/同激活参数对比（质量与吞吐）
- decoupled routing对路由熵、专家利用率、loss曲线稳定性的影响
- joint attention + text KV sharing对推理延迟/显存的收益
- curriculum与质量tier配比对最终基准分数的提升幅度
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约30–45分钟）：
1) 先看架构与推理优化部分：文本token剥离、joint attention、跨timestep KV共享——这是“质量不降但推理显著省”的关键结构点。
2) 再看MoE与路由章节：Expert-Choice Routing为何更稳、如何避免额外负载均衡损失；重点找与timestep modulation冲突的现象描述，以及decoupled routing的具体实现（路由输入、stop-grad、归一化、温度/噪声等细节）。
3) 数据管线章节建议扫读图5与Table 1（schema）：理解其“元数据控制平面”如何支持快速迭代与可追溯，这对大规模预训练数据科学很有借鉴。
4) 若时间有限，实验部分优先看：质量-效率Pareto图、路由稳定性消融、KV共享带来的latency/显存曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: How to push text-to-image diffusion quality to the frontier while drastically reducing per-step compute/memory, and how to make sparse MoE diffusion Transformers stable under timestep-dependent modulation while avoiding redundant text conditioning computation across diffusion steps.
summary_en.importance: The paper is most relevant as a “scaling + efficiency recipe” for generative pretraining: (i) scale total capacity via MoE (17B total) while keeping active parameters per forward around 2B, improving the quality/efficiency Pareto; (ii) a structural inference-oriented redesign that removes text tokens from the backbone and enables cross-timestep text KV reuse; (iii) a data/control-plane approach (metadata-driven filtering, tiering, curriculum) that is directly transferable to large-scale foundation model data science. For base-model researchers, the key value is not the benchmark itself but the system-level coupling of MoE stability, training curriculum, and inference-efficient conditioning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Sparse MoE Diffusion Transformer: 64 routed experts per layer, ~17B total parameters, but only ~2B activated per forward pass.
2) Routing: Expert-Choice Routing (experts select tokens) to keep utilization balanced with less reliance on heavy auxiliary load-balancing losses.
3) Conditioning redesign: exclude text tokens from the main Transformer backbone; use a joint-attention mechanism so text-side KV can be shared across diffusion timesteps, cutting repeated computation and memory.
4) Decoupled routing for stability: timestep modulation can shift feature distributions and destabilize routing; the paper introduces a decoupled routing design that separates routing signals from timestep-modulated activations to improve training stability and expert assignment consistency.
5) Training objective & curriculum: rectified flow supervision plus a multi-stage curriculum that increases the emphasis on higher-quality data tiers later in training.
6) Data pipeline: ~700M curated images and ~1.5B image-caption pairs; a metadata-first design (Parquet control plane + immutable snapshots/manifests) enabling fast iteration, debuggability, and deterministic sampling via attached signals (quality tiers, curriculum buckets K=8, aspect-ratio buckets, caption provenance, routing tags).
summary_en.experiments: From the provided full-content excerpt, the paper reports: competitive or leading results on GenEval / DPG-Bench / OneIG-Bench while activating ~2B params per pass (17B total, 64 experts/layer), trained on ~700M images (~1.5B pairs). However, the excerpt does not include the detailed quantitative tables/plots (exact benchmark scores, throughput/latency, memory, ablations). When reading the full paper, prioritize extracting: (i) Pareto plots (quality vs active params / latency), (ii) ablations for decoupled routing (routing collapse metrics, utilization, loss stability), (iii) gains from text KV sharing (end-to-end sampling speed and peak memory), and (iv) curriculum/tier-mix sensitivity.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
- Architecture/inference section first: text-token removal from backbone + joint attention + cross-timestep KV sharing (core efficiency idea).
- MoE/routing section next: why expert-choice routing, and the exact decoupled routing implementation under timestep modulation.
- Data pipeline section: focus on the metadata schema/table and retention funnel figure to understand the “control plane” concept.
- Experiments: look for Pareto frontier plots and routing/efficiency ablations; ignore qualitative samples unless you need failure modes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 MoE 扩散 Transformer 的路由稳定与跨步文本 KV 共享这两处“真省钱”改造；其余 SOTA 叙事可略，重点抓可复用的工程约束与失败模式。
recommendation.en: Skim for two genuinely cost-cutting ideas: stabilizing MoE routing in diffusion Transformers and sharing text KV across timesteps; ignore most SOTA storytelling, focus on reusable constraints and failure modes.

paper.title: T2I-BiasBench: A Multi-Metric Framework for Auditing Demographic and Cultural Bias in Text-to-Image Models

summary.core_problem: 系统审计文本到图像模型中的人口统计与文化偏见，并同时覆盖偏见、元素遗漏与“文化坍缩”三类现象的评测需求。
summary.importance: Benchmark/评测贡献：提出多指标框架把偏见与生成缺失/坍缩问题统一量化；对多模态生成模型的数据配比、对齐与安全评测有参考价值，但对文本LLM预训练方法论是间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: T2I-BiasBench：13个互补指标（6个已有+7个新增/改造），新增如Composite Bias Score、Grounded/Implicit Missing Rate、Cultural Accuracy Ratio，并引入Hallucination/Vendi/CLIP proxy等适配指标；以结构化prompt集生成图像并汇总多维度评分。
summary.experiments: 评测Stable Diffusion v1.5、BK-SDM Base、Koala Lightning，并以Gemini 2.5 Flash（RLHF对齐）作参考；基准共1,574张生成图像、5类结构化prompt；摘要未给出完整量化结论细节（仅描述发现）。

summary_en.core_problem: Audit demographic and cultural bias in text-to-image models with a unified evaluation that also captures omission and cultural collapse.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark/evaluation contribution: a multi-metric framework that jointly quantifies bias and generation failures (missing elements/cultural collapse), useful for multimodal generative model data, alignment, and safety evaluation; only indirectly informative for text-only LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: T2I-BiasBench with 13 complementary metrics (6 existing + 7 new/adapted), including Composite Bias Score, Grounded/Implicit Missing Rate, Cultural Accuracy Ratio, and adapted hallucination/Vendi/CLIP-proxy measures; uses structured prompts to generate images and aggregates scores across dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates Stable Diffusion v1.5, BK-SDM Base, Koala Lightning, with Gemini 2.5 Flash (RLHF-aligned) as a reference; 1,574 generated images across five prompt categories; the abstract lacks detailed quantitative results beyond high-level findings.

recommendation.zh: 当作评测备查即可：指标把“偏见/遗漏/文化坍缩”拆开量化，适合拿来补你们 T2I 安全评测表，但不必细读方法细节。
recommendation.en: Keep as a benchmarking reference: it separates bias vs omission vs cultural collapse with multiple metrics—useful to plug into a T2I audit checklist, not worth deep reading.

paper.title: PromptEcho: Annotation-Free Reward from Vision-Language Models for Text-to-Image Reinforcement Learning

summary.core_problem: 文本到图像(T2I)的RL能提升prompt following，但奖励信号难：CLIP类过于粗粒度，VLM奖励模型需要偏好标注与额外训练，直接让VLM打分又不稳定（采样随机/幻觉）。论文要解决的是：如何在“零标注、零奖励模型训练”的条件下，构造一个稳定、细粒度、可扩展（随VLM变强自动变强）的奖励，用于T2I的RL优化。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义在于“把预训练目标直接当作可用奖励/监督信号”的范式：PromptEcho用冻结VLM的token级交叉熵（与VLM预训练目标一致）作为reward，绕开偏好标注与reward model训练。这对更广义的RL-pretrain/后训练有启发：当一个强基座模型已通过大规模预训练学到对齐知识时，可以用其原生似然/损失作为确定性奖励，减少对人类偏好与额外标注的依赖，并天然具备scaling属性（换更强VLM即更强reward）。此外，它把“理解(对齐知识)”与“推理式评审(生成式打分)”区分开，强调确定性、可微/可控的打分路径。
summary.technical_approach:
PromptEcho奖励：给定生成图像x与原始prompt c，向冻结VLM输入(图片x, 引导query q，如“Describe this image in detail.”)，然后把c当作label，在对应token位置计算VLM输出对c的token级交叉熵loss，reward取其相反数：图像越能让VLM高概率“复述”出prompt token序列，reward越高。关键点：
1）确定性：不做自回归采样生成描述，直接用logits算CE，避免InferScore的随机性与幻觉。
2）细粒度：token级似然对属性/关系/计数等更敏感（至少理论上比单一CLIP相似度更细）。
3）可扩展：reward质量随开源VLM能力提升而提升，无需重训reward model。

RL算法：采用AWM(Advantage Weighted Matching)用于扩散模型RL，使用纯ODE采样避免探索噪声导致画质下降；训练流程为：从caption数据采样prompt→T2I生成一组图→冻结VLM算PromptEcho reward→组内相对优势(advantage)→AWM更新。

数据构造：内部约100K高质量“概念丰富”图片，用Qwen3-VL-32B在固定提示下生成200–400词的长caption作为训练prompt分布，强调覆盖对象、属性、空间关系、颜色纹理等。
summary.experiments:
论文在给定全文片段中明确给出部分关键数字与设置：
- 适配两种SOTA T2I模型：Z-Image 与 QwenImage-2512。
- DenseAlignBench胜率提升：+26.8pp / +16.2pp（对应两模型）。
- 在公开基准上“持续增益”：GenEval、DPG-Bench、TIIFBench（未在片段中给出具体分数）。
- 声称可迁移到文本渲染(text rendering)任务。

但当前提供的全文仍缺少实验细节：PromptEcho相对CLIP/RewardDance/InferScore的完整对比表、训练步数/采样预算、VLM选择与尺寸对reward质量的scaling曲线、以及关键消融（guiding query选择、只算部分token/加权、caption长度影响、不同VLM的reward一致性与偏置）。这些决定了方法是否真正“细粒度且稳健”。若补充实验章节，我可以把每个benchmark的绝对分、显著性、以及画质-对齐权衡（FID/IS/偏好）系统拆解。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45分钟）：
1）Method：把reward公式看清楚——哪些token计入loss、是否mask掉系统prompt/引导query、是否做长度归一化、如何处理BPE/tokenizer导致的词粒度问题。
2）Section 4/5（实验与分析，需你补齐后半部分）：重点看三类消融——(a) VLM能力scaling：换不同VLM reward是否单调提升；(b) 与InferScore对比：确定性带来的方差下降与稳定训练证据；(c) reward hacking：模型是否学会生成“让VLM容易复述prompt”的捷径而非真实对齐（例如过度文字化、模板化纹理）。
3）数据：100K内部数据+Qwen3-VL-32B长caption的分布是否会引入风格偏置；caption过长时token级CE是否更偏向语言先验而非视觉证据。

值得深挖（对预训练/后训练更关键）：PromptEcho本质是“用教师模型的条件似然当reward”。可以类比到LLM领域：用冻结teacher对(student输出|上下文)的NLL作为确定性reward/优势信号，探索其与DPO/IPO/RLVR的关系，以及在持续学习中作为无标注对齐约束的可行性。

summary_en.core_problem: RL can improve prompt following in text-to-image generation, but reward design is the bottleneck: CLIP-like scores are too coarse, VLM-based reward models require costly preference annotations and extra training, and prompting a VLM to judge alignment is stochastic and hallucination-prone. The paper asks: can we build a high-quality, deterministic reward with zero annotation and zero reward-model training?
summary_en.importance: The key contribution is a paradigm shift: directly reuse a pretrained VLM’s native training objective (token-level cross-entropy) as an RL reward, instead of training a separate reward model or relying on sampled VLM judgments. This is conceptually relevant to RL-pretrain / post-training more broadly: when a strong foundation model already encodes alignment knowledge, its conditional likelihood can serve as a scalable, annotation-free, deterministic supervision signal. The method also cleanly separates “encoded understanding/alignment” from “reasoning-based judging”, arguing the former is more stable as a reward source.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PromptEcho reward: for a generated image x from prompt c, feed (x, a fixed guiding query q such as “Describe this image in detail.”) into a frozen VLM M, then treat the original prompt c as the label sequence and compute token-level cross-entropy over the positions of c. The reward is the negative CE:
- Deterministic: no autoregressive sampling of a description, avoiding randomness and VLM hallucinations in scoring.
- Fine-grained: token-level likelihood is intended to be sensitive to missing attributes, relations, and counting.
- Scalable: reward quality improves automatically with stronger open-source VLMs, without re-annotation or reward-model retraining.

RL optimization: they use Advantage Weighted Matching (AWM) for diffusion-model RL, emphasizing pure ODE sampling to avoid quality degradation from exploration noise. Pipeline: sample prompts → generate a group of images → compute PromptEcho rewards via frozen VLM → compute group-relative advantages → update the T2I model.

Data: an internal ~100K high-quality, concept-rich image set; Qwen3-VL-32B generates long (200–400 word) detailed captions under a fixed query to form the prompt distribution.
summary_en.experiments:
Concrete numbers present in the provided text:
- Evaluated on two T2I models: Z-Image and QwenImage-2512.
- DenseAlignBench win-rate gains: +26.8 percentage points / +16.2 pp.
- Reported consistent gains on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and TIIFBench (exact scores not included in the excerpt).
- Claimed successful application to text rendering.

What’s missing due to truncation: full benchmark tables, training budgets, comparisons against CLIP/InferScore/RewardDance-style rewards, VLM-choice scaling curves, and critical ablations (guiding query, length normalization, token weighting, robustness and reward hacking). With the full experimental section, I can extract exact deltas and analyze the alignment–image-quality trade-off.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Method section: verify the exact CE computation (masking, length normalization, which tokens are scored, tokenizer effects).
2) Experiments/analysis (once available): focus on (i) scaling with VLM strength, (ii) stability vs InferScore (variance, training collapse rates), (iii) reward hacking checks (does the model exploit VLM priors rather than improving visual faithfulness?).
3) Data construction: assess whether long VLM-generated captions bias training toward verbose language priors and how that impacts reward reliability.

Deep-dive for foundation-model researchers: view PromptEcho as “teacher conditional NLL as reward”. Map it to LLM post-training (DPO/RLVR) and explore whether deterministic likelihood-based rewards can replace preference labels in certain regimes, and how this interacts with continual learning constraints.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫一眼 reward 定义：用冻结 VLM 的 token-level NLL 当确定性奖励，比“让模型当评委打分”干净，适合你内部先快速复现做 RL 管线对比。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward construction: using frozen VLM token-level NLL as a deterministic reward is cleaner than judge-style scoring, and is easy to slot into an internal RL pipeline for a quick baseline.

paper.title: Continuous Adversarial Flow Models

summary.core_problem: Flow Matching（FM）在视觉生成中常出现“无 guidance 时样本偏离数据分布（out-of-distribution）”的问题。作者认为根因之一是 FM 训练使用固定的欧氏 MSE 速度匹配损失，有限容量模型在这种度量下会产生不符合数据流形的泛化。问题是：能否在连续时间流模型中引入对抗式、可学习的判别准则，以更好地对齐真实数据分布，同时保持连续时间 ODE 生成框架？
summary.importance: 连续时间流模型（CNF/FM 系）是扩散/流生成的重要分支。若能在不依赖 guidance 的情况下显著提升分布匹配与感知质量，将直接改善“无引导采样”的可用性，并为后训练（post-training）现有 FM 模型提供低成本增益路径；同时把 GAN 式判别器优势引入连续时间生成，为统一/融合两类范式提供新接口。
summary.technical_approach:
（must_read 级别：详细技术分析）
1) 观点与动机：FM 通过最小化预测速度场与目标条件速度的 L2/MSE 来学习概率流的边际速度场。理论上无限容量可收敛到真流，但有限容量下，固定欧氏损失并不“流形感知”，导致错误泛化与 OOD 样本；而固定感知网络作为度量又可能被生成器“hacking”。
2) 核心方法：提出 Continuous Adversarial Flow Models（CAFM），把对抗训练引入连续时间流建模。与离散时间的 Adversarial Flow Models（AFM）不同，CAFM 在连续时间（ODE）框架下，用“学习到的判别器”替代固定的 MSE 准则来指导速度场学习，从而在有限容量情形诱导出不同的广义分布（generalized distribution），经验上更贴近目标数据分布。
3) 训练范式：主要定位为对现有 FM 的 post-training（微调/后训练），以较小训练成本改善分布对齐；也可从头训练。方法强调：FM 与 CAFM 目标真流相同，差异主要来自训练目标导致的泛化行为不同。
4) 预期效果机制：判别器相较点对点 L2 更敏感于纹理、锐度、轮廓等感知细节，可能更好刻画数据流形；联合训练判别器可缓解固定特征度量被利用的问题。
summary.experiments: ImageNet 256×256 类条件生成：对 latent-space SiT 的 guidance-free FID 从 8.26 提升到 3.63；对 pixel-space JiT 从 7.17 提升到 3.57，且仅需约 10 epochs 后训练。Guided 生成也有提升：SiT FID 2.06→1.53，JiT 1.86→1.80。文本到图像实验：GenEval 0.81→0.85，DPG 83.7→85.2。整体结论是：对抗式连续流后训练能显著改善无引导分布匹配与感知质量，并兼顾有引导场景。
summary.reading_guide:
（must_read：精读建议）
- 精读 Introduction：抓住作者对 FM “OOD 与欧氏度量”根因的论证链条，以及与 Riemannian FM、感知损失、GAN/AFM 的关系定位。
- 精读 Background（FM 推导部分）：确保理解条件速度/边际速度、FM 目标为何依赖度量性质（文中提到的准则条件），这是 CAFM 替换损失的理论接口。
- 精读 CAFM 方法章节：重点看对抗目标如何在连续时间/ODE 设定中定义（判别器输入是什么、与时间 t 的耦合方式、训练稳定性技巧、与 AFM 的关键差异）。
- 精读实验：重点看“post-training 设置”（训练轮数、学习率、判别器结构/正则、是否改变采样器）、以及 guidance-free 与 guided 的对比，判断收益来自分布对齐还是仅锐化。
（skim：泛读建议）
- 只想快速获取结论：读 Introduction + ImageNet 主表（SiT/JiT 的 FID 改善）+ 文本到图像指标（GenEval/DPG）。
summary.authors_note: 作者主张 FM 的固定 MSE 速度匹配在有限容量下会产生不符合数据流形的泛化，从而导致无 guidance 的 OOD 样本；通过在连续时间流模型中引入可学习判别器的对抗目标（CAFM），可作为对现有 FM 的高性价比后训练手段，显著提升分布匹配与感知质量。

summary_en.core_problem: Flow Matching (FM) often produces out-of-distribution samples in visual generation unless guidance is applied. The paper argues a key reason is the fixed Euclidean MSE objective for velocity matching: with finite model capacity, this non-manifold-aware metric induces undesirable generalization. The question is how to incorporate adversarial, learned criteria into continuous-time flow models (ODE/CNF setting) to better match the true data distribution while retaining continuous-time generation.
summary_en.importance: Continuous-time flow models are a major alternative to diffusion-style generators. Improving guidance-free fidelity and distribution matching would make unguided sampling more practical and provides a cost-effective post-training route for existing FM models. Conceptually, it also bridges GAN-style discriminators with continuous-time flow modeling, offering a new integration point between two paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
(must_read level: detailed technical analysis)
1) Motivation: FM learns the marginal velocity field of a probability flow by minimizing an L2/MSE loss between predicted and target conditional velocities. While infinite-capacity models can recover the true flow, finite-capacity models trained under a fixed Euclidean metric may generalize off the data manifold, yielding OOD samples. Using a fixed perceptual network as the metric can be exploited (“generator hacking”), motivating joint training of the criterion.
2) Method: Continuous Adversarial Flow Models (CAFMs) introduce adversarial training into continuous-time flow modeling. Unlike discrete-time Adversarial Flow Models (AFMs), CAFMs operate in continuous time (ODE/CNF) and replace the fixed MSE criterion with a learned discriminator to guide learning. This changes the effective generalized distribution induced under finite capacity and empirically yields samples closer to the target distribution.
3) Training usage: Primarily proposed as post-training (finetuning) of existing FM models for efficiency, though it can also train from scratch. The paper emphasizes FM and CAFM target the same ground-truth flow; differences arise mainly from finite-capacity generalization under different objectives.
4) Intuition: Discriminators are more sensitive to perceptual details (texture, sharpness, contours) than pointwise L2 losses and may better capture manifold structure; jointly learned criteria mitigate fixed-metric exploitation.
summary_en.experiments: On class-conditional ImageNet 256px: post-training improves guidance-free FID for latent-space SiT from 8.26 to 3.63 and for pixel-space JiT from 7.17 to 3.57 with ~10 epochs of finetuning. Guided generation also improves (SiT 2.06→1.53, JiT 1.86→1.80). In text-to-image, GenEval increases 0.81→0.85 and DPG 83.7→85.2. Overall, adversarial continuous-time post-training substantially improves unguided fidelity/distribution matching and also benefits guided settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
(must_read: deep reading)
- Read Introduction to understand the claimed root cause (Euclidean metric → manifold-mismatched generalization) and positioning vs Riemannian FM, perceptual losses, GANs, and AFMs.
- Read Background carefully (FM derivations): conditional vs marginal velocity and why the FM objective depends on properties of the distance/criterion—this is the theoretical hook for swapping MSE with a learned discriminator.
- Read the CAFM method section in detail: how the adversarial objective is defined in continuous time/ODE, what the discriminator sees, how time t is incorporated, stability/regularization tricks, and the key differences from discrete-time AFM.
- Read experiments focusing on the post-training protocol (epochs, optimizer, discriminator architecture/regularization, sampler changes) and compare guidance-free vs guided to judge whether gains are true distribution alignment vs mere sharpening.
(skim: quick reading)
- For takeaways only: read Introduction + the main ImageNet FID table (SiT/JiT) + the text-to-image GenEval/DPG results.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that FM’s fixed MSE velocity-matching objective leads to manifold-mismatched generalization under finite capacity, causing OOD unguided samples. By introducing a learned discriminator into continuous-time flow training (CAFM), they provide an efficient post-training recipe that markedly improves guidance-free fidelity and distribution matching, with additional gains under guidance.

recommendation.zh: 只需看对抗判别损失如何插进连续时间FM训练与稳定性ablation；若成立，后训练给现有FM加个判别器可能是低成本增益。
recommendation.en: Skim the exact adversarial objective insertion into continuous-time FM and the stability ablations; if it holds, adding a discriminator as post-training for existing FM could be a cheap win.

paper.title: GLEaN: A Text-to-image Bias Detection Approach for Public Comprehension

summary.core_problem: 如何把文本到图像（T2I）模型的社会偏见以“公众可读”的方式可视化呈现，而不仅是面向技术人员的统计指标。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏向评测/可解释性展示：提出一种面向非技术受众的偏见呈现范式（用代表性合成肖像直观展示模型“想象的典型人”），对生成模型公平性沟通与审计流程有启发，但对LLM基座训练/架构本身影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: GLEaN三阶段流水线：(1) 基于身份/职业等提示词进行大规模自动生成；(2) 用人脸关键点进行过滤与空间对齐以降低姿态/构图噪声；(3) 通过median-pixel合成得到“中心趋势”代表肖像，用于直观对比不同提示词下的偏差（如doctor vs felon）。
summary.experiments: 在Stable Diffusion XL上演示，覆盖约40个社会/职业类别；主要展示可视化案例与对比效果。摘要未给出定量指标、对比基线或显著性检验细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to communicate and visualize social biases in text-to-image models in a way that is understandable to the general public rather than only via technical aggregate metrics.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a public-facing bias presentation paradigm that produces intuitive, representative visual summaries of a model’s stereotyped ‘typical person,’ supporting fairness communication and auditing workflows even if it does not change model training itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes GLEaN, a three-stage pipeline: large-scale prompt-based generation over identity/occupation categories, facial-landmark filtering and spatial alignment to reduce pose/composition noise, and median-pixel compositing to create a central-tendency portrait for side-by-side bias comparison across prompts.
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrates the approach on Stable Diffusion XL across roughly 40 social/occupational categories, primarily via qualitative visualizations; the abstract does not report quantitative metrics, baselines, or significance testing.

recommendation.zh: 更像审计沟通工具而非训练论文：把T2I偏见做成公众可读展示，适合PR/治理流程；研究员只需看展示范式示例图。
recommendation.en: More of an audit-communication tool than a training paper: it visualizes T2I bias in a public-facing way for governance/PR workflows; researchers can just look at the exemplar visualizations.
